Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. You'll work on real business challenges, applying your skills to projects that create meaningful impact. 
Along the way, you'll deepen your knowledge of Mastercard's business, collaborate with teams across the organization, and develop the technical, analytical, and professional capabilities needed to accelerate your career. By the end of the program, you’ll have a strong foundation in your chosen field and the confidence to continue to grow here at Mastercard. 
About the team 
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities. 
What you’ll do 
As an Associate Consultant, you will: 
• collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions.  
• create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more. 
Specialization Tracks 
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences. 
Please specify on your CV which track you are interested in. Application deadline is the 30th of October. Our interview process will take place in the following 2-3 weeks after closing deadline.
Strategy & Transformation 
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms. 
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer: 
• How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market? 
• How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals? 
Team members typically support 1-3 projects concurrently, with each project lasting for approximately 8-16 weeks. 
Performance Analytics 
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations. 
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer: 
• How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class? 
• How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated? 
Team members support typically support several customers concurrently and include both short- and long-term projects that can last anywhere from 4 weeks up to 1 year. 
Marketing 
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible result

Use Your Power for Purpose 
 Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer’s digital and ‘data first’ strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Your work will directly contribute to improving patients' lives by protecting the integrity and confidentiality of data that drives our innovative healthcare solutions.
 What Will You Achieve 
 As an Associate, you will participate in projects, providing guidance on risk mitigation strategies, advising on compliance matters, developing training materials, conducting security awareness campaigns, and assisting in the development of policies and procedures.
 In this role, you will:
 - Provide security representation to business and technology solution projects in support of the security consultancy services to ensure secure outcomes.
- Monitor and analyze security alerts to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities.
- Work with subject matter experts to assist in the implementation and maintenance of security policies and procedures.
- Conduct regular security assessments and audits to ensure compliance  and support incident response activities, including investigation and remediation of security incidents.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance security awareness and training programs.
- Produce security risk management KPIs and metrics to drive risk reduction and excellence.
- Acquire threat intelligence and technical indicators from internal and external sources.
- Contribute to project tasks and/or milestones, organizing your own work to meet deadlines.
- Make decisions within limited options to resolve basic problems, working under the supervisor's direction.
 Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements) 
 - Bachelor's degree and up to 2 years of relative experience
- Basic understanding of information security principles and practices.
- Familiarity with security tools and technologies such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and antivirus software.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English to convey technical information verbally and written to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies
 Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements): 
 - Experience with computer operating systems, programming and/or scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
- Experience with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.
- Knowledge of network protocols and operating systems.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
- Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.

 Purpose   
 Breakthroughs that change patients' lives ... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.   
 Digital Transformation Strategy 
 One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience. 
 Flexibility    
 We aim to create a trusting, flexible workplace culture which encourages employees to achieve work life harmony, attracts talent and enables everyone to be their best working self. Let’s start the conversation!

Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees. 
 Disability Inclusion

We encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments to support your application and future career. Your journey with Pfizer starts here!

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people! Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. 
 As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world! We are growing and looking for a Project Technical Delivery Manager with experience in project delivery in datacenter environments. In this role, the delivery manager will manage the project through the complete project lifecycle from Initiation to Close. This includes ensuring that the project is delivered on time, meets business & technical requirements and is within the agreed budget. 
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Establish and maintain effective working relationships with all stakeholders 
- Understand the high and low level technical architecture and be able to facilitate debate and drive decisions on appropriate solutions 
- Ensure that company requirements are produced to standard in a timely manner. 
- Develop & present comprehensive technical solutions to customers 
- Communicate and hold conference calls with internal teams, customers, and partners 
- Manage complex installations, Report and escalate all observed problems to proper operational escalation points 
- Manage the communication of project’s changes and release notices to customers 
- Document technical and operational procedures clearly and concisely 
- Be willing to work irregular hours as required 
 What we need to see: 
 - BS/MS Engineering or Computer Science (or equivalent experience) 
- 5+ years of experience in project delivery management  
- Minimum 5 years of experience in providing field services and/or customer support for hardware & software  products 
- In-depth knowledge of data center environments, servers, and network equipment. 
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work directly with customers 
- Supreme leadership skills across broad and diverse functional teams 
- Excellent communication and presentation/oral skills 
- Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize/multi-task easily with limited supervision   
- Experience leading global projects. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - PMP Certification 
- HPC Clustering or Data-Center technologies 
 NVIDIA is at the forefront of breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our teams are composed of driven, innovative professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We offer highly competitive salaries, an extensive benefits package, and a work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a supportive and empowering workplace for all

 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Job Description 
 We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Guided by our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in innovative ways. We empower you to excel in your career, explore new opportunities, and contribute to positive change. If you believe in business as a platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you’ve come to the right place. 
 Your Mission as an Account Executive: 
 - Manage a dedicated territory in the Growth Business (51-300 employees) space, overseeing the entire sales cycle. You’ll coordinate multiple sales projects simultaneously and take full responsibility for your customers. 
- Lead the sales process to ensure delivery against key performance metrics, with a strong focus on new business sales, while rapidly growing existing accounts. 
- Use your solution selling expertise to respond effectively to customer needs and identify business potential, building strategic, long-term partnerships. 
- Strengthen client relationships through regular engagement and face-to-face meetings. 
- Coordinate and lead industry events and user groups to generate market interest. 
- Collaborate with our team of Core AEs, Sales Specialists, Business Developers, Pre-sales, and Marketers for all sales leads and opportunities. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 - Close opportunities at assigned existing accounts and drive sales at new accounts. 
- Drive sales within the assigned segment (SMB segments). 
- Acquire new logos within the assigned territory. 
- Speak to Salesforce offerings as they relate to customer needs and engage other Salesforce resources as required. 
- Effectively manage multiple accounts and sales, with support from our team to ensure a balanced workload. 
 What We Are Looking For: 
 - Proven track record of success in sales. 
- 3 to 5 years of experience in the entire sales cycle of complex SAAS solutions. 
- Ability to build positive relationships internally and with customers, demonstrating credibility and trust. 
- Effective communication skills with the ability to build influential relationships and deliver results in a cross-functional environment. 
- Successful history of net new business sales, with the ability to consistently deliver against targets. 
- A strong drive, adaptability, and enthusiasm to build a career at Salesforce. 
- Advanced level of English. 
 ​ What We Offer: 
 - Competitive benefits 
- Employee Stock Purchase Program 
- Wellness and Education Reimbursement 
- Unlimited PTO 
- Inclusive Parental Leave 
- And more to support your well-being and growth! 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Role Description 
 The Country Brand Manager, Adult Vaccines, supports the Marketing Lead and Country Brand Lead in executing local Adult Vaccines initiatives. The role is responsible for coordinating tactical plans, customer engagement activities, omnichannel programs, field-force enablement, budget tracking, and approved material deployment in line with the overall brand direction.
 Ensures that all activities are conducted in accordance with company policies and SOPs, Pfizer values, and global guidelines (including MAPP, FCPA), as appropriate.
 This is an execution-focused role. The incumbent will contribute insights and implementation feedback but will not be primarily accountable for overall brand strategy, brand plan ownership, or long-range portfolio direction.
 Key Responsibilities 
 The role supports the delivery of agreed Adult Vaccines priorities through strong planning discipline, stakeholder coordination, and timely execution of local initiatives.
 - Support translation of brand direction into local tactical plans, execution timelines, and implementation trackers.
 - Coordinate approved HCP, patient, customer engagement, omnichannel, and educational initiatives.
 - Support development, review, approval routing, and deployment of promotional materials, training resources, FAQs, and field tools.
 - Track A&P budget, purchase orders, activity spend, KPIs, and agreed performance indicators.
 - Prepare activity updates, execution summaries, and follow-up actions for review with the Marketing Lead and Country Brand Lead.
 - Coordinate with field teams, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, Supply, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure execution readiness.
 - Support field-force enablement through training coordination, material deployment, field feedback consolidation, and implementation support.
 - Ensure all activities are executed in accordance with company policies, SOPs, Pfizer values, and applicable compliance requirements.
 - Perform other duties as assigned by the hiring manager.
 - undefined
 Key Accountabilities/Deliverables 
 Accountable 
 - Timely execution of approved local Adult Vaccines initiatives.
 - Accurate activity workplans, timelines, trackers, and implementation updates.
 - Effective coordination of promotional, educational, omnichannel, and field-force enablement activities.
 - Proper tracking of A&P budget, spend, purchase orders, KPIs, and activity performance.
 - On-time preparation and deployment of approved materials, messages, FAQs, and training tools.
 - Clear monthly updates on activities, risks, opportunities, and follow-up actions.
 - Strong collaboration with internal stakeholders to support execution excellence and compliance.
 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 
 Qualifications: 
 - Minimum 5 years of pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience, preferably with at least 3 years in marketing, commercial execution, or related roles.
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent required.
- Experience in marketing execution, customer engagement, project coordination, or field-force support within the healthcare industry.
 - Strong execution mindset with good attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to work across matrix teams.
 TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS 
 - Marketing execution and tactical planning
 - Project coordination and operational excellence
 - Stakeholder coordination across commercial and cross-functional teams
 - Budget, KPI, and activity tracking
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills
 - Good presentation skills and computer literacy
 - Agile, collaborative, and proactive team player

Job Description: Senior Product Security Engineer
 The Opportunity
 Are you passionate about product security testing and vulnerability management? Adobe Product and Software Security is seeking a dynamic candidate with strong security testing expertise to join our expanding team. In this role, you will be the frontline responder for external vulnerability reports submitted through the Bug Bounty program, working closely with internal engineering and security teams to ensure timely, accurate triage and resolution, managing automation workflows, supporting live hacking events, campaigns, challenges.
 This is a great opportunity to contribute to innovative work that will elevate Adobe Security to new heights!
 What You'll Do
 - Triage, validate and reproduce incoming vulnerability reports submitted via the bug bounty platform, assessing validity, impact, and scope, including AI related reports.
- Assign CVSS scores and severity ratings accurately, following Adobe’s internal severity guidelines and industry standards.
- Reproduce proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to validate reported vulnerabilities across web, API, and mobile surfaces.
- Communicate clearly and professionally with external researchers: request clarifications, provide status updates, and manage expectations.
- Coordinate with product engineering teams to route confirmed vulnerabilities for remediation.
- Identify duplicate, out-of-scope, or informational reports and close them with clear, respectful explanations.
- Contribute to internal documentation, triage runbooks, and severity calibration guidelines.
- Flag systemic or critical findings to Bug Bounty team for partner concern as needed.
- Develop dashboards in PowerBI to support data-driven analysis and remediation efforts.
 What You Need to Succeed
 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of practical experience.
- In-depth knowledge of application security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) and mitigation techniques.
- Strong understanding of CVSS v3.1 scoring and hands-on experience applying it to real-world vulnerabilities.
- Proficiency in common web vulnerability classes: XSS, SQL injection, SSRF, IDOR, authentication flaws, and business logic issues.
- Ability to reproduce and validate PoC exploits using tools such as Burp Suite, browser DevTools, curl, and custom scripts.
- Familiarity with bug bounty platforms and responsible disclosure processes.
- Solid written communication skills — able to write clear, constructive responses to researchers of all skill levels.
- Familiarity with attacker techniques used by external researchers against LLM systems and generative AI products.
- Proficiency with JIRA and PowerBI.
- Strong knowledge of LLM (Large Language Model) testing methodologies.
- Hands-on experience in penetration testing of AI/ML and LLM-powered products, including chat interfaces, agentic workflows, and inference APIs.
- Ability to design and complete AI-specific test cases.
- Experience with attacker techniques used by external researchers against LLM systems and generative AI products.
 - Experience with a SOAR/orchestration platform (building or extending app connectors and playbooks, understanding action-based automation models)
 - API integration literacy (can read a vendor's REST API docs or an OpenAPI/Swagger spec and correctly implement authentication (OAuth2, bearer tokens, API keys), pagination, and error handling)
 - Scripting proficiency in Python (comfortable writing and maintaining small, production-quality integration code)
 - Event-driven automation (hands-on experience with webhooks, AWS Lambda, and API Gateway, turning real-time platform events into automated downstream actions)
 - Dependability: Demonstrates commitment, works independently, accepts accountability, adapts to change, sets personal standards, and remains focused under pressure.
- Ability to communicate professionally and effectively.
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 As a Yield Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and addressing yield limiters throughout the lifecycle of advanced technology nodes. On a daily basis, you will analyze large-scale manufacturing data, perform statistical modeling, and drive process improvements to enhance yield performance. Your work will directly contribute to the successful ramp-up and manufacturability of innovative semiconductor technologies, ensuring product quality and driving Intel's technological leadership.
 Business group 
 The Yield Development Engineer role resides within Intel Corporation's Yield Organization, which focuses on optimizing manufacturing processes and improving technology node yields. This group leverages advanced data analytics and engineering expertise across multiple disciplines to deliver high-quality, reliable products while supporting Intel's broader goals of innovation and market leadership.
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Analyze manufacturing and experimental data to identify yield limiters and recommend process changes for yield improvement.
- Develop statistical models and visualizations to construct accurate process development roadmaps.
- Consolidate and analyze diverse big data sources using coding techniques, machine learning, and statistical methods to drive actionable insights.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to debug yield limiters in design, test, and process development areas.
- Perform fault isolation and failure analysis using tools such as ATE testing, DFx software, optical probing, logic simulation, and layout studies.
- Develop tools and methodologies for high-volume data analysis and yield improvement actions.
- Participate in design of experiments to support new product introduction and manufacturing ramp readiness.
- Create measurement recipes to enhance product quality and resolve yield-impacting issues.
 Behavioral traits 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills to lead cross-functional teams and drive yield improvements.
- Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership and ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments.
 Qualifications: 
 You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.  This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 - Bachelor's degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Chemistry/Physics with 6+ years of experience; OR Master's degree with 4+ years of experience; OR PhD with 2+ years of experience.
 - Experience mentioned above should be a combination of the following areas: - Expertise in engineering analysis tools, data analysis, and scripting methods for automation of standard analytical tasks.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JMP for big data analysis, with the ability to create dashboards to democratize datasets.
- Understanding of logic or substrate process flows critical for yield analysis
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 - Experience in integration, yield analysis, LYA, failure analysis, test, defect metrology, or QNR.
- Demonstrated ability to connect analysis results to process fundamentals and systematically solve yield challenges.
- Familiarity with wafer-level or package assembly processes and associated yield considerations.
 Join us in shaping the future of semiconductor technology. Your contributions will drive innovation, enhance manufacturability, and ensure product excellence at Intel.

Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Director, Data Analytics 
Overview:
The Global Business Solutions Center (GBSC) Operational Excellence & Enablement organization advances enterprise performance by combining data, technology, analytics, and operational expertise. The team partners across GBSC and its stakeholders to establish trusted data foundations, develop forward-looking insights, and create scalable reporting capabilities that improve decision-making, operational visibility, and business outcomes.

description:
The Opportunity 
 Ready to build the media planning playbook for one of the world's most recognized brands? Adobe is establishing a new in-house media planning function to take direct ownership of end-to-end media buying and develop an AI-driven engine for global advertising execution. As Senior Media Planner, this role will translate regional media strategy into tactical media plans for one or more paid channels — starting with Meta, TikTok, and Snap — converting strategy into plans the buy desk can implement directly. It's an early opportunity to help shape how Adobe plans and buys media for years to come! 
 What the Role Does 
 This role sits between the media strategy teams and the buy desk, making sure every plan is platform-native and ready to execute! The Senior Media Planner builds tactical plans for assigned channels — audience targeting, budget splits, flighting, and placement — based on regional media strategy, and stays in daily contact with the local strategy team to maintain alignment. Keeping pace with platforms that change their ad products and targeting tools every quarter takes staying current and applying that knowledge consistently across every plan. 
 Finished plans get handed to Adobe's India-based media-buying team for execution. This role flags blockers and resolves them against the team's established process. Where it fits, Adobe's own marketing technology — GenPem, AEP, RTCDP — gets built into the plan, putting Adobe's platforms to work on its own advertising. Before anything moves to the buy desk, campaigns are tagged, organized, and quality-checked against Ops standards, with local nuance (language, regulatory, pricing) layered on top of consistent global planning practices. 
 This role will also partner with regional strategists and analysts to review campaign reporting and translate results into optimizations: budget shifts, targeting changes, and creative refreshes for their channel(s). Performance trends, platform changes, and new targeting or data-sharing opportunities get surfaced back to the Director of Media Planning and the broader team. The role also helps shape a consistent quarterly planning process and works directly with platform partners to identify testing and beta opportunities each cycle. 
 Scope & Reporting 
 This is an individual contributor role, one of a global team of seven Media Planners reporting to the US-based Director of Media Planning. The role works closely with, but does not manage, the India-based buy desk, analytics, media strategy, and engineering partners. Initial focus is paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap), with scope expected to grow over time. 
 First 90 Days 
 During the first quarter, the goal is to ramp fast and build trust. Become proficient in Adobe's audience segments, brand guidelines, and channel mix, and work on building relationships with regional strategists regarding media objectives and planning cadence. Complete the buy desk handoff process for at least one full plan submission. You will audit current tagging, naming, and QC practices against new Ops standards. You will establish a regular cadence with regional strategy counterparts and the India-based buying team. 
 What's Needed to Succeed 
 - 5+ years in digital advertising or media planning/buying, with hands-on experience in at least one of Meta, TikTok, or Snap 
- Strong working knowledge of platform ad managers, audience targeting tools, and campaign measurement 
- Experience managing multi-market activations, including platform setup across a wide range of markets and languages 
- A track record of delivering performance-focused paid social campaigns 
- Comfort reading campaign dashboards and working with analysts to shape concrete optimization recommendations 
- Ability to translate strategic briefs into detailed, executable media plans 
- Clear communication across regional and offshore teams, holding to global standards while adapting to local needs 
- Strong attention to detail — comfortable owning QA, QC, and documentation for assigned plans 
- Native-level Japanese and business-level English proficiency
 Nice-to-Haves 
 - Familiarity with AI-driven media buying, including executing buys through LLM-based tools like Meta's MCP 
- Experience with Adobe's marketing and advertising tools (GenPem, AEP, RTCDP) 
- Experience working with an offshore or outsourced buying/execution team 
- Background spanning both B2B and consumer advertising 
- Agency experience, or exposure to a newly formed team — ideally at a company insourcing media execution 
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human

You will contribute across the design lifecycle, from circuit architecture and simulation through optimization and design verification, helping deliver robust IP that meets demanding power, performance, area, timing, and yield requirements.
 You will collaborate with architecture, layout, and other engineering teams to solve complex circuit challenges and help deliver high-quality silicon solutions for Intel product
 What You’ll Do 
 Key responsibilities will include but not limited to: 
 - Design, develop, and build analog circuits in advanced CMOS process nodes.
- Create floorplans, perform circuit design, extract chip parameters, and simulate analog behavior models.
- Develop and execute test plans to verify designs against circuit and block microarchitecture specifications.
- Evaluate test results, verify functionality, and optimize circuits for power, performance, area, timing, and yield goals.
- Collaborate cross-functionally to report design progress and address performance or circuit design issues.
- Minimize leakage, optimize power consumption, and enhance the area efficiency of analog/mixed-signal blocks.
- Work closely with architecture and layout teams to ensure robust functionality and electrical capabilities.
 Behavioral traits that we are looking for: 
 - Technical Problem-Solving: Applies an analytical, data-driven approach to complex and ambiguous analog circuit-design challenges.
 - Design Ownership: Takes ownership of assigned designs, drives technical issues toward resolution, and contributes to high-impact product outcomes.
- Collaboration: Works effectively across architecture, circuit design, layout, and other cross-functional engineering teams.
- Technical Communication: Clearly communicates design decisions, trade-offs, risks, results, and recommendations to technical stakeholders.
- Attention to Detail: Applies disciplined engineering practices to circuit design, simulation, analysis, and verification.
- Learning Agility: Continuously builds knowledge of analog circuit technologies, architectures, process technologies, tools, and design methodologies.
- Innovation Mindset: Identifies opportunities to improve circuit performance, design methodologies, and engineering efficiency and applies new ideas to technical challenges.
 Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. 
 -  See  Intel Benefits  for more details. 
 Qualifications: 
 You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. 
 Note: 
 For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see 
 Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information 
 Minimum Qualifications and Experience: 
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field with 4+ years of experience in analog circuit design. OR a Master's degree in the same fields with 2+ years of experience. OR a PhD in the same field with 1+ of educational or work experience.
 Your experience describe above must be in the following:
 - Analog simulation tools and methodologies.
- Experience with circuit optimization techniques focused on power, area, timing, and yield.
- Experience with advanced process nodes and their application in analog circuit design.
 Preferred Qualifications and Experience :
 - Analog/mixed-signal IC or SoC design in advanced CMOS process technologies.
- Circuit design and optimization across multiple operating conditions and design corners.
- Low-power circuit design, leakage reduction, or power optimization.
 Why Join Intel? 
 Help engineer the circuits behind the next generation of computing. You'll tackle challenging analog and mixed-signal design problems in advanced process technologies while collaborating with experts across architecture, circuit design, and layout. Your work will directly influence the power, performance, reliability, and efficiency of future Intel products.

description:
ROLE SUMMARY 
 The Lead Automation & M aintenance Manager is responsible for site-level ownership and technical leadership of automation, electrical, and data systems supporting operations at the C hesterfield R&D site. This role applies deep subject matter expertise to design, integration, and continuously improves systems that enable reliable operations, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision-making. The position operates with a high degree of independence, leading technical initiatives, influencing stakeholders, and ensuring alignment with Global Workplace Experience standards and site business needs. This role functions as an individual contributor with significant technical responsibility, leveraging expertise and influence to deliver results without direct people management accountability.  Partners with other GWE sites (e.g., Bothell, Andover) to standardize solutions. This role operates as a senior individual contributor providing technical leadership without direct people management responsibility.
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 - Serve as the site and network subject matter for performance and reliability of automation, electrical, and data systems, including lifecycle planning and continuous improvement. 
- Design and implement system architecture, integrations, and enhancements to support evolving site and enterprise requirements. 
- Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and analytics tools to support operational and strategic decision-making. 
- Drive energy and utility optimization initiatives through metering strategy, data analysis, and system improvements. 
- Ensure compliance and inspection readiness of systems and data practices in alignment with GMP, GLP, and GCP standards. 
- Lead cross-functional project teams as technical authority for automation and data systems. 
- Provide technical direction and guidance to service providers and project teams, ensuring alignment to requirements and standards. 
- Drives alignment across engineering, operations, vendors, and leadership. 
- Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis efforts for complex system issues, driving timely and effective resolution. 
- Defines standards, strategies, and technical roadmaps. 
- Identify and lead initiatives that deliver measurable cost savings, energy reductions, or reliability improvements. 
- Translate business needs into technology strategy and investment priorities. 
- Drives digital transformation initiatives.
- Establishes data governance and analytics frameworks.
- Integrates enterprise platforms (e.g., CMMS, BMS, IoT systems).
- Ensure alignment to GWE standards and contribute to development of global engineering standards and best practices.
 ​ BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 
 Education and Experience 
 - Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 4 years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 2 years of experience; OR a PhD with 0+ years of experience; OR as associate's degree with 8 years of experience; OR a high school diploma (or equivalent) and 10 years of relevant experience.
- Experience extracting, analyzing, and presenting system data in a usable format for operational or leadership decision-making 
- Minimum of 5-8 years of progressive experience supporting electrical, automation, or facility systems in a regulated or industrial environment 
- Experience providing engineering operations support, project support, and technical input for facility or infrastructure systems 
 Technical Skills 
 - Working knowledge of power distribution, emergency generation, UPS systems, and facility support utilities 
- Experience with PLC control systems, HMI software, power monitoring tools, and smart building or IoT technologies (lighting systems and GUI operating/reporting systems) 
- Knowledge of network architecture, server communications, and troubleshooting of ethernet and fiber-connected systems 
- Ability to use test equipment and diagnostic tools to evaluate automation and electrical systems 
- Experience with computerized maintenance management systems and Microsoft Office applications 
- Ability to prepare technical reports, evaluations, cost estimates, and design documentation 
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize technical information and communicate effectively with stakeholders 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 
 - Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field or equivalent experience 
- Experience with Building Management System software and associated hardware 
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry practices, including change management procedures 
- Familiarity with project management methods, procedures, and controls 
- Experience with Pfizer systems such as KodeLabs, Johnson Controls, Enlighted and EAMS. 
- Experience influencing stakeholders without direct authority. 
- Experience supporting regulated environments (GxP highly preferred). 
 PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS 
 Due to the nature of work assignment

NVIDIA is seeking passionate, highly motivated, and creative design engineers to be part of a team working on industry-leading GPUs and SOCs. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have crafted a team of exceptional people stretching around the globe, whose mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. 
 What you’ll be doing: 
 - In this position, you'll own physical verification for the full chip — taking designs from block-level assembly through full-chip integration and tapeout on the latest process nodes like TSMC A16 and TSMC 3nm. 
- Own full-chip physical verification signoff — DRC, LVS, antenna — across block, partition, and top levels, and drive convergence to a clean tapeout database. 
- Push the frontier of 3D die stacking and heterogeneous integration — verifying die-to-die interfaces and stitching together dies built on entirely different process nodes into a single working system. 
- Be at the leading edge of Angstrom class technology, enabling signoff for breakthroughs like Super Power Rail backside power delivery and nanosheet GAA transistors. 
- Reinvent how signoff is done with AI — building ML- and LLM-powered automation for root-cause analysis, and flow optimization. 
- Partner with the methodology and CAD/technology groups to define and deploy correct-by-construction flows that catch issues early and reduce signoff iterations. 
- Cross-functional collaboration with P&R, Timing, IR, Library team to drive design closure on time. 
 What we need to see: 
 - BE/BTECH/MTECH, or equivalent, with 5+ years of experience in Physical Design Verification, full chip integration and tapeouts on the latest technology nodes. 
- Strong understanding of  Physical Implementation and VLSI design concepts. 
- Expertise in signoff tools like Calibre, ICV, EDI, FC. 
- Good understanding of the RTL2GDSII concepts related to synthesis, place & route, CTS, timing convergence, layout closure. 
- Good problem-solving skills.

The Opportunity 
 Adobe's Legal & Government Relations (LGR) group is seeking a strategic and innovative Senior Manager, Legal Operations.
 This highly visible, cross-functional leadership role is responsible for overseeing outside counsel and vendor management, legal spend and financial operations, operational intelligence, and core business operations. Partnering closely with legal leadership, Finance, Procurement, and partners across Adobe, this leader will drive operational excellence, financial stewardship, and insight-based decision making. The ideal candidate is a proven people leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, balances competing priorities with ease, challenges conventional thinking, and brings an AI-first mentality to modernizing and elevating the legal function.
 What You'll Do 
 Outside Counsel, Vendor & Financial Management 
 - Manage Adobe's external counsel and legal vendor programs, including governance, performance oversight, billing adherence, fee structures, and cost efficiency.
- Own LGR financial operations, including budgeting, forecasting, accruals, spend reporting, and financial controls.
- Partner with Finance and Procurement to improve cost efficiency, prioritization, and financial planning.
 Operational Intelligence & Business Operations 
 - Build operational metrics, dashboards, reporting, and executive insights to promote data-driven decision making.
- Provide operational and financial insights that support long-term planning and leadership decision making.
 AI, Innovation & Transformation 
 - Find opportunities to improve efficiency, decision making, and business outcomes through innovative operational practices and new technologies.
- Partner with Solutions Consulting to support transformation initiatives by providing operational context, data, governance, and value measurement.
 Guide and Grow a High-Performing Team 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team.
- Establish clear priorities, goals, and operating rhythms that drive accountability, execution, and continuous improvement.
- Build organizational capability and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and high performance.
 What You Need to Succeed 
 - Significant experience in Legal Operations, Business Operations, Finance, Consulting, or a related field.
- Proven experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
- Deep expertise managing outside counsel programs, legal spend, vendor relationships, budgeting, and forecasting.
- Strong business and financial competence with the ability to translate data into actionable executive insights.
- Proven ability to lead multiple complex initiatives simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
- Outstanding communication, collaborative and positive attitude, and influencing skills.
- Track record of driving innovation, challenging the status quo, and delivering measurable business impact.
- Passion for AI, technology, and modernizing how organizations operate.
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Manager, Legal Services 
Overview
Based in Purchase, NY, the Manager, Legal Services (M&A Integration) will be a member of the Global Legal Entities (GLE) team and serve as the governance bridge between transaction execution and ongoing legal entity ownership. This role is responsible for supporting the governance and legal entity integration aspects of acquisitions, investments, strategic partnerships, and other corporate transactions. The position will work closely with Corporate Development, Legal, Treasury, Tax, Controllers, integration teams, and regional stakeholders to ensure acquired entities are successfully transitioned into Mastercard's governance framework.
The successful candidate will help drive governance readiness throughout the deal lifecycle, beginning with due diligence activities and continuing through post-closing integration, remediation, and transition to steady-state ownership. This role requires strong organizational skills, legal entity governance experience, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and complex entity structures.
Role
• Serve as the primary governance integration lead supporting acquisitions, investments, and strategic transactions from due diligence through steady-state ownership.
• Coordinate legal entity onboarding, governance readiness activities, and post-close integration efforts to ensure acquired entities are aligned with Mastercard governance standards and operating requirements.
• Partner with Corporate Development, Legal, Treasury, Tax, Controllers and cross-functional integration teams to manage governance-related workstreams throughout the transaction lifecycle.
• Support the assessment, documentation, and remediation of governance matters identified during diligence, onboarding, and integration activities.
• Maintain accurate legal entity data, ownership records, organizational structures, and governance documentation within Mastercard systems and repositories.
• Drive integration readiness and transition planning to facilitate the successful handoff of acquired entities to ongoing legal entity ownership and business-as-usual governance processes.
• Coordinate governance support for banking, signatory, KYC, UBO, entity management, and related corporate maintenance activities arising from acquisitions and strategic initiatives.
• Develop and monitor integration plans, remediation trackers, status reporting, and governance metrics to enhance visibility, accountability, and execution.
• Identify opportunities to improve governance processes, data quality, operational efficiency, and controls through automation, technology solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.
• Support Global Legal Entities team priorities and special projects, including assigned attorney engagement activities, governance transformation initiatives, audit, regulatory and compliance-related projects, and other legal entity governance matters as needed.
All About You
Bachelor's degree, paralegal certificate, or equivalent legal entity governance experience.
Minimum 5+ years of experience in corporate governance, legal entity management, paralegal services, subsidiary management, M&A integration, or related legal operations functions required.
Strong understanding of corporate governance principles, legal entity structures, board and shareholder actions, and corporate recordkeeping.
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, integrations, restructurings, or other complex corporate transactions.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and coordinate activities across global stakeholders.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Experience working with legal entity management systems.

 Job Description: 
 Intel Corporation is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, dedicated to designing and manufacturing innovative technology that powers the devices and infrastructure shaping modern life. With a legacy of breakthrough innovation spanning decades, Intel continues to push the boundaries of what's possible — from advanced chip manufacturing to next-generation packaging technologies. At Intel, we believe in the power of human ingenuity, and we're committed to creating an inclusive, collaborative environment where the brightest minds come together to change the world.
 We are looking for a talented and driven Module Development Engineer to join Intel's Wafer Assembly Technology Development (WATD) group in Oregon. In this high-impact role, you will be at the forefront of advancing Intel's semiconductor manufacturing capabilities, driving the design, development, and optimization of complex processes and equipment. Your work will directly influence Intel's technology roadmap, manufacturing efficiency, and product quality — helping Intel maintain its leadership position in global semiconductor innovation. This is a unique opportunity to work alongside industry experts, collaborate with world-class suppliers, and contribute to technologies that will define the future of computing.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 - Lead the design and development of advanced manufacturing processes and equipment solutions for next-generation semiconductor products
- Conduct feasibility studies using theoretical simulations and practical engineering methods to meet device specifications
- Optimize process integration through material selection, equipment metrology, and parameter settings for new product designs
- Perform pathfinding activities to develop processes and hardware for innovative device architectures
- Develop and implement technology roadmaps that support future manufacturing needs
- Recommend and implement modifications to equipment and manufacturing techniques to improve efficiency, reliability, and output
- Collaborate with equipment suppliers and materials vendors to develop enabling technologies for advanced manufacturing solutions
- Design and execute experiments using statistical methodologies (DOE, SPC) to optimize process windows and control strategies
- Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and process innovations, contributing to Intel's competitive edge

- Thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment
- Approaches challenges with curiosity, creativity, and a solutions-oriented mindset
- Demonstrates strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality
- Adapts quickly to evolving priorities and ambiguous problem spaces
- Takes ownership of your work and drives initiatives through to completion
- Builds strong relationships with internal teams, vendors, and industry partners
- Leads with integrity, humility, and a passion for continuous learning
 If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of semiconductor technology and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of computing, we want to hear from you. description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Director, Specialist Sales 
1) Overview:
Across LAC, Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) represent more than 90% of businesses and are often underserved by traditional financial institutions. Unlocking growth in this segment requires identifying new routes to market and capturing payment flows through distributors, platforms, fintechs, software providers, marketplaces, and trade ecosystems that already serve SMEs at scale.
This role requires a strong commercial mindset and the ability to identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities across a diverse regional landscape. Success will depend on understanding partner business models and SME payment flows, uncovering customer needs, building compelling value propositions, and navigating complex sales cycles to translate opportunities into sustainable revenue and payment volume for Mastercard.
Given the diversity of the region, the role requires balancing market-specific opportunities with scalable commercial models that can be replicated across countries, partners, and verticals.
2) Role
Our SME team is looking for a Director, SME Sales Specialist in LAC to accelerate the origination, development, and conversion of strategic SME opportunities across the region.
The role will focus on identifying new sources of SME payment flows, developing relationships with strategic partners, and leading opportunities throughout the commercial lifecycle—from prospecting and opportunity qualification through solution development, business case creation, negotiation, and closing.
The Director will work closely with Mastercard's market teams and cross-functional partners to develop tailored commercial propositions that combine Mastercard's products, capabilities, partnerships, and services to address customer needs and unlock incremental GDV and revenue.
The ideal candidate combines an entrepreneurial mindset with strong consultative selling, commercial, and analytical capabilities. The individual should be comfortable creating opportunities from white space, engaging senior decision-makers, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and maintaining strong ownership and momentum throughout the sales process.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Origination & Pipeline Development
•Identify, originate, and prioritize high-potential SME opportunities across markets, verticals, and distribution channels.
•Build and manage a strong pipeline focused on generating incremental GDV and revenue for Mastercard.
•Develop relationships with strategic partners including fintechs, platforms, marketplaces, software providers, distributors, acquirers, and issuers.
•Identify untapped payment flows and opportunities to replace cash, checks, transfers, and other traditional payment methods.
Consultative Selling & Deal Development
•Understand partner business models, strategic priorities, economics, and customer pain points to develop tailored value propositions.
•Lead opportunities across the full sales cycle, from initial engagement and solution design through business case development, negotiation, and closing.
•Structure compelling commercial propositions that balance customer needs, Mastercard economics, and long-term growth potential.
•Lead senior customer conversations, pitches, workshops, and commercial negotiations.
Strategic Partnerships & Channel Distribution
•Identify and develop new distribution channels and partnerships that expand Mastercard's reach into SME ecosystems.
•Identify opportunities to embed Mastercard solutions into existing SME purchasing, payment, financing, and business workflows.
•Develop scalable commercial models that can be replicated across markets, partners, and verticals.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution
•Partner with regional and market Sales teams and coordinate across Product, Finance, Legal, Services, Marketing, and Operations to advance opportunities.
•Mobilize internal stakeholders, remove barriers, and maintain momentum throughout complex sales cycles.
•Ensure an effective transition of closed opportunities into implementation and activation.
Market & Commercial Strategy
•Develop a strong understanding of SME ecosystems, payment flows, competitive dynamics, and emerging business models across LAC.
•Identify priority verticals, partners, and use cases based on strategic fit and commercial potential.
•Translate market insights and deal learnings into stronger sales strategies and repeatable commercial playbooks.

 As a GPU & AI Accelerator Hardware Design Undergraduate Intern , you will work alongside experienced engineers developing next-generation GPU and AI accelerator platforms. description:
The Opportunity  
 Adobe Experience Platform powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across every channel. Behind these capabilities are engineering teams that must understand both the platform’s architecture and the regulated, complex environments where customers operate. 
 The FDE role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You will be embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA customers — working directly with their teams to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build what’s needed to unblock adoption and expansion. 
 This is not a support role. You don’t wait for tickets. You operate inside cross-functional Customer Pods — small, autonomous teams with end-to-end ownership — translating customer problems into working platform solutions. You lead with architecture, prototype rapidly, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers. 
 What You’ll Do  
 - Partner directly with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives
- Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes 
- Investigate and troubleshoot production-level platform issues — from data ingestion and identity resolution to journey orchestration and audience activation 
- Design and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and adjacent Adobe systems 
- Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that earn customer trust before any commercial motion 
- Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate on new capabilities — using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of execution 
- Bridge the gap between customer needs, product direction, and engineering implementation — feeding field patterns back into the product roadmap 
- Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts — from initial discovery through implementation, go-live, and expansion 
 What Succes Looks Like 
 We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates will show: 
 - Customer-to-Solution Thinking —  you connect customer problems, workflows, and business goals with practical technical solutions — collapsing the gap between requirement and working platform capability 
- Architecture with Execution —  you don’t just design; you prototype, validate, debug, and iterate. Your architectures work because you’ve built them, not just drawn them 
- Production Awareness —  you understand how distributed systems behave at scale — data integrity, graceful degradation, and observability are part of how you think, not afterthoughts 
- Enterprise Navigation —  you operate across complex organizational boundaries, regulatory constraints, and multi-stakeholder environments with confidence and credibility 
- AI-Augmented Execution —  you use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a standard part of how you design, prototype, and deliver 
- Adaptability Under Ambiguity —  you navigate evolving environments where experimentation, learning, and iteration are core to the process — and you don’t mistake seniority for certainty 
 Typical background: 8–15+ years across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering roles. What matters is what that experience has produced — not the title or the number of years.  
 Your Domain  
 - AEP / RTCDP / AJO : Adobe’s core platform — data ingestion, segmentation, journey orchestration, audience activation 
- Enterprise Architecture : Multi-system integration, data flows, identity resolution, API design across complex landscapes 
- Security & Compliance : Regulated industries (FSI, Healthcare), data sovereignty, privacy-preserving architectures, GDPR 
- Cloud Platforms : AWS, Azure — infrastructure patterns, managed services, networking 
- Data Platforms : Event-driven architectures, streaming pipelines, batch processing, data lakes 
- Observability : Platform health, SLO definition, performance governance, production monitoring 
 What We Value  
 Beyond technical execution, the people who grow fastest on this team demonstrate: 
 - Agency  - You identify problems before they are assigned to you and drive them to resolution 
- Product Judgment  - You understand what the platform needs to do for customers, not just what the ticket says to build 
- Customer Empathy  -You earn trust by understanding the customer’s world — their constraints, pressures, and what success looks like for them 
- Builder Mindset  - You are as comfortable prototyping a new capability as you are presenting an architecture to a CT 
 Nice to Have  :
 - Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products (AEP, AJO, RTCDP, CJA, Target) 
- Experience with sim

• Serve as the primary regional point of contact for market teams and Global Product, aligning regional requirements, roadmap priorities, dependencies, and execution plans.
• Guide customer engagements and implementations with delivery and technical teams, ensuring responsive support, clear ownership, and timely resolution of escalations. Identify process improvement opportunities and work with relevant teams to enhance the product and simplify solution enablement.

• Monitor portfolio performance through adoption, revenue, customer feedback, and business reviews, translating insights into actions and executive updates.
• Support the regional introduction of relevant enhancements and new Network Products through opportunity assessment, market prioritization, readiness, and go-to-market execution.
All About You: 
• Experience in product management, sales, technology, in the payments industry.
• Working knowledge of payment processing, including authorization, clearing, settlement, connectivity, or adjacent network capabilities, is preferred.
• Experience working across multiple Latin American and Caribbean markets, or in another complex regional environment, is preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a product portfolio across its lifecycle, including strategy, adoption, performance management, and customer engagement.
• Experience identifying cross-sell opportunities and recommending related solutions based on customer needs.

 Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 - Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 We are looking for talented Software Engineers to work on developing and deploying an AI agent that leverages machine learning models to solve complex problems in VLSI design. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, with experience in machine learning, deep learning, and software development. The successful candidate will work closely with our team of experts in VLSI design, machine learning, and software engineering to create and integrate machine learning-based solutions that enhance the efficiency, productivity, and quality of our VLSI design flows.
 What you will be doing: 
 - Create and integrate AI agents to enhance the efficiency, productivity, and quality of VLSI design flows.
- Collaborate on the design and implementation of algorithms and models that can optimize VLSI design processes.
- Contribute to the development of software tools and frameworks that support the integration of AI in VLSI design.
- Analyze and interpret data to identify patterns and insights that can inform the development of AI-driven design methodologies.
- Stay ahead of the latest advancements in machine learning, deep learning, and VLSI build to continuously improve our solutions.
 What We Need to See: 
 - BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- 6+ years of experience building AI-driven software systems, ideally applied to complex engineering workflows.
- Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing production-quality systems.
- Demonstrated experience designing and applying AI agents or learning-based decision systems (e.g., RL, planning, LLM-based agents) to optimize processes.
- Proficiency with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and data-driven model development.
- Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex design challenges into agent-driven solutions.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications in software and AI development
- Proficiency in standard methodologies for software development, including version control, testing, and CI/CD.
- Deeply interested in learning disparate concepts and putting them together in innovative new ways
 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 Are you excited to build the automation infrastructure behind next-generation silicon design? We’re seeking a Senior VLSI Methodology Engineer to join our team and to design automation that powers library modeling, quality checks, and release for NVIDIA’s PD flows. We build and integrate data‑driven pipelines and verification systems, collaborating with process and cell‑design teams to push modeling standards forward on advanced nodes!
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Build scalable systems (from validation pipelines through dashboards) for quality checking of GPU and SOC libraries
- Develop automated library analysis, validation, and quality control flows using modern scripting and EDA tools
- Collaborate with our design teams to integrate library quality systems and enhance cell design methodologies, applying adaptive threshold partitioning
- Define and implement guidelines for library modeling, abstraction, and data integrity, that drive innovation!
 What we need to see: 
 - M.S. in Electrical Engineering or related field (or equivalent experience)
- 4+ years of Library, Physical Design, and/or CAD methodology experience
- Hands-on development with industry-standard EDA tools (Innovus, Fusion Compiler, Crosscheck, Virtuoso, or similar), including scripting, customization, or tool integration
- Advanced Python, C++, or Perl skills; workflow automation and data pipelines development experience (data collection, validation, and reporting/dashboards)
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Understanding how library models are consumed in chip design flows (synthesis, place and route, timing closure, power analysis)
- 2+ years in library modeling/validation, quality systems, or physical design automation
- Experience building robust library models with system-level quality and automation, including exposure to contextual model calibration
- Applied AI/ML/LLM experience to enhance EDA tools, automation, or design methodologies
- Built or maintained quality systems with integrated dashboards tracking critical metrics such as release readiness, validation pass rates, or regression health
 We welcome you join our team with some of the most hard-working people in the world working together to promote rapid growth. Are you passionate about becoming a part of a best-in-class team supporting the latest in GPU and AI technology? If so, we want to hear from you.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 136,000 USD - 218,500 USD for Level 3, and 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD for Level 4. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
