description:
What You Will Achieve 
 The Sr. Manager, CX Research, within the CX Research department, plays a pivotal role in shaping colleague-centric product development within Pfizer Digital & Technology, reporting to the Director, CX Research. This role leads moderately complex qualitative research, experimentation, and usability studies, manages cross-functional collaborations, and translates colleague insights into actionable product recommendations. This is a hands-on role: the Sr. Manager personally designs, executes, and analyzes research and experiments without reliance on external vendors, applies behavioral and telemetry data analysis to understand how colleagues actually work, and integrates AI into research workflows to move quickly from analysis to insight to action, all while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, agile environment. 
 How You Will Achieve It 
 - Personally design, execute, and analyze qualitative and quantitative research studies end to end, including sampling, instrument design, and statistical analysis, without reliance on external vendors, to uncover pain points and workflows and to measure colleague sentiment, concerns, and readiness as AI tools are deployed across the organization.  
 - Apply behavioral science frameworks (e.g., habit loops, nudge theory, behavior change models) to frame research questions and surface insights that open new directions for product and design; identify the concerns, skills gaps, and barriers that slow adoption and recommend support and enablement tactics that build colleague confidence.  
 - Translate findings into actionable insights for product design and development, and develop a research-grounded strategic point of view that informs the change management campaigns, communication strategies, and adoption roadmaps owned by partner teams.  
 - Integrate AI into research workflows, using AI tools to accelerate study design, data collection, analysis, and synthesis while maintaining methodological rigor and quality; create frameworks to assess the success of AI prototypes and products, using GenAI tools for rapid prototype iteration, and evaluate emerging approaches such as synthetic personas and digital twins to extend, simulate, and pressure-test research.  
 - Collaborate with product managers to prioritize features based on user impact and key performance indicators (KPIs), combining behavioral research with telemetry to explain the why behind the what and defining the experience indicators (CPIs) that track it.  
 - Manage multiple research projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing priorities while ensuring strategic alignment.  
 - Mentor junior researchers and promote best practices.  
 - Advocate for customer-centric solutions within engineering teams, and build strong, strategic relationships with senior stakeholders to ensure alignment, trust, and collaboration on key business priorities.  
 - Set the standard for ethical and responsible AI use in research practice; stay current on emerging methods, LLM advancements, and tools and bring them into the team's ways of working.  
 Here Is What You Need (Basic Requirements) 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Psychology, Market Research, or a related field; background in a quantitative or statistical discipline.  
 - 7+ years with a Bachelor's or 5+ years with a Master's in CX, user experience (UX), or product research, including hands-on execution and delivery of studies.  
 - Proficiency in qualitative research, experimentation, and usability methods, with a strong applied statistics foundation including experimental design, power analysis, and significance testing applied to behavioral and telemetry data.  
 - Hands-on researcher able to independently plan, field, and analyze qualitative studies, usability tests, and experiments without reliance on external vendors, using tools such as Python or R for behavioral and telemetry analysis, usability-testing platforms (e.g., UserZoom), and survey, statistical, or experience management software (e.g., Qualtrics, SPSS, Medallia) as needed.  
 - Experience integrating AI into research workflows, using AI-driven research and analytics tools, including emerging methods such as synthetic personas and digital twins, to accelerate the path from analysis to insight to action and improve the speed, scale, and quality of insights.  
 - Ability to identify the key areas and questions for research to pursue, toggling between hands-on execution and shaping strategy with product leaders; experience building and articulating research-driven strategies and roadmaps from early opportunity framing through execution and measurement.  
 - Comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities and delivering in a fast-paced, agile product development environment.  
 - Ability to synthesize complex qualitative and behavioral data into compelling narratives, supported by clear data visualization.  
 Bonus Points I

 Adobe seeks a Senior Financial Analyst to provide Financial and Business Partner support to Creativity & Productivity Non Enterprise Business segment. description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Senior Specialist, Open Banking Mortgage Solutions 
Overview
Our Open Finance business enables consumers to securely share and use their financial data while helping lenders make faster, more accurate decisions with less friction. We work with mortgage lenders, technology providers, loan origination platforms, and ecosystem partners to modernize the mortgage journey through verified data and digital experiences.
As mortgage lending evolves toward a more connected, API-driven ecosystem, Mastercard is helping lenders replace manual verification processes with trusted consumer-permissioned data that supports faster approvals, improved compliance, and better borrower experiences.
The Mortgage Solutions Product Analyst will play a critical role in supporting Mastercard's Open Finance and mortgage verification products used across the mortgage origination ecosystem. This role is for someone who combines mortgage industry expertise, business analysis, systems analysis, and product execution capabilities. They will serve as a bridge between customers, industry platforms, product teams, engineering teams, and implementation partners to ensure Mastercard solutions continue to meet evolving market needs.
Familiarity with mortgage origination workflows, mortgage technology platforms, and lender operational processes will be important. The Product Analyst will monitor industry and platform changes, support client-facing product enhancements, assist with technical remediation efforts, and help shape future innovations that expand the use of verified consumer data in mortgage lending.
Roles & Responsibilities
Mortgage Industry & Market Expertise
• Maintain deep knowledge of mortgage origination, underwriting, verification, fulfillment processes, and the technology ecosystem supporting them.
• Monitor mortgage technology providers, loan origination systems (LOS), point-of-sale (POS) platforms, GSE initiatives, industry standards, and emerging market trends to identify risks, impacts, and growth opportunities.
• Analyze how lenders leverage income, asset, employment, identity, and other verification solutions throughout the mortgage lifecycle, translating industry developments into actionable product recommendations.
Product Development & Delivery
• Gather, analyze, and document business, customer, regulatory, and platform requirements, translating them into product enhancements and technical specifications.
• Partner with Product Managers to define and maintain business requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, process maps, integration documentation, release plans, and product roadmaps.
• Support agile product development activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, user acceptance testing, release validation, and implementation of readiness.
• Conduct business process analysis and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, automation, and customer outcomes.
Customer Support & Technical Analysis
• Act as a liaison between business, technical, and operational stakeholders (Engineering, Client Success, Sales and Legal Compliance) to support successful product delivery and adoption. 
• Investigate and resolve complex customer issues through troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, remediation planning, testing, and validation activities.
• Support mortgage customers through product enhancements, platform changes, integrations, and operational transitions, ensuring a high-quality client experience.
Innovation & Strategic Growth
• Evaluate emerging mortgage technologies, lender workflows, competitive solutions, and verification use cases to inform product strategy and roadmap priorities.
• Identify innovative opportunities to leverage consumer-permissioned financial data to improve borrower experiences, underwriting accuracy, operational efficiency, and lending outcomes.
• Contribute market intelligence, customer insights, go-to-market readiness activities, training materials, operational documentation, and client communications that support successful product adoption and growth.
All About You
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance or equivalent experience in field.
• Professional experience in: Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Product Analysis, Product Operations, Mortgage Technology and/or Mortgage Lending Operations.
• Experience working with mortgage lenders, mortgage technology providers, fintechs, or financial institutions

description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new challenges that are hard to tackle, that only we can pursue, and that matter to the world. Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact
As a Manufacturing Engineering Equipment Manager, you will lead a team of engineer/technicians responsible for overseeing operations, equipment maintenance, and repair within Intel's manufacturing facilities. You also need to equip the skills to hand on by your own for machine repairing as equipment engineer. You'll play a pivotal role in driving safety, quality, and efficiency across production, ensuring the team meets critical goals and delivers results. Your contributions will directly impact factory performance and operational success, enabling Intel to maintain its leadership in innovative manufacturing excellence.
Business group
This position is part of Intel's Manufacturing and Operations division, engineering department which focuses on delivering world-class manufacturing capabilities to support Intel's cutting-edge technology. The team is essential to Intel's growth, ensuring quality, efficiency, and scalability in production processes while fostering a culture of collaboration and excellence.
Key Responsibilities
 - Able to repair and sustain machine as an equipment engineer
- Own, sustain, troubleshoot, repair, and optimize Assembly manufacturing equipment to achieve equipment uptime, yield, quality, and productivity targets while supporting production ramps and tool qualifications.
- Drive equipment reliability and process improvements through root cause analysis, preventive maintenance, failure analysis, SPC, FMEA, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Lead/coach and manage a team of technicians responsible for manufacturing operations, equipment maintenance, and repair.
- Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining stringent safety and quality standards.
- Oversee equipment performance, troubleshooting, and repair to sustain operational efficiency.
- Establish and implement training and certification plans to equip the team with the necessary skills for production ramp requirements.
- Supervise shift schedules, including workstation assignments, rotations, and PTO management, to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
- Act as the first responder to resolve operational, safety, and security issues within assigned toolsets or areas.
- Develop and execute tactical plans to streamline workflows and improve coordination between groups and divisions.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to address factory health challenges and operational issues.
- Drive team results through effective goal setting, performance management, and leadership development.
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications
 - Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 3 years of experience in manufacturing operations or equipment management OR Master's degree in a relevant field with 2+ years of experience
- Minimum 3 years of equipment maintenance/repairing experience.
- Proficiency in equipment monitoring, scheduling, and maintenance practices.
- Experience in manufacturing quality assurance processes and practices.
- Knowledge of good manufacturing practices and operational safety standards.
- Demonstrated ability to develop training plans and manage team certifications.
Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience leading and developing diverse teams in a manufacturing environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
- Familiarity with excursion management and process optimization strategies.
- Proven ability to inspire and drive results through effective leadership and goal-setting.
- Strong equipment knowledge at assembly operation will be added advantage
 Join us in shaping the future of manufacturing excellence at Intel while building a team that drives innovation and operational success.

Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Legal Compliance Analyst 
Overview
Leveraging Mastercard's global payments network, our account-to-account business provides domestic and cross-border solutions to enable the frictionless future of payments. We help our customers capture business and consumer payment flows through rich messaging functionality, connect and safeguard the Open Banking ecosystem, and protect banks and their customers from financial crime.
Open Banking sits within Mastercard's Services team, one of the fastest growing areas of our business, which fuels growth by going beyond the core payments network to deliver solutions in Customer Acquisition and Engagement, Security Solutions, Business and Market Insights, and Open Banking. Together, these offerings help our customers unlock new revenue, deepen consumer relationships, and navigate an increasingly complex digital economy. 
The Legal Compliance Analys for Open Banking will support our Open Finance business across the Americas. As open banking continue to emerge globally, we need a compliance professional who can read and analyze new laws, translate them into risk assessments, and identify the controls needed to operate in this evolving space.
Role
• Know-Your-Customer (KYC) Operations: Perform customer due diligence for Open Finance customers, resellers, and distributors, including Customer Identification Program, Customer Due Diligence, and Enhanced Due Diligence reviews, and document risk ratings and decisions
• KYC Refresh: Execute periodic refresh and trigger event reviews, including collection of updated documentation, and backlog management to meet service level agreements
• Consumer Compliance Operations: Process Consumer Compliance operational queues daily, including consumer manual identity verification requests, privacy requests, and disputes, from intake through documentation review, resolution, and consumer notification
• Automation: Identify opportunities to standardize and automate manual operations steps, using automation and AI 
• Reporting: Track and report Key Performance Indicators and Key Risk Indicators, including volumes, aging, and backlog, for monthly and senior management reporting
• Pipeline Review: Review the bi-weekly sales opportunity pipeline with sales representatives to confirm deal status and identify higher risk customers ahead of onboarding, and record outcomes in the team tracker
• Projects: Participate in cross-functional projects and perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support business and compliance objectives.
All About You
• Previous experience in compliance operations, KYC or customer due diligence, or consumer operations within banking, payments, or financial services
• Hands-on experience managing a case queue end to end, including intake, research, documentation, resolution, and closure, while meeting service level agreements
• Ability to work cases independently with limited supervision, applying written procedures consistently and knowing when to escalate
• Working knowledge of KYC and Anti-Money Laundering requirements, including Customer Identification Program, Customer Due Diligence, and Enhanced Due Diligence
• Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and fluctuating volumes
• Ability to produce accurate, well-documented case files and clear reporting on volumes, aging, and backlog
• Experience with case management, workflow, or CRM systems (for example Fenergo, Salesforce, or similar)
• Experience building automation or AI agents to streamline manual operational work is a plus
• Knowledge of Open Banking or Open Finance products is a plus 
• Compliance certification such as CAMS or ICA is a plus

 - Bridge the gap between architecture, RTL implementation, and physical design.

- Propose and drive improvements related to high-frequency design and power methodology for our custom CPU cores.
 What we need to see:

- 15 or more years of relevant experience.
- Extensive background in CPU architecture and high-frequency server CPU design.
- Solid understanding of power dissipation, delivery, and efficiency concepts.
- Detailed understanding of process technologies and circuit design.

 Ways to stand out from the crowd:

 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact:
As a Memory Electrical Validation Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and validating electrical performance for memory IO interfaces. You'll focus on ensuring compliance with industry standards, analyzing margins for stable operation, debugging electrical issues, and driving system-level improvements. Your expertise will directly contribute to delivering high-quality, reliable products that meet production goals while advancing Intel's innovative memory solutions. 
Business group 
The Silicon and Platform Engineering (SPE) Group leads Intel's efforts in designing, developing, and validating advanced silicon and platform technologies. This team is committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that drive Intel's leadership in the semiconductor industry. By joining SPE, you'll be part of a collaborative environment that tackles challenging problems and powers Intel's success in creating transformative technologies for the future. 
Key Responsibilities 
- Define electrical validation strategies for memory IO interfaces to ensure optimized electrical performance and alignment with production goals. 
- Validate circuit analog performance, signal integrity compliance, and system-level margins against industry standards. 
- Analyze, debug, and optimize Memory Reference Code (MRC) requirements to improve margins and overall product quality. 
- Collaborate on multidisciplinary research for testing, validation, and optimization of memory IO and mixed-signal architectures. 
- Develop procedures and designs for validation processes, systems margin evaluation, and test infrastructure. 
- Debug functional and triage failures to identify root causes and resolve electrical issues. 
- Test electrical interactions between design features using advanced validation infrastructure. 
- Prepare validation specifications, evaluate intellectual property (IP), and generate detailed test reports. 
- Partner with architecture, design, and presilicon verification teams to ensure effective Design for Testability (DFT) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) capabilities for IO architectures.
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications:
- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
- 3+ years of hands-on industry experience in electrical validation or debugging
- Proficiency in validating signal integrity and electrical performance of memory IO interfaces. 
- Experience with debugging electrical and system-level issues. 
- Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and optimize validation procedures and test infrastructure. 
- Familiarity with compliance testing against industry-standard specifications. 
Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with memory validation tools, techniques, and methodologies. 
- Strong collaborative skills, particularly in multidisciplinary research and cross-functional teamwork. 
- Proven ability to develop and refine validation strategies for complex architectures. 
- Passion for delivering innovative solutions and driving continuous improvement. 
We're looking for someone eager to make a meaningful impact while solving complex challenges in memory validation. If you're ready to join a team that values collaboration, innovation, and excellence, we encourage you to apply today.

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Manager, B2B Marketing Operations - Partner Marketing Platforms 
Mastercard powers economies and connects people in over 200 countries and territories, helping build a more inclusive and sustainable future. We make digital payments secure, seamless, and accessible, leveraging technology, innovation, and partnerships to create products and services that unlock potential for businesses, governments, and individuals alike. Our Decency Quotient (DQ) is at the heart of everything we do—driving a culture that values doing well by doing good.
The Services Marketing Operations team is the core enabler for the entire Services Marketing team. Our focus? Driving a scalable marketing campaign engine, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. As our partner ecosystem grows, we are looking for a strategic and technically minded Manager, B2B Marketing Operations - Partner Marketing Platforms to join our global team. This role will define how technology, data, and processes work together to support indirect customer engagement through partners with communication programs, co-marketing campaigns, co-branded events, and partnership summits.
The ideal candidate understands B2B marketing, partner-led growth, and marketing technology. They can turn business needs into clear technical requirements and scalable solutions. They enjoy working across teams to connect platforms, simplify processes, and improve how partner marketing programs are delivered and measured.
Role Overview
The Manager, B2B Marketing Operations - Partner Marketing Platforms will own the technology roadmap for partner marketing and design the connected MarTech ecosystem that supports Mastercard’s growth engine through our partner ecosystem. 
This role will connect partner relationship management, CRM, marketing automation, event platforms, campaign workflows, data, AI agentic workflows and reporting. The Manager will define platform requirements, integrations, data standards, and delivery priorities that allow Partner Marketing teams to operate at scale.
Reporting to the Director of Marketing Operations within the Services Marketing Operations and Digital team, this role will help build a consistent and scalable foundation for Services B2B partner-led marketing.
The Role:
PARTNER MARKETING TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY AND ROADMAP
• Own and maintain the partner marketing technology roadmap, aligning platform investments and technical priorities with the broader partner marketing strategy and enterprise MarTech direction.
• Develop a target-state architecture connecting partner relationship management, marketing automation, CRM, event management, co-marketing workflows, content systems, data platforms, and reporting capabilities.
• Translate business requirements from Partner Marketing and regional marketing teams into scalable technical capabilities, system requirements, integration needs, and prioritized use cases.
• Collaborate with technology teams to evaluate platform capabilities against business needs, architecture standards, cost, security, integration requirements, and support needs.
• Establish measurable success criteria for roadmap initiatives, including adoption, operational efficiency, data quality, campaign scalability, and visibility into partner engagement.
CAMPAIGN, EVENTS AND CO-MARKETING ENABLEMENT
• Design scalable frameworks for partner campaigns, including partner recruitment, co-marketing campaigns, communication programs, events, partnership summits, and ongoing partner engagement.
• Define the technology and data framework for partner co-branded events and partner summits, including registration, consent, data-sharing, lead routing, engagement tracking, and reporting.
• Create reusable campaign workflows, templates, approvals, compliance controls, and payment processes that improve speed and consistency for event and co-marketing campaigns.
CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP
• Serve as the main Marketing Operations partner for Partner Marketing. Lead initiatives from discovery and design through testing, launch, adoption, and improvement while communicating priorities, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
• Build alignment across Channel Sales, Field Marketing, Privacy, Technology, I&E Sales Operations, Reporting, and Operations to define standards for partner identification, segmentation, data quality, lifecycle management, system ownership, and operational support.
• Develop rollout plans, communications, training, and d

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 At NVIDIA, we’re transforming the way the world interacts with technology. Our CPUs are at the heart of groundbreaking innovations across AI, gaming, and autonomous vehicles. Join our CPU Performance Architecture team in Santa Clara, CA, and be part of a company that is pushing boundaries and making an outstanding impact globally. - Advocating for microarchitectural ideas, communicating their benefits and drawbacks in various mediums.
- Driving the microarchitecture segment with enthusiasm and energy, leading by example.
 What we need to see:

- Experience in performance modeling, debugging, and demonstrating the merit of innovative ideas.
- Close collaboration skills with build and verification teams to successfully implement microarchitectural improvements.
- At least 16+ years of experience in a frontline role within brand new CPU projects.
- Strong critical thinking, communication, and advocacy abilities.
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience leading microarchitecture segments and driving initiatives.
- History of collaboration with architects and microarchitects to achieve ambitious targets.
- Demonstrated ability to think critically and advocate for complex ideas successfully.
- Enthusiasm for driving innovation and leading by doing.

ROLE SUMMARY 
 Since PAXLOVID’s emergency use authorization on 12/22/21, PAXLOVID has helped treat over 25M patients at high-risk from progression to severe COVID-19, which can lead to hospitalization and/or death. PAXLOVID is well-positioned to remain the gold standard in COVID-19 treatment, however the COVID-19 treatment landscape is a rapidly evolving space with significant complexity. Opportunity to increase treatment rates for eligible patients and bolster PAXLOVID’s leadership position in the marketplace continues. New burden of disease studies and real-world evidence is anticipated throughout 2026 and beyond to help continue to support the treatment value proposition.
 The Senior Director, HCP Team Lead, US Antiviral will report directly to the VP of US Antiviral and will be responsible for leading the development and execution of marketing strategies for U.S. HCPs in a complex and evolving market 
 The role will require the ability to work collaboratively with the U.S. Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) organization, the CMO, and other agency and cross-functional teams. They will need to translate insights into action and identify business accelerators and innovative strategies to overcome market challenges and drive business. The ideal candidate will have high learning agility and demonstrated prior success in leading key marketing and strategic initiatives and demonstrate the ability to learn and adapt strategies and tactical execution quickly given how dynamic the marketplace is. 
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Lead a team of experienced marketers and drive treatment of appropriate patients through strong leadership in the following areas:

 ·       Support the development and implementation of annual tactical plans that drive the short- and long-term HCP strategy, based on key customer insights

 ·       Ensures marketing materials are compelling and appropriate across all appropriate channels.

 ·       Lead the U.S. POA meetings and other Sales Force meetings including planning, execution and follow-up engagement

 ·       Collaborate and align with marketing team counterparts and cross-functional team members to ensure the plans work in synergy to deliver business objectives
 ·       Conduct all responsibilities in accordance with Company policies, with a strong adherence to our Values including compliance
 ·       Exhibit a high performance, values driven approach to develop strategies, identify opportunities, and manage key issues to achieve commercial objectives

 - Develop full-system functional models capable of running complex multi-threaded heterogeneous (CPU/GPU) workloads – with special focus on the CPU subsystem.

 - Experience working with hardware emulators and/or FPGAs

Join Pfizer International Commercial Division, Business Transformation organization to leverage cutting-edge technology for critical business decisions and enhance customer experiences for colleagues, patients, and physicians. Our team of data engineering, data science, and AI professionals is at the forefront of Pfizer’s transformation into a digitally driven organization, using data science and AI to change patients’ lives, leading process and engineering innovations to advance AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production. 
 As the AI Data Architect you will be the senior individual-contributor authority for AI-ready data across International Commercial. You will define what "AI ready" means in practice: designing the data models, semantic layers and readiness standards that allow analytical and agentic AI solutions to consume commercial data reliably, safely and at scale. 
 This role owns the architecture and modelling backbone of the AI data product portfolio: dimensional and semantic model design, AI readiness assessment frameworks, and data product blueprints, from source analysis through to certified, AI-consumable data assets. 
 This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.  1) AI Data Readiness 
 ·       Own and evolve the AI readiness framework and criteria used to assess, certify and prioritise datasets for AI consumption across international markets

 ·       Extend AI readiness beyond structured data: define architectures and enrichment strategies (parsing, chunking, metadata, embeddings) that make unstructured content such as documents, transcripts and field notes AI-consumable 
 ·       Define reusable standards, blueprints and accelerators that enable market teams to achieve AI readiness independently 
 ·       Stay current with emerging AI data architecture patterns (semantic layers, agentic data access, retrieval) and evaluate their applicability to the International Commercial roadmap 
 2) Data Modelling & Semantic Layer Design 
 ·       Design dimensional and analytical data models (fact and dimension design, grain definition, surrogate key and conformed dimension strategy) optimised for both human analytics and AI/agentic consumption

 ·       Establish modelling standards for AI consumption: naming conventions, documentation, lineage, constraints and machine-readable metadata 
 ·       Resolve complex cross-source integration and dimension-alignment challenges (master data, identifiers, encodings) spanning global and local market datasets

 ·       Translate business and AI use-case requirements into target-state data architectures and data product designs

 ·       Partner with Product Owners, data engineers and AI engineers to ensure designs are implementable, performant and production grade 
 ·       Align designs with enterprise Data and AI Platform standards (governance, security, cataloguing) while maintaining product delivery velocity

 ·       Act as the subject-matter expert and design authority for AI-ready data: lead design reviews, author architecture decision records (ADRs) and reference architectures 
 ·       Coach and upskill data engineers and market teams on modelling and AI readiness best practices, without direct people management 
 ·       Champion engineering and data quality excellence through documentation, patterns and continuous learning (labs, guilds, demos)

Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 The responsibilities include but not be limited to:
 - Managing the overall package design electrical work including the schedule and key milestones. Work with different stakeholders to ensure the work is on track and meets the electrical performance requirement.
- Gathering the inputs requirement from customers.
- Performing electrical analysis that includes signal integrity analysis and power delivery analysis.
- Providing recommendations/solutions in the package design parameters to meet the electrical requirements. 
- Publish the electrical design reports and get the sign-offs from customers. 
- Continuously improve in the electrical analysis work by coming up with innovations or driving efficiencies that helps improve cost, schedule, efficiency and/or quality for the design that ultimately add value to our company.
 Qualifications: 
 - Bachelor, Master or PhD degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
 Candidates with the following experience/s are encouraged to apply:
 - Strong technical knowledge of electrical field theories and electronic fundamentals. 
- Experienced in using Electrical Design Analysis software tools such as Ansys (HFSS, Q3D, SIwave), Cadence Sigrity or any equivalent software.
- Experienced in using Package/Board CAD layout software tool such as Cadence Allegro, Mentor Expedition or any equivalent software. 
- Strong project management skills and multi tasking.
- Strong in technical problem solving (and root causing problems). 
- Good communication in articulation, written and presentation skill.
- Excellent team work.

description:
The Opportunity   
 Frame.io is seeking a Principal Program Manager to lead the technical and cross-functional programs that connect Frame.io to the broader Adobe platform. This role sits at the intersection of Frame.io product ,   engineering , product marketing   management   and the shared Adobe systems — identity, storage,   pricing , entitlements, and other Unified Platform services — that Frame.io depends on   to ship . You will be the person who understands how the pieces fit together! You will keep the dependency map current, and know exactly where the risk lives.   
 The ideal candidate moves fluidly between the 30,000-foot view — strategy, sequencing, tradeoffs — and the ground-level detail of specific   deliverables,   timelines , or launch dependency. You are a proactive communicator who keeps leadership, partner teams, and engineers aligned without being asked, and   you're   comfortable driving a room toward a decision when a program needs one, even across teams you   don't   formally manage.   
 What You'll Do   
 - Own end-to-end program management for initiatives spanning Frame.io and Adobe platform teams (Adobe Unified Platform, Adobe.com, Identity, Pricing Operations, and others), from planning through launch.   
 - Build and   maintain   the technical dependency map   and schedules   between Frame.io and underlying Adobe platform services; proactively surface conflicts, sequencing risks, and blocking dependencies before they become critical-path problems.   
 - Translate ambiguous, strategic goals into structured project plans with clear achievements, owners, and success criteria — and track execution against them in detail.   
 - Drive cross-organizational decisions and broker agreements among Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Legal, Pricing Operations, Support,   and Sales   especially when priorities conflict.   
 - Lead proactive, executive-ready communication up, down, and across the organization — status updates, risk   call-outs , decision— tailored to each audience.   
 - Identify   risks and dependencies   early and   drive mitigation plans across multiple concurrent programs.   
 - Establish and evolve operating rhythms, planning processes, and governance that scale with program complexity.   
 - Partner with   Product and   Engineering to understand technical tradeoffs deeply enough to   represent   them accurately to non-technical partners, and vice versa.   
 - Manage change: adjust plans as scope, timelines, or partner commitments shift, and clearly communicate the impact.   
 - Mentor and support other program managers; contribute to program management practice and tooling across the team.   
 What You Need to Succeed   
 - 8–10+ years of program or technical program management experience, ideally spanning both product-facing and platform/infrastructure-facing work.   
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or   a related   field, or equivalent experience.   
 - Demonstrated ability to understand and manage technical dependencies across systems — comfortable in conversations about APIs, service integrations, data flows, or platform architecture without being an engineer yourself.   
 - Experience with media, video, and/or experience integrating a product into a shared platform ecosystem.   
 - Proven   track record   driving alignment and decisions across multiple organizations, including partners you   don't   directly manage.   
 - Written and verbal communication skills that are outstanding; able to distill complex, multi-team programs into clear, concise updates for leadership.   
 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to hold both strategic context and execution-level detail simultaneously.   
 - Skilled in change management, risk mitigation, and resolving ambiguity under time pressure.   
 - Proficiency   with Jira, Confluence, and standard program reporting tools.   
 - Track record   of building repeatable program management practices, not just running individual projects.   
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 
Let’s Adobe together 
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, inc

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Manager, Airport Experiences 
Global Cardholder Services is a critical organization within the Consumer Products & Processing business, delivering best in class benefits. With a dual mandate to enhance the Core value proposition and drive services revenue, Cardholder Services is a dynamic and high impact program. The team combines deep product expertise and partner management excellence to deliver industry leading customer experiences. 
In this role, you will help with the development, optimization and delivery of Airport benefits, including the new Mastercard Collection Travel Pillar. You will manage key partner relationships and ensure seamless execution across product, services and operational teams. You will also play a critical role in ensuring market competitiveness, pricing consistency and differentiation for Mastercard in the Travel vertical. This role supports global asset development, vendor management, issuer communication, coordination with regional teams, and launch timelines. Experience with product ownership and external vendor management is preferred. The ideal candidate excels in communication, works independently, and is highly organized, detail-oriented, and data-driven.
Responsibilities
• Card Benefits Strategy & Development: align with relevant product teams and deliver benefits that enhance customer value and align to global Airport strategy
• Revenue Growth: identify and execute go-to-market strategies that expand monetization of Airport benefits
• Partner Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic partners, negotiating agreements, ensuring quarterly business reviews and monitoring performance against SLAs
• Alignment: ensure benefit initiatives are coordinated across card product teams, integrated into platform roadmaps and correctly set up with operational enablers
• Performance and Reporting: track product KPIs, partner performance and ROI to inform strategic decisions and create continuous improvement
• Global Execution: Support asset development, vendor management, and communication with our issuers across the all regions. You will also be responsible for coordinating with regional teams and managing project timelines from start to finish.
Experience
• Experience in product management, partnerships or related roles in payments, financial services or travel loyalty programs
• Proven track record of managing high-value partner relationships and delivering measurable business results
• Strong commercial acumen with experience in revenue generation, analytics and using data to drive timely decisions
• Excellent communication (verbal and presentation) and stakeholder management skills, including experience working in global, matrixed organizations
• Ability to operate strategically while managing multiple complex initiatives in fast paced environments 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 - Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
Come be a part of new process technology adoption by joining NVIDIA's Advanced Technology Group! We are looking for a Full-Chip RTL Integration Engineer to join our dynamic and growing FE-ASIC development team. In this role, you will be responsible for integrating complex IPs and subsystems into large-scale SoCs while ensuring design quality, verification readiness, and DFT compliance.
 You will work closely with Architecture, Design, Verification, DFT, and Physical Design teams to deliver high-quality silicon products in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. If you are a problem solver and highly motivated individual searching for a collaborative and exciting role, join us today! We encourage applicants with a history of proven success working in a multicultural and diverse environment. 
What you'll be doing: 
 - Lead RTL integration of multiple internal and third-party IPs into complex ASIC/SoC designs, owning top-level connectivity, clocking, reset architecture, address mapping, and power domain integration.
- Work closely with Architecture, RTL Design, Verification, DFT, and Physical Design teams to drive system-level integration and design closure.
- Perform RTL quality checks including lint, CDC, RDC, synthesis, and connectivity validation.
- Develop and carry out integration-level verification plans using SystemVerilog/UVM, debug simulation failures, and support functional coverage closure.
- Collaborate with DFT teams to integrate scan, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG, and other test structures, and review ATPG reports and fault coverage metrics to ensure testability requirements are met.
- Support design signoff activities and ensure smooth handoff across implementation stages.
- Develop automation and scripting solutions to improve integration, verification, and debug productivity.
What we need to see: 
 - B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years of experience.
- Strong experience in ASIC/SoC RTL Integration.
- Excellent understanding of digital design fundamentals, SoC architecture, clocking, reset, and bus protocols.
- Strong verification knowledge with hands-on experience in SystemVerilog and UVM.
- Ability to independently verify block-level and integration-level designs.
- Strong understanding of DFT methodologies including Scan, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG, and test compression techniques.
- Experience with lint, CDC, RDC, and design quality signoff flows.
- Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Good communication skills and ability to work effectively across multiple engineering teams.
Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience with large-scale SoC or full-chip integration, including high-speed interfaces, processor subsystems, memory controllers, and third-party IPs.
- Exposure to Synopsys, Cadence, or Siemens DFT and verification tools.
- Experience with low-power design methodologies and UPF.
- Proficiency in Python, Perl, Tcl, or Shell scripting, and a passion for improving engineering productivity through automation and AI-assisted development tools.
- Ability to bridge integration, verification, and DFT domains to solve complex system-level challenges and drive efficient design closure.

description:
We're building the platform that lets long-running autonomous agents operate safely inside NVIDIA's enterprise. These are not assistants on a developer's laptop. They are fleets of agents deployed in the cloud, running continuously at scale on shared accelerated compute. They take on real work across enterprise systems, so people get far more done than they could before. This role defines the constructs that agents are built from: the blueprints they start from, the tools, skills, and plugins that power them against enterprise data, the runtime safety harness that keeps them in bounds, and the connections into credential management, sandbox, memory, and observability. The team designs and ships these building blocks so that agent developers across the company can stand up a new agent, wire it in, and run it for days or weeks. Security and safe execution come out of the box, not something each team has to get right on its own.
 Today an agent runs inside a single harness. Claude, Codex, and open-source agent harnesses each work differently underneath, with their own execution model, tool interface, and telemetry shape. The platform smooths over those differences, so a single skill, safety policy, or trace works the same no matter which harness is running. We want to enable agents that act on a person's behalf, governed and secure, continuously evaluated and self-improving. These agents coordinate and hand work off to each other, with identity and policy following every hop. They route and tune themselves across harnesses from live eval signals, and get better from their own production telemetry instead of waiting on a human to retrain them. Have you run agents on a harness like Claude or Codex and hit the walls that show up when they run for real, for days, against live systems — and wanted them to learn from it on their own? We're building the platform that solves those problems once, for every team.
 What you'll be doing: 
 The day-to-day is designing and building the platform that agent builders across NVIDIA depend on, from engineering teams to functions like finance, legal, and HR:
 - Design agent blueprints with clean interfaces for authorization, sandbox, memory, observability, and skills, so a new agent inherits its enterprise integrations from the platform.
- Build the runtime safety harness: a policy engine that checks every action before it runs, rate and budget caps, circuit breakers, approval gates, action allow-lists, and a kill switch that works even when an agent goes rogue.
- Enable composing and orchestrating agents: skills as first-class units with declarative manifests, multi-agent orchestration for delegation and handoff, and support for headless, long-running, autonomous agents.
- Broker credentials so multi-agent systems can authenticate and authorize without ever touching secrets, with least-privilege scoping on every token.
- Provide checkpoint and recovery so an agent resumes cleanly after a crash or restart.
- Instrument observability and evaluation that span harnesses: decision-level traces with correlation IDs, what the agent saw and chose and why, cost anomaly alerts that catch looping, and quality scoring across skills, whole agents and products. Then close the loop: turn those signals into insights that make the agents better.
 Since teams across NVIDIA depend on this platform in production, the whole team shares in keeping it healthy and reliable, including taking part in an on-call rotation.
 What we need to see: 
 - BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
- 12+ years building distributed systems, infrastructure, or developer platforms at scale
- Hands-on experience building agents on a harness, exposing them as APIs, and shipping them with CI/CD
- Experience deploying and operating long-running services on container orchestration platforms
- Experience with the building blocks of scalable systems: messaging, caching, and durable storage
- Proficiency in Python, Go, Rust, or similar
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Built a safety or policy engine that enforces rules on agent actions at runtime, with approval gates and kill switches
- Designed evaluation and feedback loops for agent behavior, tied to versioned skills or blueprints. Built self-evolving loops where agents improve from their own eval and production signals, on the latest agent harnesses — the closed-loop, self-improving side you want to attract
- Applied security fundamentals like threat modeling, authentication and authorization, least privilege, secrets management, and token exchange
- Designed AI data platform components like ingestion pipelines, vector stores, and retrieval APIs
- Shipped platform building blocks adopted by multiple engineering teams. Led complex technical projects like migrations or greenfield platform builds, aligning teams and writing clear design docs

description:
Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
Intel Central Engineering Group (CEG) team delivers best-in-class Ethernet products and is at the heart of Intel's transformation from a PC company to a company that powers the cloud and billions of smart, connected computing devices. CEG's compelling Ethernet products move the world's data and are the foundations of cloud service and telecommunications data centers. You will be exposed to High-Speed I/O protocols such as PCIeGen6-7, DDR5-6, and PAM4 Ethernet 224Gb, which are a part of our Ethernet Infrastructure Processing Unit (Intel IPU) and Foundation NIC (FNIC) Ethernet product lines. We propose a dynamic and flexible workplace position, working directly with highly capable design, system, and pre/post-silicon teams within the organization.
Most of the team's engineers have 10+ years of experience, and we are looking for a highly skilled multidisciplinary engineer with proven experience in Signal Integrity engineering to lead the hardware design of our next division projects' challenges and be part of Ethernet networking's accelerated growth.
In this position, as a signal integrity engineer, you will be responsible for modeling channel elements in 3D and 2D EM simulation tools for pre- and post-layout stages of package and platform design for PCIe, Ethernet, and memory interfaces. You are expected to have a thorough understanding of RF circuits and electromagnetic wave propagation; the role includes learning the specifications of each interface and the required design limitations that should be verified.
You will be expected to lead all signal integrity activities related to multiple projects for various high-speed and low-speed interfaces utilizing traditional and automated tools. You will work closely with silicon design teams and Hard IP vendors and will be responsible for the model's correlation based on cross-section and electrical measurements at the post-manufacturing stage and modeling manufacturing variation impact on the channels. You will be responsible for running the sign-off simulation flows for various designs, providing feedback to the design teams, and being hands-on in the lab for experiments when required. You would also be responsible for identifying/qualifying new AI-based automation techniques and solutions and providing technical leadership to working groups/task forces through debugging and reviews. 
 Qualifications: 
 Required Skills and Experience
• B.Sc./M.Sc. Electrical Engineer with over 7 years of relevant experience in Signal Integrity 
• Proven design experience in the semiconductor ASIC development industry is a MUST
• Proven planning and design flow buildup
• Proven experience with PCB technology and layout techniques (Analog and Digital) including stack-up, routing, and advance SI/PI consideration
• Proven hands-on experience with EDA tools: HFSS, CST, ADS, Simbeor, or equivalent 
• Knowledge of CAD tools: Cadence Allegro or Mentor Expedition, or equivalent 
• Proven experience with modeling and simulation one of the Ethernet, PCIe, DDR interfaces
• Familiar with layout technics
• Working experience with AI-based tools
• Lab hands-on experience in high-speed, low-speed, and clocks circuitry signals measurement such as high-end Oscilloscopes, VNA, TDR, BERT's, etc.
• Excellent debugging skills, ability to analyze problems, diagnose the root cause and apply corrective actions
• Ability to work as a team player and contribute in a cross-functional product team on a daily basis
• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English for interacting with design, evaluation and production engineers; customers; technical marketing engineers; and program managers
 Job Type:
Experienced Hire 
 Shift:
Shift 1 (Israel) 
 Primary Location: 
Israel, Petah-Tikva 
 Additional Locations:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

N/A 
 Work Model for this Role

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Senior Analyst, Workday Reporting & P&C Core HR Services Analytics 
Senior Analyst, Workday Reporting & P&C Core HR Services Analytics
Overview
Mastercard’s People & Capability, or P&C, Product organization is evolving toward an integrated, value-driven ecosystem that delivers a modern employee experience across the hire-to-retire journey. We are moving beyond legacy approaches and disconnected solutions to simplify complexity, improve data quality, strengthen global consistency, and deliver measurable value.
Trusted workforce data is foundational to this modernization. The Senior Analyst will develop scalable reporting and analytics solutions that help product teams and P&C stakeholders measure performance, make informed decisions, and deliver better employee experiences. This role will strengthen reporting governance and improve access to accurate, secure, and actionable information.
About The Role
Join Mastercard’s P&C modernization journey and help shape how workforce data informs decisions. You will deliver reporting solutions for strategic initiatives, product enhancements, and operational needs across Core HCM, Compensation, Learning, Payroll, Time Tracking, and Absence.
This is more than a report-development role. You will partner with product teams and P&C stakeholders to transform complex needs into advanced Workday reports, dashboards, and analytics experiences. You will also strengthen governance, data quality, and responsible self-service, making workforce information easier to access, understand, and act upon.
This role is ideal for someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and energized by complex reporting challenges. You will collaborate across technical and functional teams to create accurate, scalable, secure, and meaningful solutions that support a simpler, more connected employee experience.
What You Will Do
Workday Reporting and Analytics
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Workday reporting and analytics solutions supporting P&C modernization, product enhancements, recurring processes, and operational requests.
• Build and optimize Advanced, Matrix, and Composite reports using calculated fields, complex business-object relationships, and appropriate report logic.
• Design, troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain complex calculated fields supporting critical reporting logic and data requirements.
• Deliver reports, dashboards, and Discovery Boards across Core HCM, Compensation, Learning, Payroll, Time Tracking, and Absence.
• Recommend the most effective solution based on business outcomes, audience, data availability, scalability, and security.
• Translate complex workforce data into meaningful information for P&C product teams, People Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, and business leaders.
• Resolve reporting, calculated-field, and data-quality issues with functional and technical partners.
Reporting Governance and Operational Delivery
• Apply reporting governance, design standards, naming conventions, documentation requirements, security controls, and lifecycle practices.
• Maintain report and calculated-field documentation, including ownership, business logic, definitions, and metadata.
• Contribute to report and calculated-field inventories, repositories, data dictionaries, and governance materials.
• Perform quality assurance, including data validation, peer review, regression testing, and user acceptance testing support.
• Review reports and calculated fields for duplication, inconsistent logic, performance concerns, and consolidation or retirement opportunities.
• Partner with security and functional teams to ensure appropriate access and alignment with privacy, confidentiality, and governance requirements.
• Manage project work through Jira and business-as-usual requests through Workday Help, known internally as AskPS inquiry cases.
• Triage, track, and document operational requests while balancing business value, timelines, service expectations, governance, and technical dependencies.
Stakeholder Partnership and Product Improvement
• Partner with P&C product teams and stakeholders to clarify requirements, define business outcomes, and establish acceptance criteria.
• Communicate solution options, status, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences.
• Develop reusable, scalable solutions that address common needs and reduce unnecessary or duplicative reports.
• Promote responsible self-service r

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 As the Manager of SOX and Internal Audit, you will have a key role in managing financial reporting risk across our fast-growing business. This is your moment to lead with impact and help transform the audit function by putting AI at its core. Join us in Santa Clara, CA, and be a member of a team dedicated to outstanding performance and careful implementation!
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Be responsible for the end-to-end SOX 404 lifecycle and for assigned business process areas, including design assessment, risk assessment, walkthroughs, test planning, control testing, and reporting to management.
- Partner with process owners to assess risks, determine the control response, and drive the resulting narratives, flowcharts, and control builds to completion.
- Promote the adoption of AI in the Internal audit and SOX function by applying AI and analytics to risk assessment, documentation, testing, sampling, and evidence review.
- Review risks and controls associated with AI-powered business processes, ensuring the deployed AI and automation are regulated and sufficiently monitored.
- Evaluate control deficiencies, quantify potential impact, conclude on severity, and drive remediation to closure, presenting issues clearly to Accounting and Finance control owners.
- Drive continuous improvement and automation across the program by finding opportunities to streamline, standardize, and rationalize controls.
- Support and evaluate the efforts of offshore testers, giving coaching and feedback to maintain quality and audit-ready documentation.
- Build SOX proficiency across the business by developing and delivering mentorship and training that makes compliance requirements practical for control owners.
- Assist with operational audits and special projects as assigned.
 What we need to see: 
 - Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or equivalent experience. Active CPA required.
- 8+ overall years in Big 4 and/or large public company environments, with broad hands-on SOX and internal audit experience covering core business processes.
- 2+ years in a leadership role.
- Strong knowledge of GAAP, COSO, PCAOB standards, and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements, with good judgment in applying them to real-world business situations.
- Proven capability to manage complex workstreams autonomously, establish direction without formal authority, and influence process owners.
- Experience reviewing the work of others and raising quality standards within a team.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with keen attention to detail.
- Strong ability to convey complex issues clearly, making recommendations accessible to executive audiences.
- Demonstrated critical thinking and curiosity, with a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Semiconductor or high-growth technology industry experience.
- Hands-on experience applying AI, automation, or data analytics to audit or controls work.
- Experience scaling a SOX program through significant business growth, acquisitions, new revenue streams, or ERP/process transformation.
- Track record of getting results through influence.
- Familiarity with IT General Controls.

Job Description :
 - The M&A IT Business Analyst supports the planning and execution of IT activities for mergers and acquisitions at Adobe. This role partners with cross-functional teams—including GTM, Sales, Product, Finance, Corporate Development, and IT—to gather requirements, analyze business processes, track integration activities, and support successful transaction outcomes.
- The Business Analyst translates business needs into clear requirements, plans, and insights throughout the M&A lifecycle. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, collaborative, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 What you'll Do: 
 - Support IT workstreams across the M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, pre-close planning, Day 1 readiness, and post-close integration.
- Gather, document, and validate business and technical requirements with functional stakeholders and system owners.
- Analyze current-state processes, systems, data, and dependencies to identify integration needs, risks, and opportunities.
- Translate business requirements into process flows, user stories, functional requirements, and actionable work plans.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams to track milestones, deliverables, decisions, risks, issues, and dependencies.
- Assist with systems assessments and rationalization activities across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, identity management, and data environments.
- Support the development and tracking of integration key performance indicators, synergies, and transaction-value measures.
- Prepare status reports, dashboards, governance materials, and leadership updates.
- Facilitate working sessions, document decisions and action items, and follow up with owners to support timely completion.
- Maintain and improve M&A IT playbooks, templates, process flows, checklists, and other integration tools.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and help develop repeatable practices for future transactions.
- Support change-management, testing, data-migration, and business-readiness activities as needed.
 What you need to succeed 
 - Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, information systems, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- At least 3 years of experience in business analysis, technology consulting, project coordination, IT operations, or a related role.
- Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes, analyzing data, and supporting cross-functional technology initiatives.
- Familiarity with the M&A lifecycle or IT integration activities is preferred.
- Working knowledge of enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, and HRIS platforms, as well as cloud and collaboration technologies.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and documentation skills.
- Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience working in global or matrixed organizations is preferred.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work through ambiguity, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
- Proficiency with project-tracking, reporting, process-mapping, and presentation tools.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 The NVIDIA Enterprise Experience (NVEX) Solutions Engineering team is looking for a senior Computer or Software Engineer. This person will establish expertise in ground-breaking network technology used in AI clusters. Our software engineers connect customer support teams and R&D. They focus on solving tough problems from the front lines. They provide top support for high-speed interconnect technologies like InfiniBand, NVLink, and Spectrum-X that link GPUs and AI compute infrastructure. Candidates must have a software development background in the networking industry either for a network hardware manufacturer or software integrator. It is essential to have a proven grasp of in-field, production network operations and have experience in root-causing customer-found issues down to the source code level, primarily C and Python. Breadth of experience is key. We want to see experience in multiple areas such as network operating systems (NOS), Linux network drivers and internals, network hardware, NIC software, Smart NICs, DPUs, embedded firmware, Software Defined Networking, and infrastructure management technologies. IPC, race conditions, finite state machines, event processing loops, queue management, network traffic and flow analysis, and software design gaps will be common areas of focus. The individual will get to work across many NVIDIA teams and often interact with both internal and external customers, so superb interpersonal and communication skills are essential. Candidates will need to understand, root cause, and resolve complex issues, and provide detailed explanations of what you find.
 What you will be doing: 
 - Assist various network and AI cluster support teams in reproducing, resolving, and root causing sophisticated customer issues
- Work with R&D teams to develop bug fixes, workarounds, and solutions for critical customers using NVIDIA’s network technologies
- Become an authority in NVIDIA network technologies used in AI clusters such as Infiniband, NVLink, and Spectrum-X
- Analyze network performance metrics and make tuning recommendations for high-performance, lossless networks
- Develop support and analysis tools to help analyze and root cause field issues
- Daily use of ground breaking AI tools for software development, log and trace analysis, and source code debugging
- Occasional work on weekends or holidays to support customers
 What we need to see: 
 - Minimum of a BS in Computer, Electrical, or Software Engineering (or equivalent experience)
- 8+ years of experience in C or Python programming in Linux or embedded systems
- Experience developing software for one or more of the following:
- Linux NIC drivers, switch ASICs and SDKs, embedded network device firmware, Linux based network equipment (routers, switches, gateways, etc), network operating systems, virtual routers, SDN stacks, virtual switching, DPDK, SRIOV stacks
- At least 3 years of experience directly supporting end-customers, partners, or integrators for network equipment and infrastructures
- Strong system software (firmware, BIOS, kernel, driver, operating system) expertise
- Professional-level communication skills, including adjusting communication to the technical level of the audience, and staying calm and focused in negative situations.
- Passion for learning innovative tech and motivation to work hard on ground-breaking products
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Background with AI infrastructure and HPC networking
- Experience programming switch and NIC ASICs and SDKs
- Background with Infiniband or other non-Ethernet network technologies
- Experience developing or supporting DPUs or SmartNICs
- Knowledge of HPC performance test tools and NVIDIA AI stacks (NCCL, MPI, DOCA, CUDA)

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 270,250 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.
