Supply Operations Quality Specialist 
 Why Patients Need You
 Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is flexible and innovative.
 What You Will Achieve
 You will be a member of Pfizer’s dedicated and highly effective quality operations team. You will evaluate and review Pfizer’s clinical and commercial batches of pharmaceuticals. You will make sure that product and process documents match the specifications based on established sampling and statistical process control procedures. Your expertise will help in identifying deviations from established standards, in the manufacturing and packaging of products. In the
 relevant cases you will approve investigations and change control activities to ensure compliance with configuration management policies.
 As a SOQ Specialist, your knowledge and skills will contribute towards the goals and objectives of the team. Your focus and ability to meet team targets will help in completing critical deliverables.
 Your innovative use of communication tools and techniques will facilitate explaining difficult issues and establishing consensus between teams.
 How You Will Achieve It
 • The key role of the SOQ Specialist is to establish and maintain an appropriate and sustainable Quality Management System and Quality Culture within the Pfizer Country Office (PCO) to ensure compliance with Pfizer and Regulatory Authority expectations.
 • SOQ Specialist is the main point of contact for the investigation and resolution of all product quality issues detected or originating in the PCO and for interacting with the
 relevant local stakeholders (such as Regulatory Affairs, Medical, Commercial, etc.) and Pfizer Global Supply (PGS) on such issues.
 • SOQ Specialist monitors the product quality and compliance activities within the PCO, to ensure current regulatory expectations are met, and facilitate internal and regulatory GMP/GDP inspections.
 Key Accountabilities
 Resolution of Product Quality and Compliance Issues
 Deviation Management 
 Investigates, together with appropriate local functions, deviations from Product Quality and Compliance requirements that occur within the responsibility of the PCO and agrees and tracks preventive/corrective actions. Local investigations may relate to product damage, artwork and labeling errors, counterfeits, temperature excursions during transport or issues with contract manufacturers or logistics service providers etc.
 Customer Complaints Handling 
 Ensures that relevant customer complaints are dealt with effectively as the main responsibility.
 Manages the intake of product quality complaints from the local market and forwards them to the appropriate global teams.
 Tracks responses to product quality complaints. Develops and issues responses to complainants in a timely manner, if requested.
 Provides input from quality perspective to Commercial Departments for the resolution of customer complaints related to distribution activities.
 Notification to Management 
 Informs PGS Quality Operations Management of significant deviations and complaints.
 Quality Management System 
 Ensures timely implementation of all applicable Product Quality SOPs (issued by SOQ) within the
 PCO. Ensures that initial and continuous training programs are implemented and maintained for all relevant PCO colleagues. Monitors key quality performance indicators, evaluates and highlights any significant trends and identifies actions.
 Inspections and Internal Audits 
 Supports the Responsible Person (RP) in the preparation and coordination of GMP/GDP Regulatory Agency inspections. Supports preparation and coordination of Regulatory Agency inspections internal Pfizer audits of Product Quality and Compliance (GMP/GDP) activities at the PCO. Works with local functions to define an appropriate action plan to address the inspection/audit
 observation. Tracks the implementation of the identified actions within agreed timeframes.
 Contracted Activities with GMP/GDP Impact 
 Approves any subcontracted activities which may have an impact on GMP/GDP: Develops, negotiates and maintains up to date Quality Agreements with GMP/GDP contractors, e.g. Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), relabeling/repackaging contractors. Oversees quality operations at contractors, which includes but is not limited to:
 Oversight of Local Relabeling and Repackaging Operations
 Ensures relabeling/repackaging contractor has been internally assessed and approved. Obtains regulatory approval of the relabeling/repackaging activity. Coordinates all activities related to Pfizer productsat the relabeling/repackaging contractor. Informs the releasing site of the
 relabeling/repackaging activity.
 Development and Maintenance of Consistent Quality Culture 
 Collects data and metrics on the PCO’s quality performance and communicates this to the Management of SOQ, PCO

Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Manager, Software Engineering 
Overview:
Mastercard's Global Credit Authorization team is seeking a Manager, Software Engineering to lead the development of highly scalable, mission-critical payment authorization systems that power billions of transactions worldwide. This role is ideal for a technical leader with strong expertise in C/C++ and distributed systems who enjoys building high-performing teams while remaining actively engaged in architecture, design, and software delivery.
In this role, you will lead a team of 5-10 engineers responsible for developing and supporting low-latency, high-throughput authorization services that operate at global scale. You will balance people leadership with hands-on technical contributions, guiding architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle.
You will play a key role in modernizing platforms, improving resiliency and performance, and adopting emerging technologies that help shape the future of digital payments. The position offers the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges in an environment where reliability, security, scalability, and availability are paramount.
This is a hybrid position based in O'Fallon, MO, requiring three days per week onsite.
Role:
• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for high-performance payment authorization platforms built primarily in C/C++.
• Partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technology roadmaps and deliver innovative solutions aligned with business objectives.
• Drive the design and development of scalable, resilient, and highly available distributed systems that support real-time transaction processing.
• Remain hands-on with design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization efforts.
• Establish and promote engineering best practices related to software design, coding standards, testing, observability, and operational excellence.
• Champion system reliability, security, resiliency, and performance across all phases of development and production operations.
• Foster Agile development practices, continuous integration, automated testing, and continuous delivery.
• Collaborate with global teams to manage priorities, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
All About You:
• Proven experience as a Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead, Architect, or Engineering Manager leading software development teams.
• Strong hands-on programming experience in C and C++, including modern C++ standards, multithreading, memory management, and performance optimization.
• Experience building and supporting high-performance, low-latency, mission-critical distributed systems in a Linux or Unix-based environment.
• Working knowledge of Java and related enterprise development frameworks is a plus.
• Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and software architecture principles.
• Familiarity with relational databases and data technologies such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar platforms.
• Experience with cloud technologies, containerization, and orchestration platforms, including Docker and Kubernetes, is highly desirable.
• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, DevOps practices, and observability tooling.
• Ability to drive technical strategy while effectively managing people, projects, and stakeholder expectations.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
• Experience working in Agile development environments with distributed global teams.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

ROLE SUMMARY 
 Within Pfizer's Chief Marketing Office, Senior Manager, Audience Strategy and Optimization will be part of the Audience Center of Excellence (CoE), which builds the audience-first ecosystem powering personalized, orchestrated engagement across paid, owned, and earned channels for patients across a multi brand DTC portfolio. The Sr. Manager will support the expansion of digital addressable audiences for the Pfizer BioPharma US business across patient and HCP. As a critical member of the Audience COE, you will participate in the growth and future roadmap for our audience approach and data driven optimizations. 
 In this role you will partner with Integrated Media Strategy, Analytics, Brand Marketing, Performance Media teams, Measurement and other key CMO commercial teams to ensure the audience strategy is aligned with the marketing objectives and KPI's. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in audience strategy and development, will work well in a matrixed organization, and demonstrate a high level of agility to adapt to changing business needs. 
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 - Develop strategy and support execution of a comprehensive audience approach across Consumer and HCP brands, providing strategic recommendations, partnership, and education to internal stakeholders on implementing key audience functions and tactics. 
 - Assist in establishing, developing, and promoting best practices for audience strategy, planning, and execution — driving consistency in standards and processes across creation, execution, measurement, and optimization, and translating individual brand learnings into those standards. 
 - Develop and maintain the CoE's audience segmentation methodology, profiling and activation standards, translating what's learned on individual brands into playbooks, case studies, and governance practices used across the multi brand portfolio. 
- Drive expansion of digital audience usage within your assigned brand set, demonstrating ROI improvements that can inform CoE-wide scaling decisions 
 - Manage strategic relationships with third-party audience data partners (e.g., Swoop, Crossix, IQVIA). Help to evaluate new audience partners as part of the CoE's test and learn prioritized roadmap. 
 - Collaborate with Media Measurement Team and Audience Analytics lead to develop performance reporting and optimization recommendations for the assigned scope, and translate results and cross-brand patterns into content for the CoE's monthly and quarterly leadership updates.  
 - Serve as the primary analytics partner to brand and leadership teams for all things audiences, translating ambiguous business questions into audience solutions and directing the ad hoc analysis needed to answer them. 
 - Advise senior leadership on audience strategy and measurement, shaping reporting to their needs and turning data into recommendations that drive brand planning and media investment decisions. 
 - Monitor state and federal health-data privacy regulations affecting audience targeting, maintaining exclusion lists in partnership with Legal/Privacy. 
 - Evaluate emerging audience, media, and AI-enabled tools and vendors, recommending which merit test-and-learn investment on assigned brands and which should scale CoE-wide. 
 - Support cross functional team members through knowledge sharing on audience methodology and contribute to CoE problem-solving, with growing visibility to senior stakeholders.  
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 
 - Bachelor's degree required with 6+ years of experience in digital media, audience strategy, advanced analytics, marketing technology, or digital strategy/buying; Master's degree with 5+ years of experience 
- Demonstrated experience working with audience strategy for a brand, category, or client, including presenting recommendations directly to key stakeholders. 
 - Strong knowledge of the audience data ecosystem: DSPs, DMPs, third-party audience data, and data analytics platforms, with experience negotiating or managing data-partner relationships. 
 - Experience translating individual brand or campaign learnings into repeatable standards, playbooks, or processes used by a broader team. 
 - Strong analytical abilities — able to interpret data, identify insights, and make data-driven recommendations for optimization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience developing content for senior leadership updates and explaining performance results and audience recommendations to a range of stakeholders. 
 - Experience managing relationships with cross-functional and external partners, including agencies, clients, in-house teams, and brand teams. 
 - Experience working with data & audience partners. 
 - A strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data to inform strategic decisions and optimize campaign performance 
 - Strong attention to detail and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of hardware, firmware, operating systems, and AI. You will collaborate with some of the best engineers in the world to solve challenging system-level problems and redefine what future data center products can achieve. If you are a creative software engineer who is passionate about low-level technology and wants to build products that expand the boundaries of computing, we want to hear from you. Join us at the forefront of this new frontier!

 - Design and develop SoC software, validation solutions, and test frameworks that efficiently validate and stress complex SoCs and systems throughout the complete software development lifecycle. Your work may span user space, the kernel, firmware, and SoC boot software.
- Pioneer next-generation system validation and reliability software that accelerates the journey from virtual prototypes and first silicon to production-ready hardware, large-scale deployment, and rapid failure resolution across standard and custom platforms.
- Spearhead initiatives that improve the efficiency, intelligence, robustness, and user experience of software used for design validation, thermal and power characterization, manufacturing screening, and customer platform bring-up.
- Investigate and drive root-cause analysis of highly complex board- and system-level failures across hardware and software boundaries.
- Collaborate across the company and with customers and partners to bring next-generation computing platforms to life—powering breakthroughs in AI factories, data centers, autonomous systems, and space-based computing.
 What we need to see: 
 - BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- 8+ years of relevant industry experience.
- Strong C and C++ programming skills, including object-oriented design and development.
- Experience with low-level systems software, device drivers, firmware, or hardware-facing programming.
- A strong understanding of processor architecture fundamentals, preferably ARM.
- Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills, particularly for issues spanning multiple layers of the system.
- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and planning skills, with the ability to lead technically complex initiatives.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals and a solid understanding of ARM-based platforms.
- Experience developing systems, validation, or reliability software for data center, server, AI infrastructure, or other mission-critical platforms.
- Experience planning and executing pre-silicon or post-silicon bring-up for complex SoCs and platforms.
- A consistent record of quickly learning new technologies and applying them to deliver results within ambitious timelines.
- Experience contributing to large-scale software projects and applying AI, automation, or data-driven techniques to accelerate validation, analyze failures, and improve system reliability throughout the software product lifecycle.

 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 AI Builder, Emerging Talent - Finnish Speaking Market 
 Technical foundation required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
 Salesforce is hiring AI Builders, people who are early in their career but not early in their ambition. As part of our first-of-its-kind AI Builder New Grad cohort , you'll be embedded directly with customer-facing teams, designing, developing, and deploying Agentic solutions for the world’s Fortune 500. We are at the beginning of the agentic era, and you will be at the keyboard building the solutions that define how the world's largest companies operate. You’ll deliver real-time customer impact from day one. Working in a builder pod, a cross-functional team that collaborates to design, build, and deploy AI solutions for real customers. It's a built-in support system to ensure you're set up to win. Honestly, you're already thinking about what you'd build here…  
 The AI Builder Experience 
 - AI-Powered Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions with the best-in-class suite of leading-edge AI tools: Including Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes , to accelerate development.  
- Dedicated Mentorship: You won’t be building in a vacuum. You’ll be part of a program focused on hands-on technical skill development, shadowing opportunities, and meaningful networking. You’ll be paired with a dedicated onboarding buddy and have the opportunity to partner with senior developers. 
- Skill Acceleration: This role is designed to develop both your technical depth and your sales skills, ensuring you can lead high-level conversations with stakeholders.  
 What You'll Actually Be Building 
 - Develop AI agents that take real actions for real companies. This is not a side project. Agentforce is live, in production, running for some of the biggest companies on the planet.  
- Design Agent Intelligence: Design how agents think: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and the entire architecture, leveraging AI/LLM technologies and the Agentforce platform. 
- Support the entire Technical Lifecycle: Collaborate with other Builders to architect, build, debug, and deploy high-quality, scalable production systems using JavaScript, Python, and Apex .  
- Drive Strategic Impact: Partner with clients to turn business challenges into agentic solutions . You’ll use your consultative skills to ensure our tech meets real-world needs 
- Iterate and Deploy: Test it, break it, fix it, ship it. Repeat. You will own your work from day one.  
 You’re Our Builder If… 
 - You have a strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.  
- You’re an AI native who has been deep in LLMs and prompt engineering. 
- You are fluent in React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Python, OOP and Real-Time Infra 
- You can hold your own in a room with our sales teams and customers.  
- You write high-quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.  
- You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.

description:
Our Company       
 Empowering everyone to create.   
 Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences.   
 We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.   
 Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.   
 Our Team   
 Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.    
 Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.   
 The Opportunity    
 Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own creative work should set the standard for what those tools make possible.   Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary   Head of Design   to define design excellence for Adobe and build the practice, systems and culture that bring it to life across everything we create.   
 You will lead design across our creative, content and experiences, from high-velocity everyday work to major global campaigns, product launches and Adobe’s most visible moments. You will raise the quality of the work at every scale, creating greater coherence without making it repetitive or predictable.   
 Working upstream, you will   establish   the principles,   frameworks,   and practices that help teams make stronger design decisions earlier. You will translate them into tools,   templates,   and AI-enabled workflows that help internal teams and external partners deliver exceptional work at scale.   
 The Head of Brand owns Adobe’s identity architecture and core brand system. You own the design practice and creative expression across the work, ensuring the brand is interpreted and brought to life with exceptional craft, intelligence and imagination.   
 Design leadership at Adobe extends beyond traditional graphic design. It includes typography, image-making, art direction, motion, digital behavior, spatial experience, editorial thinking, emerging   technology,   and the creative use of AI.   
 You are a maker first. You   remain   close to the tools, the   teams,   and the work. Your authority comes from your   eyes , your   judgment,   and your ability to make the work better.   
 What You’ll Do   
 Set the Standard and Build the Practice   
 - Define and hold the design craft standard across Adobe Creative.    
 - Establish a clear point of view on world-class design in the age of AI.    
 - Build shared principles for typography, image-making, art direction, motion,   interaction   and emerging visual practices.    
 - Raise the design standard across everything we make, from high-velocity work to our most visible global moments.    
 - Ensure the work feels connected and   recognizably   Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic.    
 - Build frameworks,   tools,   and working practices that enable   strong design   decisions from the start.    
 - Partner with the Head of Brand to translate Adobe’s identity system into distinctive and adaptable creative expression.    
 - Partner with Production, Operations and Creative Technology to protect craft while supporting speed and scale.    
 Lead Design Across the Work   
 - Lead design from early creative development through final execution.    
 - Set the art direction and design craft across Adobe’s creative, content and experiences.    
 - Shape Adobe’s most visible global campaigns, product launches, cultural moments and live experiences.    
 - Ensure strong ideas scale across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact.    
 - Partner with the Head of Campaigns to turn breakthrough ideas into compelling visual worlds.    
 - Partner with the Head of Copy to develop visual and verbal expression as one connected creative system.    
 - Direct agencies, design studios and specialist collaborators from a clear internal Adobe point of view.    
 - Hold externally produced work to the same standard as internal creative.    
 Cultivate a world-Class community of   D esigners   
 - Lead and develop Creative Directors, Associate Creative Directors, Art   Directors,   and Designers.

Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact 
As a Module Engineering PhD Intern, you will play a key role in developing and optimizing semiconductor manufacturing processes for a specific module. You will gain hands-on experience by sustaining and improving manufacturing equipment, troubleshooting issues, and supporting qualification activities. This internship offers a unique opportunity to apply your academic knowledge, build practical skills, and contribute to real-world projects in a dynamic environment that fosters growth and innovation. 
 Business Group 
Intel Foundry is focused on advancing semiconductor manufacturing technologies and delivering innovative solutions to meet customer needs worldwide. As part of this organization, you will join a group dedicated to sustaining high-performance manufacturing processes and driving process optimization to support Intel's broader mission of technological excellence. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Support the development and implementation of manufacturing processes for a specific module in semiconductor production. 
- Sustain and enhance manufacturing equipment performance to ensure operational reliability and efficiency. 
- Assist in troubleshooting equipment issues and performing qualification activities to achieve production standards. 
- Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize process control methodologies and enhance process efficiency. 
- Apply statistical analysis and experimental design to improve process reliability and throughput. 
- Gain hands-on experience with materials and device characterization techniques, such as SEM and TEM. 
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for process control systems and methodologies.
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 - Currently pursuing a Ph.D. degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or another STEM-related field. 
- Knowledge of semiconductor processing fundamentals, including lithography, etching, polishing, and deposition techniques. 
- Familiarity with statistical data analysis and experimental design methodologies. 
- Experience in materials and physical device characterization techniques like SEM or TEM, gained through coursework, academic research, or hands-on training. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 - Expertise in advanced semiconductor device structures, fabrication techniques, and process integration. 
- Proficiency in statistical analysis tools and programming languages such as JMP, Python, MATLAB, or C++. 
- Hands-on research experience in device fabrication, physical characterization, or materials testing. 
- Strong foundational knowledge in process control systems and semiconductor device physics. 
 Explore the opportunity to grow your expertise in cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing while contributing to innovative solutions in a collaborative environment. Apply today and take the first step toward shaping the future of technology.

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Lead, Platform Engineering 
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
Overview
The Lead Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks and platform services that support largescale hybrid infrastructure environments. This role focuses on engineering reusable automation patterns using Chef, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps tooling to deliver consistent, secure, and self-service infrastructure capabilities. The ideal candidate brings strong DevOps engineering experience, deep knowledge of Chef (Infra, Habitat, or Automate), and a passion for building scalable automation systems, not performing manual operations.
Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain Chef cookbooks, recipes, roles, and policy files to automate configuration management across cloud and prem environments.
• Build and maintain Chef Automate or equivalent orchestration pipelines for compliance, reporting, and fleet management.
• Engineer reusable automation frameworks, including shared libraries, templates, and patterns for consistent infrastructure provisioning.
• Integrate Chef automation with CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, artifact repositories, and enterprise governance controls.
• Implement automated testing and validation for Chef code using tools such as Test Kitchen, InSpec, and ChefSpec.
• Collaborate with cloud, platform, and security teams to define and enforce configuration baselines, compliance policies, and hardened system standards.
• Support the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) for provisioning compute, network, and platform services.
• Troubleshoot complex automation, configuration, and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments.
• Contribute to platform engineering initiatives such as self-service catalogs, GitOps workflows, and automated remediation.
• Document automation patterns, architectural decisions, and operational runbooks.
All bout you 
• 5–8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or configuration management roles.
• Strong hands-on experience with Chef Infra, including cookbook development, policy files, Test Kitchen, and InSpec.
• Experience managing largescale configuration management environments (Chef Server, Chef Automate, or similar).
• Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, OS hardening, and configuration of lifecycle management.
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on Prem virtualization (VMware, HyperV).
• Strong scripting or programming skills (Ruby preferred for Chef, plus Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
• Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
• Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review practices.
• Ability to troubleshoot complex automation and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Chef Habitat or application-level automation.
• Experience with Chef Automate for compliance, reporting, and fleet orchestration.
• Familiarity with Terraform or other IaC tools for provisioning infrastructure.
• Experience with policyascode tools (OPA, Conftest, Sentinel).
• Background in security hardening, compliance frameworks, or CIS benchmarks.
• Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, or container orchestration.
• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, ELK).
• Knowledge of network automation or infrastructure APIs.

• Configuration Management
• Chef Infra (cookbooks, recipes, policy files)
• Chef Automate, InSpec, Test Kitchen
• Ruby development for automation

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 We are seeking a highly motivated Senior HPC Support Engineer focussing on InfiniBand and NVLink technology, passionate about data center and networking technologies, to provide comprehensive solutions for sophisticated installations, maintenance, or operations for a broad scope of groundbreaking networking products. As a primary point of contact for our customers; assisting them with technical questions, debugging and resolving their issues. As a member of our NVIDIA Experience (NVEX) Global Technical Support team, you are a conscientious, proficient communicator who is fundamentally interested in taking ownership in resolving issues, while ensuring that a high level of customer satisfaction is maintained and delivered. Significant part of the role is also to collaborate with Engineering, Marketing, and Support teams regularly on technical issues.
 What you will be doing: 
 - Ability to resolve sophisticated customer concerns and technical issues through meticulous research, reproduction, and solving problems for customers installing our products and supporting systems using Linux Operating Systems (Multi-distro), with the focus on NVIDIA InfiniBand, NVLink and GPU Technology and our End-to-End Solutions
- Responding to customer product support inquiries via telephone, email, or conference calls
- Resolving customer issues during installation, operation, maintenance or product application or interoperability with other vendors
- Participate in multi-functional team meetings and giving feedback to engineering and marketing regarding product requirements, customer experience, support tools, etc.
- As a technical resource develop, re-define and document standard methodologies to provide to internal teams(Support/R&D) for support process and improvements
 What we need to see: 
 - 8+ years in providing in-depth Customer Support and debugging experience focussed on large-scale networking and AI Infrastructure environments and products such as InfiniBand, Ethernet and GPU including infrastructure performance, strong interpersonal skills and ability to prioritize/multi-task easily with limited supervision.
- An academic degree from an accredited university or college in Networking, Computer Science/Engineering, or Electrical/IT (or equivalent experience).
- Shown use of established Agentic AI technologies (Claude, Codex, Cursor) in day-today job responsibilities.
- Excellent verbal and written English skills.
- Intellectual curiosity, positive attitude, flexibility, analytical ability, self-motivation, and team-oriented including professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems.
 Profound knowledge and experience (solving) in the following skills:
 - Networking Technology, protocols and routing including IP, L2 and L3 on a CCNP/CompTIA Networking+ and Cloud+ level
- Able to debug networking protocols using tools such as TCPDUMP and Wireshark or similar packet generation and analysis tools
- Configuration and operational expertise with traditional network switch/router and Open platforms
- Linux OS System Administration, Networking and Performance on a LFCS/RHCSA level
- Containerized solutions experience on a level of DCA and/or CKA, Virtualization and (KVM/ESXi) and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS/OCI) Technologies
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Knowledge and working experience with the following:
 - InfiniBand, RDMA/RoCEv2 and GPU Technology.
- Clustering or HPC Data-Center technologies including Upper Layer Protocols (i.e., NCCL, MPI, Slurm/SchedMD).
- Shell scripting (Bash/Python).
- Linux, Networking and NVIDIA AI Infrastructure and Operations Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIE-DC/ENT, RHCE, LFCS, NCP-AII/AIO/AIN
 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ 
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 120,000 USD - 207,000 USD for Level 4, and 144,000 USD - 230,000 USD for Level 5. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

description:
The Inflammation & Immunology Clinical Excellence & Innovation organization is seeking an experienced and enterprise-minded clinical development leader to serve as Senior Director, Clinical Excellence Group Lead. This highly visible role provides strategic clinical, scientific, operational, and people leadership across a portfolio of complex clinical development programs.
 The successful candidate will lead and develop a team of clinical scientists while ensuring oversight of clinical integrity, scientific quality, patient safety, and disciplined execution across studies within the Dermatology Franchise. This leader will also help advance new ways of working, including the responsible integration of AI-enabled, digital, data, and advanced analytics capabilities to improve clinical development quality, speed, and decision-making.
 As a senior change leader within a highly experienced matrix organization, this individual will bring strategic clarity, operational discipline, and collaborative influence to address portfolio challenges, optimize resource allocation, and scale effective solutions across the clinical trial lifecycle.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Team Leadership & Change Management 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of high-performing clinical scientists, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, intellectual curiosity, and agility.
- Act as a change champion, guiding a highly tenured organization through digital transformation and new ways of working.
- Drive change management initiatives that encourage the adoption of innovative tools and process optimizations without compromising scientific rigor.
- Build strong, collaborative partnerships with Clinical Operations, Data Science, Biostatistics, Digital/Technology, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Portfolio Strategy, and Business Operations to align clinical science objectives with broader enterprise goals.
- Portfolio planning, lifecycle management, and evaluation of future growth opportunities.
 Business Operations & Enterprise Strategy 
 ·       Apply strong business acumen to identify operational bottlenecks within clinical development and lead cross-functional workstreams to design and implement scalable solutions.
 - Partner with cross-functional teams on enterprise initiatives to develop and implement fit-for-purpose operating practices, tools, and governance approaches that enable a well-controlled, flexible organization with strong fiscal management, cross-team communication, and efficient workflows.
- Establish and leverage standardized frameworks to evaluate clinical program designs, resource needs, and workflows through an operational efficiency lens, ensuring resources are optimized and key milestones are supported.
- Support generating business insights, metrics, and dashboards to inform decision-making, monitor therapeutic area performance, and identify opportunities to improve quality, speed, productivity, and portfolio impact.
- Navigate a complex matrix environment with an enterprise mindset, ensuring that innovation strategies in I&I can scale and align with broader Pfizer corporate objectives.
 AI-Enabled Clinical Development & Innovation 
 ·       Partner closely with data science, digital, and technology teams to translate complex AI use cases into practical, scalable, compliant workflows for study teams.
 ·       Lead the identification, strategic development, and implementation of AI/ML and advanced analytics tools to optimize clinical trial design and execution.
 ·       Direct applied AI/ML approaches across the continuum, including:
 ·       Protocol design and optimization
 ·       Site selection and feasibility assessment
 ·       Patient recruitment and enrollment strategies
 ·       Query management and workflow automation
 ·       Data cleaning, anomaly detection, and signal identification
 ·       Safety risk prediction and proactive mitigation
 - .      `Incorporate AI-derived insights and data-driven approaches into overarching clinical strategy and regulatory deliverables.
 Core Clinical Leadership 
 ·       Oversee the clinical execution and integrity of a portfolio of high-complexity clinical studies within the I&I dermatology pipeline.
 ·       Provide senior-level clinical oversight in protocol design, development, and strategic clinical documentation (protocols, CSRs, regulatory submissions).
 - Oversee study delivery, quality, and operational excellence. Serve as a senior clinical escalation point and strategic partner for Product Team Leads, Global Development Leads, investigators, and internal study teams.
- Contribute to evaluation of external opportunities, business development assessments, or due diligence activities as needed, based on clinical expertise, therapeutic area knowledge, and project-specific needs.
 QUALIFICATIONS
 Basic Qualifications 
 - Education: Advanced scientific or clinical degree required; PhD, PharmD, or equivalent advanced degree strongly preferred.

description:
Our Company   
 Empowering everyone to create.   
 Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences.   
 We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process .     
 Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.   
 Our Team   
 Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.    
 Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.   
 The Opportunity   
 Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own writing and storytelling should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary   Head of Copy   to define the copywriting and narrative standard for Adobe Creative’s campaign and creative work, and to build the copywriting practice, teams and culture that bring that voice to life. You will lead language and narrative across Adobe Creative’s output, from campaign platforms and multi-platform storytelling to digital experiences, product narratives, brand films, and live moments.   
 This is not simply a role responsible for reviewing copy or   maintaining   tone of voice. You will build a world-class internal copywriting practice designed for how brands communicate today: a versatile team able to move from hero campaign spots to scalable copy systems across audiences, channels, and markets.   
 Working upstream, you will   establish   the verbal principles, frameworks, and working practices that help Adobe Creative find stronger stories and language earlier in the process. You will translate them into tools, systems, and AI-enabled workflows that can also create leverage beyond Adobe Creative through shared guidance,   consultation   and collaboration with teams across C&C, Adobe, and our agency partners.   
 The Head of Copy drives Adobe’s identity architecture and core brand system . You own the copywriting practice and creative writing standard across Adobe Creative’s work, partnering closely with Brand on how Adobe’s verbal identity is expressed through campaigns and creative.   
 You are a writer first. You still find the line, rewrite the script, and shape the story. Your authority comes from your creative judgment, your cultural intelligence, and your ability to make writing better.   
 What You'll Do   
 Set the Standard and Build the Practice   
 - Define and hold the copywriting and narrative standard across Adobe Creative.   
 - Establish a clear point of view on world-class copywriting in the age of AI.   
 - Build shared principles for narrative, scripts,   headlines   and platform-native language, partnering with Brand on voice and naming.   
 - Ensure Adobe's voice feels connected and   recognizably   Adobe without becoming corporate,   repetitive   or predictable.   
 - Build frameworks, tools, and working practices that involve copywriters from the start rather than at the end.   
 - Partner with internal teams to document and encode craft into systems that support speed and scale.   
 Lead Writing Across the Work   
 - Lead copywriting and narrative from early creative development through final execution.   
 - Shape Adobe's most visible global campaigns, product launches, and high-velocity work from Adobe Creative.   
 - Partner with the Head of Campaigns to create campaign platforms, headlines, scripts, and integrated language systems.   
 - Partner with the Head of Design to develop visual and verbal expressions as one connected creative system.   
 - Partner with the Head of Brand to translate Adobe’s verbal identity, naming principles, nomenclature, and tone of voice into distinctive creative expression across Adobe Creative’s work.   
 - Ensure strong ideas can move across channels,   formats   and audiences without losing their clarity,   humanity   or impact.   
 - Direct agency copywriters, brand film screenwriters, and specialist collaborators from a clear internal Adobe point of view.

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Senior Software Engineer 
Overview
Join a team focused on transforming how Mastercard's payment systems are built, scaled, and operated. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design and development of cloud-ready applications, microservices, and distributed systems that support large-scale payment processing platforms while helping advance modernization, automation, and engineering excellence across the organization.
In this role, you will contribute to software architecture decisions, drive technical design discussions, and partner with engineers to deliver scalable, resilient, and maintainable software solutions. •Strong understanding of software design and software architecture principles.
•Experience building highly scalable and resilient systems.
•Experience implementing automated testing strategies and quality engineering practices.
•Strong knowledge of performance engineering and production optimization.
•Strong understanding of secure software development principles.
•Experience leading code reviews and mentoring engineers.
•Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.

•Agile Scrum experience.

ROLE SUMMARY 
 The Clinical Trial Results Author is responsible for the preparation, authoring, review, and maintenance of clinical trial results disclosures for public registries including ClinicalTrials.gov, the Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS), and EudraCT.
 The role works closely with Clinical Trial Disclosure Managers, Clinicians, Statisticians, Programmers, Medical Writing, and Study Teams to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant disclosure of clinical trial results. The individual authors Basic Results (BR) by transforming clinical study data and statistical outputs into compliant results records while ensuring adherence to applicable regulations, quality standards, and standard operating procedures.
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 ·        Author ClinicalTrials.gov Basic Results records in PRIME.
 ·        Prepare and maintain:
 o   Participant Flow
 o   Baseline Characteristics
 o   Outcome Measures
 o   Adverse Events
 o   Limitations and Caveats
 o   Certain Agreements and Results Point of Contact sections.
 ·        Review source documents including Protocol, SAP, CSR, and statistical tables as supporting documents for preparing basic results.
 ·        Work with Cross functional groups Clinical trial disclosure manager, clinicians, legal and statisticians for preparing basic results to resolve data questions and ensure accuracy.
 ·        Address quality review comments and support responses to ClinicalTrials.gov reviewer comments.
 ·        Ensure results are completed within disclosure timelines and in compliance with regulatory requirements.
 ·        Support process improvements, training materials, and authoring best practices.
 ·        Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence.

 o   FDAAA 801
 o   42 CFR Part 11
 o   EU CTR 536/2014

description:
Our Company   
 Empowering everyone to create.   
 Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences.   
 We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process .     
 Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.   
 Our Team   
 Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.    
 Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.   
 The Opportunity   
 Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own creative work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary Head of Campaigns to create the breakthrough ideas and enduring platforms behind Adobe Creative's most important global campaign work. You will build ideas powerful enough to move across film, social, digital, OOH, creator   partnerships   and real-world moments through collaboration with teams across C&C, without losing their meaning or creative spine.   
 This is a role for an award-winning creative leader who has built culturally influential campaigns for iconic brands, led multidisciplinary   teams   and developed ideas that people remember,   participate   in and talk about. Working upstream, you will shape the creative opportunity, campaign   platform   and central idea. You will then ensure that idea is translated into a connected creative system that can support flagship storytelling, high-velocity   creative   and adaptive work at scale.   
 The Head of Campaigns owns the campaign platform and central idea for Adobe Creative's campaign work.   The Head of Brand drives Adobe's identity architecture and core brand system; the Head of Design drives the design practice and visual expression across Adobe Creative's work; and the Head of Copy drives the copywriting practice and language across Adobe Creative's work. You partner with each from the earliest   stage   so the idea, identity,   design   and language develop as one connected creative system.   
 You will build Adobe's internal campaign capability, ensuring that our most important creative ideas come from a strong internal point of   view   and that agency partners extend, rather than define, our creative ambition.   
 You are a maker first. You still concept, shape ideas and challenge the work in the room. Your authority comes from the strength of ideas and your ability to make them better.   
 What You'll Do   
 Create Breakthrough Campaign Platforms   
 - Originate and lead Adobe Creative's most important global campaign ideas and integrated creative platforms.   
 - Define the central creative idea and campaign architecture from brief through launch, partnering with the Head of Copy on narrative and language and the Head of Design on visual expression.   
 - Build ideas that connect Adobe's products with a meaningful point of view on creativity,   culture   and the future.   
 - Ensure every campaign is grounded in a clear human tension, product   truth   and distinctive role for Adobe.   
 - Develop platforms capable of supporting flagship storytelling, cultural   participation   and high-velocity creative.   
 - Identify   creative opportunities before they arrive as formal briefs.   
 Lead Campaigns Across the Work   
 - Lead campaign development from early strategic territory through concept,   production   and launch.   
 - Shape Adobe Creative's most visible global campaigns and product launches.   
 - Partner with Content,   Experiences   and shared-service teams when campaign platforms extend into publishing, partnerships,   talent   or real-world moments.   
 - Ensure ideas scale across channels and formats without losing their clarity,   emotion   or originality.   
 - Partner with the Head of Design to turn breakthrough ideas into compelling visual worlds.   
 - Partner with the Head of Copy to shape campaign narratives, scripts,   headlines   and language.   
 - Partner with the Head of Brand to ensure campaigns stretch and advance Adobe's identity

description:
Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
The Opportunity:
For nearly a decade, Intel's Neuromorphic Computing Lab, together with a global ecosystem of 250+ research groups, has explored architectures, algorithms, and software inspired by the brain's extraordinary efficiency, scalability, and adaptability. Our Loihi series of research chips pioneered event-driven, sparse, and massively parallel neuro-inspired processing, fueling over 100 peer-reviewed publications that validate the promise of this novel approach.
Now, we're entering an exciting new chapter: transforming these breakthroughs into real-world products that will power the coming era of physical AI systems - beyond the reach of GPUs and mainstream AI accelerators.
If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of computing, from transistor-level innovation to software abstractions, join us. Help define the next wave of AI technology that harnesses the proven advantages of Intel's neuromorphic computing technology with the versatility demanded by modern AI workloads.
Position Overview:
Join the team building Intel's product-grade neuromorphic AI execution stack targeting edge and robotic systems. In this role, you will architect and lead the development of the device drivers and firmware, working closely with hardware, runtime, and validation teams to deliver a robust and efficient foundation for devices attached to a host or running standalone. You will own this layer from pre-silicon definition through production release while remaining hands-on in architecture and implementation.
Responsibilities:
- Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Intel's neuromorphic driver and firmware stack, while contributing hands-on to critical design and implementation.
- Architect, develop, and optimize the driver and firmware components that operate the device, covering command submission and execution control, memory mapping and data movement, interrupts, power management, and reset and recovery, whether the device is attached to a host or runs standalone.
- Partner with hardware architects to define the hardware/software interface of future silicon and drive software bring-up from pre-silicon modeling and emulation through post-silicon power-on and tuning.
- Own the production readiness of this layer, including security, reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability, along with the validation needed to release it and support it in the field.
- Collaborate with runtime, compiler, application, and validation teams, as well as customers and external partners, to translate platform and workload requirements into robust software capabilities.
- Provide technical leadership across the driver and firmware area by establishing engineering practices and mentoring engineers.
About the Organization:
As part of Intel's CTO Office, you will join a vertically integrated incubation effort dedicated to bringing Intel's neuromorphic technology innovations to market. Our diverse team of engineers and researchers has pioneered sparse, event-based, neuromorphic architecture over multiple generations and is now focused on commercializing the technology in future Intel and partner products. 
 Qualifications: 
Minimum qualifications
- BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 5+ years of experience developing and shipping production device drivers and device firmware, or comparable low-level systems software, for accelerators, GPUs, or other complex hardware devices, including the interfaces between them.
- 5+ years of experience leading the architecture and design of driver or firmware subsystems for complex hardware platforms, including defining technical direction and guiding implementation.
- 5+ years of experience defining hardware/software interfaces together with hardware architects, and leading software bring-up from pre-silicon development on virtual platforms, simulators such as Simics, emulation, or FPGA, through post-silicon power-on, validation, and tuning.
- 5+ years of experience designing driver or firmware subsystems for production readiness, covering security, reliability, recovery, and the tracing, telemetry, and diagnostics needed to debug across hardware, firmware, driver, operating system, and runtime boundaries and to support a product in the field.
- 5+ years of experience mentoring engineers and leading delivery across cross-functional teams spanning hardware, firmware, systems software, and validation.
- 10+ years of hands-on experience developing maintainable, production-grade systems software in C/C++, with proficiency in Python for tooling, automation, and validation, using disciplined engineering practices such as design and code reviews, profiling, benchmarking, regression testing, build/toolchain management, and CI/CD.
- 1+ years of hands-on experience with agentic software engineering, routinely using AI agents to design, implement, test, and review p

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Data Engineer II 
Overview:
Mastercard’s Enterprise Credit Risk (ECR) team is seeking a Data Engineer II to design, build, and maintain data platforms and products that support credit decisioning, risk analytics, regulatory reporting, and machine learning initiatives.
In this role, you will work with large and complex datasets to develop scalable, reliable, and high-quality data solutions. You will collaborate with engineers, data scientists, risk analytics, and product partners to translate business needs into effective data products and pipelines. This is an opportunity for an engineer to deepen their data engineering expertise while contributing to modern cloud-based platforms and ECR's ongoing data modernization efforts.
This is a hybrid role based in O’Fallon, MO, requiring three days per week onsite.
Role:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines, transformations, and datasets supporting ECR products and initiatives.
• Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows using technologies such as SQL, Python, Databricks, and Spark.
• Develop and maintain curated data products that support reporting, analytics, credit decisioning, and other business use cases.
• Partner with Product, Risk Analytics, Data Science, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
• Implement data validation, testing, and quality controls to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
• Support the deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operation of production data pipelines and workflows.
• Investigate and troubleshoot data and pipeline issues, contributing to root cause analysis and resolution.
• Participate in code reviews and follow established engineering standards, best practices, and development processes.
• Contribute to the modernization of data platforms, including cloud migration and adoption of modern data engineering technologies.
• Document data solutions, pipelines, data flows, and operational processes.
• Identify opportunities to improve the performance, reliability, scalability, and efficiency of data solutions.
All About You:
• Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role, with a solid understanding of core data engineering concepts, methodologies, and best practices.
• Experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformations.
• Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write and optimize queries to retrieve, transform, and analyze large datasets efficiently.
• Experience with Python or another programming language used for data processing and automation.
• Experience working with relational databases, including Postgress, and an understanding of data modeling and database design.
• Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering technologies.
• Familiarity with distributed data processing technologies such as Databricks, Apache Spark, or comparable platforms.
• Understanding of data testing, validation, and quality practices to ensure accuracy and consistency across data pipelines.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and develop effective solutions.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities while working effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional and Agile teams.
• A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to think critically, innovate, and identify opportunities to enhance data solutions.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM discipline. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path. 
This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.
By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

- You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning

- You have excellent interpersonal skills
- You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
- You are fluent in English & Dutch (essential) 
 What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? 
 The program is structured as follows:
 Introduction Month 
 During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:
 - Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
- Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
- Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
- Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni
 Rotations 
 - During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. description:
Role Summary 
 Pfizer Commercial Oncology is introducing the world to the next era of cancer care. With a growing portfolio of novel therapies, industry-leading R&D, and a goal of delivering eight breakthroughs by 2030 across major cancer types, we're translating cutting-edge science into market-shaping impact. Here, you'll partner with exceptional colleagues across scientific, medical, and manufacturing teams, backed by advanced digital and AI-enabled infrastructure and the authority to accelerate medicines from discovery to delivery. Guided by our values of courage, excellence, equity, and joy, you'll have the opportunity to stretch your skills and build a career that evolves with you—across teams, roles, and the Pfizer enterprise.  Join us to make history — for patients, for their families, for the future.  
 The Senior Oncology Account Specialist (SOAS) will have a variety of responsibilities, ranging from promoting Pfizer’s product portfolio to health care providers and specialists, to educating members of the healthcare community regarding the appropriate use of Pfizer products, to calling on accounts and organized customers to help improve patients’ experience with Pfizer products, as well as the overall quality of patient care delivered. 
The SOAS plays a critical role in increasing Pfizer’s brand with high-value target customers by linking an insightful assessment of the account and/or business landscape with a strong understanding of Pfizer’s products and resources. 
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 
 - BA/BS Degree from an accredited institution BA/BS Degree from an accredited institution OR an associate’s degree with 8+ years of experience; OR a high school diploma (or equivalent) with 10+ years of relevant experience. 
- Ability to travel domestically and stay overnight as necessary  
- Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards.  Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired 
- Minimum of 4 years of previous Pharmaceutical Sales experience or minimum of 4 years of previous Oncology Healthcare Professional (HCP) experience working with key Oncology thought leaders or high influence customers in hospitals, large group practices or managed care organizations.  
- A demonstrated track record of success and accomplishment with previous Pharmaceutical Sales experience or Healthcare Professional (HCP) experience  
- Exceptional aptitude for learning and ability to communicate technical and scientific product and disease management information to a wide range of customers  
- Demonstrated high degree of business acumen  
- Proficiency using complex digital applications and able to adapt to Pfizer’s long-range technology model in bringing relevant Pfizer information to market.  
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 
 - 3-5 years of Oncology sales experience  
- Experience in Hematology Therapeutic Area 
- Master’s Degree  
- Advanced Healthcare Professional (HCP) Degree  
- Experience calling on institutions, NCI centers and Key Opinion Leaders  
 Functional / Technical Skills can include:  
 - Promote broad portfolio of products; Strong knowledge of disease states, therapeutic areas, and products

At Intel, we are at the forefront of innovation, creating world-changing technology that enriches the lives of every person on planet. The Foundry labs directly support advancement of Intel's technology development. The transmission electron microscopy group supports engineering activities in fabrication, failure analysis, technology development, process development, process integration, and pathfinding. We are looking for engineers who love solving technical problems, are driven to achieve results, and are flexible in adapting to new methods, tools, and fields of study depending on what is needed to solve the problem at hand.

description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build NeMo Helix , NVIDIA’s product for developing, evaluating, deploying, and operating AI systems at scale. This role is for a senior engineer/architect for our Core team which owns and ships an open source plugin-based AI platform for running and optimizing Agents targeting multiple compute backends (local/docker, Kubernetes, Slurm, etc.).
As AI systems become more autonomous and more deeply integrated into real workflows, teams need robust APIs and orchestration systems for running, monitoring, and optimizing Agents at scale. Increasingly, the users of these systems are themselves autonomous or semi-autonomous Agents. The NeMo Helix group is building a sophisticated agent execution framework to enable agents to automatically run hundreds of experiments in parallel to find the most efficient agent architectures for our customers. This is important product engineering research for making agents more sustainable. AI systems are not yet nearly as efficient as they can be, and systems like NeMo Helix will allow large scale AI consumers to automatically tune their agents to use fewer tokens and rely on more efficient models with better throughput.
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Working in a product research environment where we place big bets on where the future is heading, adapting in real time as we build alongside an industry that is constantly evolving with us. This means fast iteration, high ownership, pragmatic decisions, and performance-minded implementation under production constraints 
- Designing an Agentic Execution system that are flexible enough to work in many environments (local, k8s, Slurm, on prem / air-gapped) 
- Provide senior technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and ownership of ambiguous cross-component problems 
- Building and maintain our Core Platform APIs for running jobs, storing data, entities, secrets, and RBAC and Auth 
- Extending our flexible Plugin Architecture that makes it easy for many teams and external customers to install new capabilities into our system 
- Building in the open in our OSS repo, keeping up the high standards that the open source community demands 
- Shipping code at the speed of light with an unlimited token budget using best in class agentic coding tools 
- Improving reliability, observability, debuggability, and performance across NeMo Helix, SDKs, plugins, jobs, and developer workflows 
- Building strong test coverage across unit, integration, E2E, Docker, and Kubernetes workflows 
 What we need to see: 
 - BS, MS, or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field 
- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building production systems 
- Comfort working in a very fast and ambiguous environment 
- Exceptional communication, both verbal and written. This includes the ability to produce and review high quality architectural RFCs, and to discuss them clearly with the right level of technical detail for the right people (Engineer, Product, Marketing, etc.) 
- Strong system design skills, with a pragmatic flexibility and phenomenal instincts to invent robust systems quickly without over-complicating. Strong understanding of reliability, scalability, security, and performance tradeoffs in production infrastructure 
- Experience with distributed systems, cloud-native services, containers, Kubernetes, and job orchestration 
- Excellent Python engineering skills, including API design, typing, testing, debugging, performance analysis, and maintainable software design 
- Experience designing SDKs, libraries, plugins, CLIs, or other developer-facing interfaces 
- Ability to work independently, define technical scope, break down ambiguous problems, and drive work across team boundaries 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience building, deploying, and iterating on production agentic AI systems at scale in Kubernetes 
- Experience with sophisticated plugin architectures 
- Strong ability to connect technical evaluation work to business outcomes, product quality, user experience, reliability, or operational efficiency 
- Experience with enterprise AI systems where measurement, regression testing, observability, governance, and continuous improvement are required for production deployment 
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .
