ROLE SUMMARY 
 The Program Coordinator provides administrative, program coordination, learning operations, and leadership support for leadership development programs and skills development for the Leadership Institute and Access and Reimbursement Team. The role coordinates learner administration, live training and event logistics, team meetings, budgets, vendors, systems, communications, travel and expenses, engagement activities, visitor logistics, and reporting to deliver a seamless learner and stakeholder experience while maintaining accurate program data and documentation.
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Program Administration and Learner Management 
 - Coordinate end-to-end learner administration for leadership development programs, including curriculum uploads and updates in the Content Library, GCMA submission management, participant enrollment, Degreed, My Essential Learning course creation, roster management, attendance and completion tracking, learner communications, assessments, certifications, badges, evaluations, and reporting.
- Maintain accurate learner records, program documentation, schedules, trackers, reports, standard operating procedures, templates, communications, and meeting documentation; proactively identify gaps, risks, and follow-up needs.
- Partner with learning, business, and platform stakeholders to provide urgent, customer-focused support and consistent learner experience.
 Live Training, Events, and Engagement Logistics 
 - Coordinate end-to-end logistics for leadership development programs, workshops, leadership meetings, town halls, off-sites, and engagement events, including scheduling, attendee management, materials, rooms, virtual meeting setup, travel, hotel blocks, registration, catering, supplies, and operational support.
- Coordinate external speakers, facilitators, vendors, partners, and visitors, including access, materials, technology requirements, timelines, responsibilities, updates, and day-of support.
- Anticipate logistical issues and resolve them early to support seamless program execution and stakeholder experience.
 Calendar, Meeting, and Leadership Support 
 - Provide administrative and coordination support to the Leadership Institute leader and AAR Team leader, including calendar management, teams channel/file management, scheduling, meeting coordination, conflict resolution across stakeholders, and phone coverage when required.
- Coordinate team and leadership meetings by gathering agenda topics, distributing agendas and materials, documenting decisions and action items, and following up on commitments.
- Prepare professional, executive-ready presentations, communications, reports, announcements, and messages of appreciation.
 Budget, Purchasing, Travel, and Vendor Administration 
 - Manage department and program budget tracking, purchase order creation and tracking, invoice routing, financial commitments, and recordkeeping in alignment with organizational processes.
- Coordinate business travel, itineraries, expense reports, reimbursements, approved purchases, supplies, equipment, hotel accommodations, event contracts, and supporting documentation.
- Coordinate vendor activities, contracts, deliverables, platform access, communications, milestones, and outstanding actions.
 Learning Systems, Assessments, and Technology 
 - Administer DiSC and SLII assessments, including assignments, access, communications, distribution, completion tracking, reports, materials, and vendor or platform coordination.
- Work with the appropriate learning platform team to add classes to My Essential Learning, Degreed, and relevant academies and support learning system administration and reporting.
- Expertise with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Microsoft Office, Copilot, Claude, and other approved tools to improve coordination, reporting, content preparation, and operational efficiency; provide basic troubleshooting and escalate issues when needed.
QUALIFICATIONS 
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 
 - High school diploma or equivalent with a minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in program coordination, administrative support, training coordination, learning operations, event coordination, or project support; OR an Associate’s, Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD with 0+ years of work experience is required.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, schedules, and stakeholders with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
- Experience coordinating meetings, live or virtual events, participant communications, materials, logistics, town halls, off-sites, engagement activities, and action tracking.
- Experience coordinating business travel, expense reports, reimbursements, budgets, purchase orders, invoices, contracts, vendors, purchases, or related financial administration.
- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including formatting professional and executive-ready materials and providing urgent stakeholder support.

You will partner with teams all across NVIDIA to enable their AI workflows. This is a role for someone who wants to build at the frontier of AI, creating the platform for next-gen agentic services! 
 What you will be doing: 
 - Leading cloud VM platform initiatives from architecture and systems design through implementation, testing, and deployment. 
- Designing, building, and operating scalable services that support secure, isolated agent workloads. 
- Developing automation for infrastructure provisioning, VM lifecycle management, application delivery, configuration, monitoring, and remediation. 
- Collaborating with engineering teams across NVIDIA to translate business and AI workflow requirements into dependable platform capabilities. 
- Improving the platform’s reliability, scalability, observability, performance, and operational efficiency. 
- Continuously raising standards for code quality, testing, documentation, infrastructure security, and production readiness. 
 What we need to see: 
 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent experience. 
- 8+ years of experience in software, platform, infrastructure, or cloud engineering, with a focus on backend or distributed systems. 
- Strong understanding of distributed-systems concepts, including service communication, asynchronous processing, failure handling, retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency. 
- Familiarity with PostgreSQL and MongoDB, including data modeling, migrations, and performance. 
- Understanding of secure software development, cloud security, identity and access management, secrets management, and network security. 
- Experience with AI-native development and coding agents to multiply developer efficiency. 
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Deep expertise in Go and TypeScript. 
- Production experience with Temporal for durable execution, workflow orchestration, and long-running distributed processes. 
- Comprehensive understanding of infrastructure security, workload isolation, container security, and zero-trust principles. 
- Experience building platforms for AI agents or sandbox execution. 
- Excited to contribute to a high-trust, collaborative culture while bringing a unique perspective to the team! 
 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and enjoy learning while having fun, then what are you waiting for? Apply today!
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 270,250 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Lung cancer treatment is evolving rapidly, and the space between emerging evidence and every day clinical practice is where our medical expertise matters most.
 As a field-based scientific expert supporting Pfizer’s Thoracic oncology portfolio in Southern Califonia . , you will engage a broad range of medical customer segments. You will deliver approved medical and scientific education to healthcare professionals, surface insights that inform medical strategy, support the identification of potential clinical trial sites and clinical trial support, and help address the field’s most important unanswered scientific questions in service of improving patient outcomes.
 Field Medical Core Responsibilities 
 - Plan and execute Medical strategy and engagement for appropriate assigned customers within a territory, compliantly coordinating with other Pfizer colleagues as needed to achieve Medical objectives
- Maintain required level of knowledge of relevant TA/disease states and Pfizer medicines, providing therapeutic area/product information to both internal and external stakeholders as needed
- Serve as a conduit and resource for Medical Information and customer insights, providing requested information to HCPs as allowed by Pfizer guidance and sharing customer viewpoints with Pfizer as appropriate 
- Understand the priorities of Pfizer Medical Affairs in order to contribute to Medical content strategy development and execute aligned Field Medical tactics
 - Maintain effective and appropriate communication and collaboration among headquarters Medical colleagues, Medical Information, and other Pfizer Field Medical colleagues
 - Demonstrate expertise in communication across multiple channels, including, but not limited to, live and virtual presentations in small or large settings, written communication, and telephone or virtual conversations
- Optimize patient centricity of Medical communications and deliverables, incorporating Health Literacy and cultural awareness principles to ensure that patients remain the ultimate focus
 Field Medical Role Responsibilities 
 - Deliver approved medical content about Pfizer medicines and relevant topics in the designated therapeutic area 
- Identify and seek medical engagement from priority customer segments in assigned Therapeutic Area
- Provide truthful, accurate, and scientifically supported information in response to direct unsolicited medical requests from HCPs in a manner that complies with all applicable Pfizer guidelines, policies, and procedures
- Leads advisory boards (BRF, Vendor) with manager oversight.
- Field relevant inbound queries from HCPs via established triage process
- In collaboration with Global Medical Affairs colleagues, partner with Oncology Research & Development and Global Product Development (GPD) in the identification of potential sites for Pfizer-sponsored clinical trials, including identification of sites serving under-represented patient populations in trials
- Appropriately provide Medical support throughout the Investigator Sponsored Research (ISR) process
- Cultivate research and therapeutic area expertise, including familiarity with latest congress data and disease state literature
- Provides Asset leadership
- Understand the principles of study design, methodology, data analysis, and interpretation and communicate these concepts with customers
- Strong territory leadership
- Reactively and proactively communicate with local Patient Advocacy Group(s), as appropriate, in close collaboration with Corporate Affairs and HQ Medical Affairs
- Deliver insights on local patient organization structure, capabilities, and patient population needs
- Serve on Medical and/or TA and asset cross-functional committees, as appropriate
- Represent Pfizer Medical Affairs leadership with clinical/professional associations and/or societies, consistently demonstrating medical professionalism in all interactions
- Mentorship – Onboarding partner, ad board and study lead mentor.
- Participate in special projects as needed
 Basic Qualifications 
 - Bachelor’s degree in a health science required
- Relevant experience required: PharmD/PhD with 6 years of experience, MBA/MSc with 8 years of experience, BA/BSc with 10 years of experience.
- Currently reside in the territory: Southern California .

 Enterprise Architect（EA）は、Adobeの日本国内エンタープライズ顧客に対し、Digital Experience領域における高品質なソリューションデリバリーを牽引する、戦略的テクノロジーガイドです。AdobeはGenerative AI・Agentic AIを核とした新しいデジタル体験のあり方を追求しており、EAはその技術的先鋒として、AI活用による顧客ビジネスの変革を主導する役割を担います。
 お客様のビジネスゴールとAdobeソリューションを、スケーラブルで統合的なアーキテクチャによって整合させます。プロジェクト単位のCustom Serviceと、サブスクリプション型のIntegrated Servicesの双方にまたがる、数少ない横断的な戦略ロールです。
 EAは以下の3つのフェーズでお客様に伴走します。
 - Plan and align ：アーキテクチャDiscoveryの実施、将来アーキテクチャの定義、ITストラテジーとの整合
- Design and guide ：統合・データフローの提言、クロスソリューションのアーキテクチャガイダンス、技術設計のレビューと検証
- Enable and Optimize ：価値の検証、ROIの実証、成功事例の発掘
 主な業務内容 
 - Adobe CX Enterprise（旧Adobe Experience Cloud）を横断する、サードパーティ連携を含むエンドツーエンドのアーキテクチャ設計
- 複雑なビジネス要件を技術ソリューションへ変換し、デリバリーチームの活動をお客様のビジネス目標に整合させる
- プロジェクトスコープ・見積り・リソース配分・進行計画の立案
- ビジネス部門、IT部門、パートナー、経営層など関係者を巻き込んだロードマップ策定
- グローバルデリバリーチーム、パートナーエコシステムと連携したプロジェクト推進と、技術成果物の品質レビュー
- Agentic AIを含むAEM / Adobe CX Enterpriseの先進機能を調査し、新しいサービスモデルの開発に貢献
- Generative AI／Agentic AIをお客様のビジネスにどう活用できるか、具体的なユースケースとアーキテクチャの観点から提言
 このポジションで得られる機会 
 - 日本を代表するエンタープライズ企業のデジタル変革を、技術面の中核として牽引できる
- AdobeのProduct/Engineering組織と直接連携できる
- Firefly、GenStudio、Agentic AIなど、Adobeが投資する最先端AIソリューション群を活用した新規サービスの立ち上げに携われる
- Custom ServiceとIntegrated Servicesを横断する希少なロールとして、コンサルティング産業の変化の最前線に立てる
 必須スキル・経験 
 - 以下のいずれかに関連する6年以上の経験:
 (a) Enterprise Architectまたはコンサルタントとして、大規模エンタープライズ向けWebアプリケーション
(b) デジタルマーケティング領域におけるプロダクトマネジメント経験
- CMSやWebアプリケーションに関する基礎知識
- CDNを含む、高パフォーマンスなWebシステムアーキテクチャの設計・立案経験
- 複雑なビジネス要件を技術ソリューションに変換し、デリバリーチームの活動を整合させた経験
- プロジェクトスコープ定義、見積り、リソース配分の実務経験
- Generative AI／Agentic AIをはじめとする技術トレンドを常にキャッチアップし、お客様のビジネスへの具体的な応用を提案できる力
- 相手（技術者・マーケティング部門・経営層）に応じてコミュニケーションを調整できる能力
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（必須）。英語はビジネス文書の読み書きができる程度で可
 歓迎するスキル 
 - Adobe CX Enterprise製品の実務経験
- アナリティクス導入のデリバリー 経験
- React、TypeScriptなど、モダンなWebフロントエンドスタックに関する知識
- 広告テック、マーケティングオートメーション、オムニチャネルパーソナライゼーション、CRMなど、デジタルマーケティングジャーニー全体の知見
- Generative AI／Agentic AIソリューションの業務活用経験、またはAIエージェント構築経験
- グローバルチームと直接折衝できるレベルの英語力
- 複数リージョンにまたがるクロスファンクショナルなチームをリードした経験
 求める人物像 
 - 顧客のビジネス課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによる解決策を描ける方
- 技術部門と経営層の橋渡し役として、双方から信頼される関係を築ける方
- AIをはじめとする変化の激しい技術トレンドを常にキャッチアップし、実務への応用を探求できる方
- 複数の関係者を巻き込みながら、責任を持ってプロジェクトを推進できるリーダーシップをお持ちの方
- 既存の枠にとらわれず、新しいサービスモデルの構築に主体的に関わりたい方
- オンショア／オフショア混成のグローバルチームとの協働に抵抗がない方
 Job Description 
 The Enterprise Architect (EA) operates as the principal strategic technology guide and technical force behind delivering high-quality Digital Experience solutions to Adobe's enterprise customers in Japan. Adobe is pursuing a new generation of digital experiences built around Generative AI and Agentic AI, and the EA serves as the technical vanguard driving customer business transformation through these capabilities.
 The EA ensures customer business goals match Adobe solutions through scalable, integrated architectures that generate sustained value. This cross-functional strategic position operates within both Custom Service, which is project-focused consulting, and Integrated Services, Adobe's subscription advisory service. Few roles span these two engagement approaches.
 The EA partners with customers across three phases:
 - Plan and align: Conduct architecture discovery sessions, define future-state solution architecture, and align Adobe solutions with IT strategy
- Design and guide: Recommend integration and data flows, provide cross-solution architecture guidance, review and validate technical designs, and advise on governance and scalability
- Enable and Optimize: Verify and validate value, measure path to value and return on investment, and find opportunities to showcase success
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Develop complete architectures throughout the Adobe CX Enterprise (formerly Adobe Experience Cloud) portfolio, incorporating connections with third-party solutions
- Translate intricate business needs into technical solutions, ensuring all delivery team actions correspond with documented customer business goals
- Develop project scope definitions, delivery estimates, resource allocation plans, and project timelines
- Develop roadmaps in collaboration with business collaborators, IT teams, partners, and executive leadership
- Propel project advancement in partnership with global delivery teams and the partner network, and review technical deliverables to ensure quality
- Investigate advanced features of AEM and Adobe CX Enterprise, including Agentic AI, to aid the development of new service models
- Advise customers on concrete use cases and architectural approaches for applying Generative AI and Agentic AI to their business
 Opportunities Offered 
 - Lead the technical architecture behind digital transformation for leading Japanese enterprise customers
- Work directly with Adobe's Product and Engineering teams
- Contribute to the creation of new services powered by Adobe's leading-edge AI portfolio, including Firefly, GenStudio, and Agentic AI
- Take on a distinctive role that combines both Custom Service and Integrated Services—situating you at the forefront of changes in the consulting field

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Director, Platform Engineering 
Who is Mastercard? 
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 
Role Summary 
Director, Platform Engineering 
At Mastercard, the pace of change across technology, AI, and the nature of work requires that we constantly push the boundaries for the technologies in building and operating infrastructure and applications globally. The Director, Platform Engineering is a critical technology and engineering leadership role within Operations Automation Program accountable for advancing our infrastructure and platform automation strategy through innovation and effective problem-solving. This role focuses on analyzing, coding, and delivering software and platform solutions. Operations Automation program supports Mastercard’s global infrastructure footprint by building and maintain automation platforms, automating infrastructure, services, and application delivery with efficient tools and processes. 
The Director, Platform Engineering is a hands-on technical expert responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks, platform services, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) capabilities that power large scale, hybrid infrastructure environments. Focuses on engineering reusable automation patterns, enabling self-service infrastructure delivery, and improving reliability, consistency, and velocity across cloud and on prem platforms. The ideal candidate brings hands on experience with infrastructure automation tools like Terraform, Ansible or Chef, strong DevOps engineering skills, and a passion for building scalable automation solutions. 
Key Responsibilities 
•Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using platforms like Terraform, Ansible, Chef to automate provisioning across cloud and on prem environments. 
•Develop reusable modules, playbooks, and automation libraries that standardize infrastructure deployment patterns. 
•Engineer and enhance platform services, including CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, artifact repositories, and configuration management systems. 
•Implement automated testing, validation, and security scanning for IaC and platform components. 
•Integrate automation with cloud platforms, virtualization systems, network/security appliances, and enterprise tooling. 
•Implement drift detection, compliance checks, and automated remediation workflows. 
•Collaborate with cloud, network, security, and SRE teams to define automation standards and best practices. 
•Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, automation, and CI/CD issues across hybrid environments. 
•Contribute to documentation, architectural diagrams, and engineering design reviews. 
Required Qualifications 
•5–8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or infrastructure automation roles. 
•Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, Ansible or Chef 
•Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on prem infrastructure (VMware, Linux, networking fundamentals). 
•Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
•Strong scripting or programming skills (Python, Go, or similar). 
Experience with configuration management, secrets management, and artifact repositories. 
•Familiarity with GitOps workflows and declarative infrastructure patterns. 
•Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, automation, and platform layers. 
Preferred Qualifications 
•Experience developing or extending Terraform modules or custom providers. 
•Experience with Ansible Collections, dynamic inventories, or Ansible Tower/Ansible Automation Platform. 
•Experience with policy as code tools (OPA and Sentinel). 
•Experience with monitoring, observability, and logging platforms. 
•Exposure to SRE practices and reliability engineering. 
Core Technical Skills

NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial organizations around the world are using NVIDIA products to redefine deep learning and data analytics, and to power next-generation data centers. Join the   team   building and advising on many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world!   
 We are looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong consulting and communication skills. This role will engage directly with customers, partners, and cross-functional teams to assess, architect, and guide the implementation of large-scale infrastructure projects. The scope spans system architecture, Kubernetes-based platforms, and automation—serving as both a trusted advisor and a hands-on technical leader.   
 What You’ll Be Doing: 
 - Advise on and help maintain large-scale computational and AI infrastructure, including monitoring, logging, and workload orchestration (Kubernetes and Linux job schedulers).   
- Provide consultative guidance and perform hands-on troubleshooting across the full stack—from bare metal and operating system, through the software stack, container platform, networking, and storage.   
- Assess customer environments and recommend optimized, production-ready Kubernetes-based container platforms integrated with enterprise-grade networking and storage solutions.   
- Serve as a key technical resource: develop, refine, and document standard methodologies and operational guidelines to be shared with internal teams and customer stakeholders.   
- Support Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs to validate new features, architectures, and upgrade approaches.   
- Create and deliver high-quality documentation, including runbooks, onboarding materials, and best-practice guides for customers and internal teams.   
- Act as   the technical leader for assigned customer accounts, providing strategic guidance on DevOps and platform architecture and influencing long-term infrastructure and operations decisions.   
 What We Need to See: 
 - Education & Experience: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields, with 5+ years of professional experience in managing scalable cloud environments and automation engineering roles.   
- Cloud & HPC Expertise: Proven understanding of networking fundamentals,   data center architectures, and hands-on experience managing HPC/AI clusters, including deployment, optimization and troubleshooting.   
- NVIDIA GPU Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and optimizing NVIDIA GPU-accelerated infrastructure, including driver management, CUDA toolkit integration, and GPU workload profiling.   
- Kubernetes & AI/ML Workloads: Extensive experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration, resource scheduling, scaling, and integration with GPU-accelerated and HPC environments.   
- Hardware & Software Knowledge: Strong familiarity with HPC and AI technologies (CPUs, GPUs, high-speed interconnects) and supporting software stacks.   
- Linux & Storage Systems: Deep knowledge of Linux (RedHat, Ubuntu), OS-level security, and protocols.    
- Automation & Observability: Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, configuration management, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform). Experience with observability stacks (Grafana, Loki, Prometheus) for monitoring, logging, and building fault-tolerant systems.   
- Solution Architecture & Customer Engagement: Strong background in crafting scalable solutions and providing consultative support to customers, including leading architectural reviews and presenting to executive stakeholders.   
 Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for software deployment and automation.   
- Solid hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and   its   operators   for   GPU and Network   management .   
- Practical   experience   with   SLURM, MPI,   enroot   and   job   provisioning   
- Experience   with   SW   change   management   of   clusters   across   compute , network and   storage .   
- Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) for provisioning, managing, and monitoring GPU clusters at scale as well as b ackground with RDMA-based fabrics (InfiniBand or RoCE) in HPC or AI environments.   
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 221,250 PLN - 383,500 PLN for Level 3, and 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4.

ROLE SUMMARY  
 Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients.  
 All over the world, Pfizer colleagues work together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Our colleagues can grow and develop a career that offers both individual and company success; be part of an ownership culture that values diversity and where all colleagues are energized and engaged; and can impact the health and lives of millions of people. Pfizer, a global leader in the biopharmaceutical industry, is continuously seeking top talent who are inspired by our purpose to innovate to bring therapies to patients that significantly improve their lives.  
 Pfizer is advancing in Neuroscience, and an integral part of the Migraine Team’s mission is to promote a breakthrough therapy for patients suffering from migraine.   
 The Neuroscience Health & Science Professional (HSP) is responsible for increasing territory sales and relationship development with assigned customers and accounts by engaging in product promotion and determining the best strategies to manage their business.   
 The HSP should possess customer, market, and business acumen, analytical skills, and strong product and disease state knowledge; demonstrate ability to drive sales, promotional and strategic business development and management skills, and in-depth customer engagement expertise both in-person and virtually; demonstrate outstanding communication and teamwork skills; be adept in the operation of digital and virtual tools; and be effective at working remotely in collaboration with cross-functional internal teams to address customer needs and compliantly deliver on Pfizer business objectives.  
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES  
 - Drives sales in assigned territory  
- Engages with customers both face to face and virtually  
- Develops and implements effective business and territory call plans; effectively identifies and implements live/virtual engagement strategies with customer to maximize overall effectiveness and impact  
- Effectively builds rapport and relationships with customers in both live and virtual environments; uses judgment to maintain customer engagement by successfully utilizing existing and ever-changing digital tools effectively for successful customer engagement  
- Understands and leverages internal reports and analytics to assist with identifying, developing, and implementing strategic business opportunities  
- Compliantly leverages product and disease state knowledge to appropriately educate providers on unbranded and branded product value proposition for relevant patient populations and effectively and strategically utilizes approved clinically oriented disease state information and patient resources, as applicable  
- Demonstrates strong teamwork capabilities to collaborate effectively and compliantly across the organization to address customer inquiries and advance Pfizer objectives.  
- Completes all administrative expectations on time and compliantly.  
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS  
 - Bachelor’s Degree  
- Minimum 2 years of experience in one or more of the following OR an associate’s degree with 6+ years of experience; OR high school diploma (or equivalent) with 8+ years of relevant experience:  
- Professional Sales or Promotional Activity  
- Small Business Owner or other Entrepreneurial experience, Marketing, Customer Service and/or Account Management  
- Relevant Healthcare/Scientific roles (e.g., RN, Pharmacist, PT, OT, etc.)  
- Educator (e.g., Teacher, Principal)  
- Full Time Military experience  
- Must live within 25 miles of the border of the territory.  
- Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards.  Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired. 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
 - At least 1 year of pharmaceutical, biotech, medical sales and/or medical related marketing.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 Fixed-term contract 
 Duration: 12 months
 Start Date: February 2027
We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path. 
This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards. 
 Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.
By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.
 Who are we looking for? 
 - You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
- You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
- You are a creative problem-solver
- You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
- You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
- You thrive in a team environment
- You have excellent interpersonal skills
- You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
- You are fluent in English & Danish (essential) 
 What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? 
 The program is structured as follows:
 Introduction Month 
 During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

 Rotations 
 - During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. Current shift openings at this location:
Seasonal Warehouse Worker
Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday 6:00AM-4:00PM
Sunday, Monday, Saturday 6:00AM-6:00PM
 Apply to join our team today!
 Warehouse Worker roles starting at $24.50 per hour. The pay range is $24.50 to
 $26.95 per hour.  
 You may also earn additional compensation in the form of a shift differential, ranging from $2.00 to $3.50 per hour, based on eligibility. 
Please apply with as much open availability as possible! As a progression TM, there is an opportunity to grow your pay based on your tenure in your role. 
 What does a role as a Warehouse Worker look like? 
 - Follow all safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment for all team members.
- Attend safety trainings to learn how to work safely in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
- Pack, load, and ship items to stores and guests.
- Ensure accurate processing of merchandise to our stores and guests.
- Work safely, quickly and efficiently to handle freight and move inventory throughout the warehouse.
- Maintain a neat, clean, and organized work area.
- Report to work on time and complete job tasks as assigned accurately and on time.
- Engage in problem solving to support continuous improvement.
- Maintains positive and respectful attitude while working independently and in a team environment.
 Please note job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
 Job requirements:   
 - Able to lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs. frequently throughout a shift. 
- Able to lift and carry merchandise weighing up to 60 lbs. occasionally throughout a shift. 
- Able to push utility carts up to 60 lbs., use carts, hand trucks, and other equipment to  move items. 
- Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts.  
- Work at a height of up to 40 ft. on a mezzanine (where applicable).  
- Maintain positive and respectful attitude while working independently and in a team environment.
- Able to accurately use basic math skills (counting, addition, subtraction). 
- Able to accurately read labels, tickets, and other product documentation. 
- Able to operate computer systems or handheld devices with minimal direction after  receiving training .
- Good written and oral communication skills 
- Able to be trained on and operate all powered equipment safely (including but not limited  to Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit Down & Standup Forklift), and work at heights of up to 40 ft. where applicable.
- Must be able to understand, speak, and read English with sufficient proficiency to follow  safety and other policies, trainings, and instructions. 
 Food Distribution Center only: 
 - Able to work in various temperature-controlled environments including refrigerator and freezer. 
 ​

 About us: 
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.  Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together. 
 Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right products to our guests faster than before, so that no matter how guests shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they deserve. 
 A role in a Supply Chain Facility means being on the front lines of getting products to our guests and stores as quickly as possible to positively impact thousands of fellow team members and Target guests. There’s so much good work being done, from Operations, where process and problem solving drive our results, to Quality Management, which ensures the right products get to the right places on time. We are always striving to support our team to create an ever-evolving business.  
 Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at   https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits .

description:
Enterprise Architect
 Position Summary
 As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
 In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.
 You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.
 Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.
 The Opportunity
 Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.
 As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:
 - Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
- Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
- Assist organizations in embracing cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
- Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.
 This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.
 What You Will Do
 Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy
 - Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI-powered innovation.
- Translate business priorities into actionable, multi-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
- See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
- Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.
 Lead Enterprise Architecture Build
 - Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
- Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real-time decisioning, and personalization.
- Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based solutions.
- Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long-term scalability.
- Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.
 Drive Alignment and Transformation
 - Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
- Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
- Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
- Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.
 Influence and Encourage
 - Communicate architecture vision, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
- Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
- Advocate for data-driven and AI-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
- Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.
 Contribute to Adobe's Growth
 - Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
- Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
- Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
- Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterpris

 Job Description: 
In this position, you will work in an exciting electron microscopy lab supporting Intel's advanced technology development.
Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
• Responsible for making TEM specimens and/or performing TEM analysis in support of process/product development, qualification and failure analysis.
• Requires use of dual beam FIB for TEM sample preparation and/or TEM for imaging and analysis.
• Continuous upgrading of skillset requires open attitude and ability to learn from others.
• Work is completed according to general instructions and prioritization.
• Some degree of judgment is required in resolving non-standard problems.
• Maintain necessary records and reports.
• Performs other related duties as required or as directed.
• Technical functions in support of engineering activities such as fabrication, failure analysis, technology development, process development, and process integration.
• Conducts engineering tasks and detailed technical procedures to perform sample preparation or imaging using advanced focused-ion-beam and/or transmission electron microscope tools in support of the research and development activities of Intel.
• Work is completed according to general instructions. 
 Qualifications:

The candidate must have at least one of the following:
• Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in a Technical Area (Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics Technology, Material Science or comparable field). OR
• 1 + years of hands-on Lab and or manufacturing experience. 
Preferred Qualifications:
• Technical Certification in Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) sample preparation or imaging.
• 1 + years of military-relevant experience.

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Lead Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering 
Our Purpose:
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people across more than 200 countries and territories worldwide.
We are committed to building an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere—by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Through secure data, trusted networks, strong partnerships, and relentless innovation, we help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses unlock their greatest potential.
About the Role:
Mastercard’s Program aligned Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams are dedicated to delivering a seamless experience for our customers. We achieve this by maintaining every aspect of our Programs infrastructure and technology ecosystem to the highest standards, ensuring compliance with rigorous security requirements.
Within Mastercard, SRE focuses on the reliability and performance of core infrastructure, networks, and foundational services that power our applications. Our mission is to ensure these components operate with excellence, enabling applications to deliver an outstanding customer experience.
In this role, you will join our Payments Network SRE team and take ownership of continuously assessing and elevating the end to end service quality of our platform. You will leverage data to drive root cause analysis and deliver strategic insights to key stakeholders on resource utilization, capacity forecasting, and performance trends—ensuring the availability, scalability, and resilience of our network.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead continuous assessments of the application infrastructure supporting critical Mastercard applications, focusing on health, performance, monitoring and alerting, and capacity analysis. Collaborate with Product and Development teams to forecast growth requirements and ensure scalability and resiliency. 
Champion observability as a core principle for infrastructure services by assessing environments and technologies to uncover gaps in monitoring and alerting. Design and implement strategies to close these gaps, ensuring all infrastructure telemetry is integrated into a unified, single-pane-of-glass view. Build custom dashboards to investigate and perform root cause analysis on complex issues. 
Lead regular incident reviews with internal support teams to ensure root causes are identified. When patterns of failure or compatibility issues between software and infrastructure emerge, develop and implement strategies to remediate or mitigate risks.
Leverage automation and AI technologies to enhance proactive issue detection, enable self-healing capabilities, reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM).
Develop testing and validation plans for new environment builds, disaster recovery exercises and post-maintenance activities to certify environment readiness before customer traffic is routed to it.
Champion continuous learning, development, and knowledge sharing across networking and other infrastructure disciplines to strengthen multi-disciplinary SRE team capabilities. Lead training initiatives for team members and Product and Development on networking aspects of the platforms.
Evaluate vendor hardware, firmware, and software upgrade roadmaps, and conduct proof-of-concept (POC) testing to identify potential risks and opportunities for improvement in upcoming releases.
All about you:
5–10 years of experience in an SRE or SRE related operations role, including 3+ years supporting e commerce, financial services, or large scale SaaS platforms. 
Excellent infrastructure troubleshooting and analytical problem solving skills. 
Strong hands on experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent, with a proven ability to triage and investigate complex issues. 
Familiarity with network telemetry tools such as SolarWinds and NetScout. 
Proficiency in packet level debugging, including capturing traffic with tools like tcpdump and analyzing packets using Wireshark. 
Broad understanding of end to end infrastructure supporting payment platforms—spanning platform services, networking, databases, and storage. 
Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Chef, Ansible, and Terraform, as well as structured data formats (JSON/YAML). 
Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate cross functional troubleshooting efforts and lead RCA processes to closure.

Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 Intel Corporation is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, dedicated to creating technology that changes the world. From powering the cloud to enabling AI, autonomous vehicles, and next-generation computing, Intel's innovations touch nearly every aspect of modern life. With a culture built on curiosity, collaboration, and a relentless drive to push boundaries, Intel offers engineers the opportunity to do the most meaningful work of their careers.
 Intel's Substrate Packaging Technology Development (SPTD) organization is on a mission to be the supplier of choice for leading-edge and affordable substrate packaging solutions. As a critical part of Intel's advanced manufacturing ecosystem, the SPTD team is driving the future of semiconductor packaging — and we're looking for talented engineers to help us get there.
 We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Module Engineer On Shift (MEOS) to join our SPTD team at our state-of-the-art facility in Chandler, Arizona. In this role, you will be a critical part of our 24x7 manufacturing operation, providing real-time support to ensure seamless lot movement through the production line. You'll work directly on the factory floor, solving complex equipment and process challenges, and collaborating with a talented team of engineers and technicians.
 Shift 6 Details: 
 - Hours: 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM (Night Shift)
- Schedule: A lternating Work Weeks: Alternating 3-Day Work Week (Wed, Thurs, Fri) and 4-Day Work Week (Wed, Thurs, Fri, Sat). 
 This position is based in Arizona. Compensation for this role will be determined in accordance with the applicable salary range for the Arizona work location, as well as factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 - Factory Floor Support: Provide hands-on, real-time support for equipment, process, and product issues to maintain continuous 24x7 lot movement through the manufacturing line.
- Shift Communication: Receive written and verbal pass-downs from outgoing shift peers; deliver comprehensive, quality pass-downs to incoming shift teams; align priorities with management at the start of each shift.
- Troubleshooting & Error Recovery: Respond promptly to process issues, perform error recovery, manage lot disposition, and support new tool enabling activities.
- Documentation: Write and update specifications and RFCs (Request for Change) as required to maintain accurate and current process records.
- Inspection & Imaging: Execute non-standard procedures and perform inspection and imaging on panels to collect critical development data.
- Stakeholder Communication: Communicate effectively via email with Tool and Lot Owners regarding key issues, ensuring timely resolution and transparency.
- Ad-Hoc Support: Perform a variety of ad-hoc duties as required by the factory within your specific functional area.
 As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring: 
 - Strong problem-solving instincts — you approach challenges with curiosity and persistence
- Clear and confident communication — you can articulate complex issues clearly to peers, engineers, and stakeholders
- Adaptability — you thrive in a dynamic environment and can pivot quickly when priorities shift
- Self-motivation and initiative — you take ownership of your work and don't wait to be told what to do next
- Team-oriented mindset — you support your colleagues and contribute to a positive, collaborative shift culture
 If you're ready to work on technology that matters — and join a team that's shaping the future of semiconductor packaging — we'd love to hear from you.

 This is an entry level position. You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research and relevant previous job and/or internship experience. This Position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 - Bachelor's degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related discipline with 1+ years of relevant industry experience OR 
- Master's degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related discipline
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 - 1+ years of experience: - Applying Statistical Process Control (SPC) methodologies in a manufacturing environment 
- Hands-on experience in Semiconductor Packaging or Packaging Substrate Manufacturing

NVIDIA is seeking a senior engineering leader to define and scale our ATE development strategy for complex silicon products from new product introduction through high-volume manufacturing. This role leads a global organization responsible for production test architecture, hardware and program development, silicon correlation, quality screening, yield enablement, cost-of-test optimization, and test automation. The ideal candidate brings deep semiconductor test expertise, strong interpersonal leadership, and can drive execution across developing, product engineering, manufacturing, reliability, and supplier ecosystems.
 What you will be doing: 
 - Set the vision, roadmap, and operating model guiding ATE creation throughout new product introductions and sustaining production. 
- Lead and develop a distributed team composed of managers and senior engineers covering test hardware, program development, characterization, correlation, productization, and data-driven test optimization. 
- Drive production test readiness for complex devices, including test coverage, guardband strategy, yield learning, defect screening, quality containment, and test cost reduction. 
- Establish scalable methodologies, standards, release criteria, and quality gates for ATE development and deployment. 
- Partner closely with architecture, circuit build, test integration, product engineering, system test, reliability, silicon operations, manufacturing, and collaborators outside the company to ensure strong design-to-test alignment. 
- Lead the strategy for ATE platform selection, vendor engagement, capacity readiness, and capital planning needed to support product ramps. 
- Use data and analytics to improve silicon correlation, test limits, binning strategies, excursion response, and long-term product quality. 
- Build a high-performance leadership culture through strong hiring, interpersonal development, succession planning, and multi-functional influence. 
 What we need to see: 
 - BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
- 18+ years of relevant semiconductor experience, including 8 + years of management experience. Leading managers and distributed engineering organizations. 
- Deep expertise in ATE development for high-volume silicon, SoC, ASIC, or GPU-class products. 
- Shown success leading organizations through NPI, silicon bring-up, characterization, production ramp, yield improvement, and quality execution. 
- Strong understanding of ATE platforms, test hardware design, test program development, instrumentation, silicon correlation, statistical analysis, and production test methodologies. 
- Consistent track record to partner across design, DFT, product engineering, failure analysis, reliability, manufacturing, and supplier or OSAT ecosystems. 
- Experience owning roadmaps, budgets, staffing plans, and operational priorities for large-scale engineering organizations. 
- Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior collaborators and drive alignment across technical and business teams. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience with GPU, AI, networking, or other high-performance compute products. 
- Track record of reducing test cost while improving outgoing quality and production scalability. 
- Strong background in test automation, data infrastructure, and improvement guided by data insights. 
- Experience building and scaling global test-development organizations across multiple sites and external partners. 
- Familiarity with system-level test, product binning, performance and power optimization, or silicon operations workflows.

Current shift openings at this location:
Seasonal Warehouse Worker
Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 4:00PM-2:00AM
Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday 4:00PM-2:00AM
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday 6:00AM-4:00PM
 Apply to join our team today! 
 Warehouse Worker roles starting at $24.90 per hour. The pay range is $24.90 to $27.90 per hour. 
 You may also earn additional compensation in the form of a shift differential, ranging from $2.00 to $3.50 per hour, based on eligibility. 
Please apply with as much open availability as possible! As a progression TM, there is an opportunity to grow your pay based on your tenure in your role.
 What does a role as a Warehouse Worker look like? 
 - Follow all safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment for all team members.
- Attend safety trainings to learn how to work safely in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
- Pack, load, and ship items to stores and guests.
- Ensure accurate processing of merchandise to our stores and guests.
- Work safely, quickly and efficiently to handle freight and move inventory throughout the warehouse.
- Maintain a neat, clean, and organized work area.
- Report to work on time and complete job tasks as assigned accurately and on time.
- Engage in problem solving to support continuous improvement.
- Maintains positive and respectful attitude while working independently and in a team environment.
 Please note job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
 Job requirements:   
 - Able to lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs. frequently throughout a shift. 
- Able to lift and carry merchandise weighing up to 60 lbs. occasionally throughout a shift. 
- Able to push utility carts up to 60 lbs., use carts, hand trucks, and other equipment to  move items. 
- Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts.  
- Work at a height of up to 40 ft. on a mezzanine (where applicable).  
- Maintain positive and respectful attitude while working independently and in a team environment.

- Able to accurately read labels, tickets, and other product documentation. 
- Able to operate computer systems or handheld devices with minimal direction after  receiving training .
- Good written and oral communication skills

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Manager, Product Development - Adtech 
Who is Mastercard? 
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 
Overview 
The Commerce Media team is looking for a Manager, Product Development to drive delivery of innovative and sustainable Advertiser solutions that yield significant in year revenue and strategic long-term differentiation for Mastercard. 
The role: 
Contribute to the development of product concepts, prototypes, and features; independently owning and delivering key workstreams. 
Work with engineering and CX&D teams on a day-to-day basis to translate strategy into tangible development plans by writing product requirements, prioritizing key milestones and tracking progress with Engineering, TPMs and tech leads. 
Lead the strategy and roadmap for a wide range of capabilities, including technical components. Includes the delivery of new features as well as improvements to existing features. 
Purview for this role will includes, but isn’t limited to features that enable creative decisioning, automation of campaign creation, Offers creation & optimization workflows, as well as specific workstreams to support evolution into ads. 
Support GTM efforts by providing key data points to assist with the creation of collateral that highlights our value proposition. 
Act as a liaison between business units and technical teams, ensuring clarity and alignment throughout the product lifecycle. 
Navigate a matrixed & globally distributed organization to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes within tight timelines. 
Establish a network within the organization by building key relationships with Publisher team counterparts and various stakeholders across Sales, Ops, Legal, Privacy, Strategy, leadership, etc. 
Mentor, develop, and foster the skills of junior product managers. 
Support the creation of business cases and strategic planning for individual product initiatives. 
Drive ideation for new-to-market product features and solutions through extensive internal/external research and workshops. 
All About You 
Extensive experience in product development, including partnering with Engineering teams, rapid opportunity assessment, concept creation, business model innovation, and global in-market testing. 
Deeply disciplined in product management process & tools including; discovery, planning, user journey mappings, prioritization, milestone creation/management, backlog/roadmap management, collaboration with CX & design, KPI measurement, optimization. 
Proven ability to effectively define MVP for new product features while also elevating products from MVP to maturity for existing product features. 
Natural problem solver: analytical, curious, and fact-driven approach to product development. 
Collaborative team player: proven track record in collaborating with multiple cross-functional (both internal and external) teams across multiple locations; facilitating challenging conversations and managing ambiguity. 
Exceptional analytical, verbal, and written communication skills. 
Strong background in translating stakeholder needs into functional specifications, user journeys and process flows. 
Strategic thinker with strong technical acumen and hands-on experience collaborating with technical teams. 
Ability to manage priorities and delegate tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
Familiarity with ML/AI concepts, particularly in working with model‑generated outputs (e.g., optimization models, predictive scoring, or automated decisioning systems). Ability to partner effectively with Data Science teams to interpret model behavior, dependencies, and implications for product design. 
Preferred Skills 
Prior experience in a PM role, or similar, working in agile environments. 
Background in AdTech or MarTech strongly preferred .

job_title: Senior Integrated Marketing Specialist - AI Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.
 Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Enterprise Marketing professional to build and activate AI infrastructure campaigns that resonate with technical and business audiences. This IC3 role combines campaign strategy, content development, and market intelligence to translate evolving AI topics into compelling stories across web, social, video, and other platforms. The work spans deeply technical campaign content and executive thought leadership, requiring close coordination across organizations and agility as the AI industry develops. This role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact workstreams and shape how NVIDIA communicates the value of AI infrastructure to enterprise audiences. 
 What you'll be doing
 - Develop and implement integrated campaigns, from messaging and content planning through activation, optimization, and measurement.
- Create and adapt technically accurate, audience-relevant content across publishing platforms, including campaign and thought-leadership assets.
- Monitor market, ecosystem, and industry trends to rapidly refine campaign narratives, priorities, and channel approaches.
- Partner across product marketing, technical teams, creative, communications, digital, regional marketing, and external collaborators; lead a campaign initiative or major workstream within a larger program.
 What we need to see
 - Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- 4+ years of experience in B2B, enterprise, technology, product, or campaign marketing, including integrated campaigns.
- Strong content development, editorial, and technical storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex concepts clear for enterprise audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional marketing, product, technical, creative, and communications partners.
- Sound judgment and project-management skills to assess market trends, independently lead moderately complex workstreams, manage milestones, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd
 - Experience marketing AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, data center technologies, cloud platforms, or enterprise software.
- Experience creating technical storytelling or thought leadership for developers, IT leaders, data scientists, or executive enterprise audiences.
- Familiarity with the AI ecosystem and using campaign performance insights to refine content, channel strategy, and engagement.
We offer competitive salaries and a generous benefits package. Many consider us one of the technology world’s most sought-after employers. Our workforce includes some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people globally. Due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class teams are rapidly growing so if you're creative and autonomous with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!
 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 108,000 USD - 172,500 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

description:
Role Summary 
 The Director, Thought Leader Engagement (TLEL) is responsible for partnering with marketeers to develop and execute a best-in-class, compliant engagement strategy with national and regional Thought Leaders / Opinion Leaders (OLs) to advance Pfizer’s or Specialty Care’s legitimate business objectives (branded and unbranded) across the Gastroenterology (GI) franchise.
 This role serves as the primary commercial liaison to identify OLs, creating consistent and high-quality One Pfizer experiences while gathering insights that inform brand, franchise, and customer engagement strategies. The Director will partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales Leadership, Market Access, and other cross-functional colleagues to ensure engagement plans are integrated, strategic, and aligned to business priorities.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Thought Leader Engagement & Strategy 
 - Partner with marketeers to develop and execute a strategic OL engagement plan aligned to brand and GI franchise objectives.
 - Support and inform OL engagement strategy development, and execute approved engagement plans in alignment with cross-functional owners.
 - Map the OL community to identify new/emerging OLs based on brand strategies.
 - Map connections and relationships within the Gastroenterology OL community to inform potential engagement strategies and channels.
 - Support the development and execution of individualized OL engagement approaches.
 - Establish, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with national and regional Thought Leaders / Opinion Leaders.
 - Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned OLs, ensuring a consistent and coordinated Pfizer presence.
 - Deliver a One Pfizer experience by aligning engagement activities across functions.
 - Identify ways to advance and expand engagement with OLs through innovative initiatives, including digital and novel engagement models.
 Insight Generation & Application 
 - Lead insight gathering to support Gastroenterology brand and other Pfizer objectives through 1:1 engagements and small group meetings.
 - Capture, synthesize, and share insights on OL expertise and experience, brand perceptions, treatment patterns, unmet needs, and market dynamics that are capable of being turned into actionable commercial recommendations.
 - Maintain consistent documentation of insights to support longitudinal understanding of relationships, enable knowledge sharing, and inform future engagement.
 - Inform the development and execution of HCP and customer engagement strategies.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 - Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales, Market Access, and other internal stakeholders to align OL engagement with broader commercial and medical plans.
 - Support brand and franchise planning through OL insights and strategic input.
 - Collaborate with global and regional colleagues, as appropriate, to align engagement approaches.
 Congress, Meetings & Engagement Metrics 
 - Support Marketing and Medical in developing OL engagement approaches for national and regional congresses and meetings through insights, including recommendations and coordination.
 - Plan and coordinate OL interactions at meetings in partnership with brand teams.
 - Establish and track engagement metrics, including post-engagement evaluations and performance against objectives.
 - Maintain up-to-date OL lists and track engagement activity.
 Compliance & Governance 
 - Ensure all OL engagements are conducted in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.
 - Partner with marketing project owner, legal, and compliance teams to ensure consistent and appropriate engagement practices.
 Basic Qualifications 
 - Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
 - Approximately 8–10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or related healthcare industries.
 - Experience in commercial, medical affairs, marketing, sales leadership, strategy, or customer engagement roles.
 - Proven ability to build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with external Thought Leaders and internal stakeholders.
 - Demonstrated success working in a cross-functional, matrixed environment with influence-based leadership.
 - Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable strategies.
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
 - Ability to travel approximately 50%, including evenings and weekends as required.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 - Gastroenterology experience.
 - Experience designing and executing Thought Leader or Opinion Leader engagement programs.
 - Science or clinical background.

 - Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
 - High emotional intelligence and executive presence.
 - Ability to influence without authority.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 Fixed-term contract 
 Duration: 12 months
 Start Date: February 2027
We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.
This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards .
Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddies who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.
By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career . We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.
 Who are we looking for? 
 - You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
- You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
- You are a creative problem-solver
- You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
- You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
- You thrive in a team environment
- You have excellent interpersonal skills
- You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
- You are fluent in English & French is Essential 
 What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? 
 The program is structured as follows: 
 Introduction Month 
 During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:
