- Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
- Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni
 Rotations 
 - During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles . The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
- If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales , you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Apply to join our team today! 
 Warehouse Associate roles starting at $20.70 per hour. The pay range is $20.70 to $22.80 per hour.  
Warehouse Worker roles starting at $23.10 per hour. The pay range is $23.10 to $25.55 per hour.  
 You may also earn additional compensation in the form of a shift differential, ranging from $2.00 to $3.50 per hour, based on eligibility. 
Please apply with as much open availability as possible! As a progression TM, there is an opportunity to grow your pay based on your tenure in your role. 
 What does a role in Warehouse Operations look like? 
 - Follow all safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment for all team members.
- Attend safety trainings to learn how to work safely in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
- Pack, load, and ship items to stores and guests.
- Ensure accurate processing of merchandise to our stores and guests.
- Work safely, quickly and efficiently to handle freight and move inventory throughout the warehouse.
- Maintain a neat, clean, and organized work area.
- Report to work on time and complete job tasks as assigned accurately and on time.
- Engage in problem solving to support continuous improvement
- Maintains positive and respectful attitude while working independently and in a team environment.
 Please note job duties may change at any time due to business needs.  
 Based on business needs and requirements for a role within Warehouse Operations, you will be considered for the role of Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate based on your responses to the questionnaire and assessment you’ll complete during the application process. Requirements associated for each of these roles are outlined below. Additional details on the specific job duties for each of these roles are provided via links at the bottom of this page. 
 Job requirements for both Warehouse Worker & Warehouse Associate: 
 - Able to lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs. frequently throughout a shift.
- Able to lift and carry merchandise weighing up to 60 lbs. occasionally throughout a shift.
- Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts. 
- Maintain positive and respectful attitude while working independently and in a team environment.
- Able to accurately use basic math skills (counting, addition, subtraction).
- Able to accurately read labels, tickets, and other product documentation.
- Able to operate computer systems or handheld devices with minimal direction after receiving training.
- Good written and oral communication skills
- Must be able to understand, speak, and read English with sufficient proficiency to follow safety and other policies, trainings, and instructions. 
 Additional Job Requirements: 
 Warehouse Worker only: 
 - Able to be trained on and operate all powered equipment safely (including but not limited to Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit Down & Standup Forklift ), and work at heights of up to 40ft where applicable. 
- Work at a height of up to 40 ft on a mezzanine (where applicable)  
 Food Distribution Center only: 
 - Able to work in various temperature-controlled environments including refrigerator and freezer for majority of shift.

 About us: 
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.  Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 Intel Corporation is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, dedicated to creating technology that changes the world. From powering the cloud to enabling AI, autonomous vehicles, and next-generation computing, Intel's innovations touch nearly every aspect of modern life. With a culture built on curiosity, collaboration, and a relentless drive to push boundaries, Intel offers engineers the opportunity to do the most meaningful work of their careers.
 Intel's Substrate Packaging Technology Development (SPTD) organization is on a mission to be the supplier of choice for leading-edge and affordable substrate packaging solutions. As a critical part of Intel's advanced manufacturing ecosystem, the SPTD team is driving the future of semiconductor packaging — and we're looking for talented engineers to help us get there.
 We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Module Engineer On Shift (MEOS) to join our SPTD team at our state-of-the-art facility in Chandler, Arizona. In this role, you will be a critical part of our 24x7 manufacturing operation, providing real-time support to ensure seamless lot movement through the production line. You'll work directly on the factory floor, solving complex equipment and process challenges, and collaborating with a talented team of engineers and technicians.
 Shift 4 Details: 
 - Hours: 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM (Night Shift)
- Schedule: Alternating 3- and 4-day work weeks (Sunday–Tuesday, with alternating Saturdays) — giving you more days off than a traditional 5-day schedule!
 This position is based in Arizona. Compensation for this role will be determined in accordance with the applicable salary range for the Arizona work location, as well as factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 - Factory Floor Support: Provide hands-on, real-time support for equipment, process, and product issues to maintain continuous 24x7 lot movement through the manufacturing line.
- Shift Communication: Receive written and verbal pass-downs from outgoing shift peers; deliver comprehensive, quality pass-downs to incoming shift teams; align priorities with management at the start of each shift.
- Troubleshooting & Error Recovery: Respond promptly to process issues, perform error recovery, manage lot disposition, and support new tool enabling activities.
- Documentation: Write and update specifications and RFCs (Request for Change) as required to maintain accurate and current process records.
- Inspection & Imaging: Execute non-standard procedures and perform inspection and imaging on panels to collect critical development data.
- Stakeholder Communication: Communicate effectively via email with Tool and Lot Owners regarding key issues, ensuring timely resolution and transparency.
- Ad-Hoc Support: Perform a variety of ad-hoc duties as required by the factory within your specific functional area.
 As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring: 
 - Strong problem-solving instincts — you approach challenges with curiosity and persistence
- Clear and confident communication — you can articulate complex issues clearly to peers, engineers, and stakeholders
- Adaptability — you thrive in a dynamic environment and can pivot quickly when priorities shift
- Self-motivation and initiative — you take ownership of your work and don't wait to be told what to do next
- Team-oriented mindset — you support your colleagues and contribute to a positive, collaborative shift culture
 If you're ready to work on technology that matters — and join a team that's shaping the future of semiconductor packaging — we'd love to hear from you.
 Qualifications: 
 This is an entry level position. You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research and relevant previous job and/or internship experience. This Position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 - Bachelor's degree in materials engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, chemistry, physics, or a related discipline with 1+ years of relevant industry experience OR
- Master's degree in materials engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, chemistry, physics, or a related discipline
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 - 1+ years of experience: - Applying Statistical Process Control (SPC) methodologies in a manufacturing environment
- Hands-on experience in Semiconductor Packaging or Packaging Substrate Manufacturing

Experienced Hire 
 Shift:
Shift 4 (United States of America)

US, Arizona, Phoenix

Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Associate Analyst, Account Management 
Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program? 
Throughout this 18-month program, you'll develop the ability to connect ideas, people, and markets to drive commercial impact. Through hands-on experiences, cross-functional projects, and structured learning opportunities, you'll gain exposure to multiple areas of Mastercard's business while building broad business acumen and a global perspective. You'll collaborate with teams across functions, contribute to strategic initiatives, and strengthen the skills needed to solve complex business challenges. This experience will help you build a well-rounded commercial mindset and prepare you for a variety of career paths across Mastercard's global organization. 
Global Markets 
This role is part of the Global Markets business unit, which offers a unique opportunity to experience 2 x nine-month rotations across curated career tracks, designed to enrich and diversify the Launch of your career, alongside enhancing your professional growth as part of the Global program that owns this initiative. 
Career Track 1. Sales and Business Development 
As part of our Sales and Business Development track, you can expect to focus on strategic sales planning and consultative and solution selling. 
These teams provide: 
Product expertise and help leverage Mastercard integrated solutions to drive sales and revenue goals 
Is responsible for setting sales strategies as it relates to products that are aligned with geographical strategy and help identify and close sales leads 
Market intelligence to product developers and managers to support design, development and implementation efforts 
Career Track 2. Product Management and Solutions 
As part of our Product Management and Solutions track, you can expect to focus on user experience, product performance and ongoing management, customer needs and insights and architecting solutions. 
These teams provide: 
The overall coordination, status reporting, financials, schedules and stability of project-oriented work efforts, ensuring that project goals and objectives are met within agreed time, scope and resource requirements 
Detailed project plans and manages all implementation processes within budget constraints 
What we’re looking for: 
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, with an anticipated graduation date between March 2026 and August 2027 
Available to start 1st March 2027
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients.  Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities. 
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities. 
Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 - Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 Join NVIDIA's Design-for-Test Engineering team in Santa Clara, CA, where we are driven by a passion for innovation and excellence. We have transformed the industry over twenty years through the invention of the GPU. This powerful technology changed modern computer graphics and parallel computing. Our latest innovations support progress in AI. We keep evolving to solve emerging challenges. As a Senior DFT - Silicon Validation Engineer, you will work on ground breaking technologies in DFT to accelerate and left shift silicon validation of the most complex semiconductor chips.
 What you'll be doing: 
 As a member of our team, you will collaborate with multi-functional teams to drive the silicon validation of NVIDIA's chips. In this role you will drive the end to end DFT architecture and methodologies to accelerate the post silicon bring up & characterization. You will collaborate across functions to help define the next generation test strategies for ATE for our product roadmap. You will lead early silicon validation for complex SoC or equivalent experience. Your tasks include planning from architecture and development, performing chip validation on ATE, debugging test content, and analyzing silicon behavior under various operating conditions. You will identify failure root causes and collaborate with a multi-functional team to ensure a strong production ramp. Your role is pivotal in validating and ramping up the yield for our chips, making a significant impact on NVIDIA's technological advancements.
 What we need to see: 
 - BSEE (or equivalent experience) with 8+, MSEE with 5+ years of experience, or PhD with 3+ years in DFT or related domains
- Expertise in silicon debug and bring-up & productization of DFT features.
- Demonstrated leadership in driving yield ramp and waste reduction for multiple products.
- Hands on experience in pre-silicon validation for various DFT features.
- Outstanding written and oral communication skills with the curiosity to work on rare challenges.
- Strong programming and scripting skills in Perl, Python, or Tcl desired
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Proven track record of successfully implementing advanced DFT methodologies in groundbreaking semiconductor technologies
- Strong knowledge of high-speed protocols and semiconductor process technology
- Knowledge of industry-standard DFT tools and software
- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to overcoming technical challenges
 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ 
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD for Level 4, and 196,000 USD - 310,500 USD for Level 5. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

The role helps ensure U.S. Commercial remains at the forefront of AI innovation while maintaining focus on business value, technical feasibility, enterprise readiness, and responsible adoption.
 The Director partners across AI Partnerships & Ecosystem, Product Management, AI Applications, Data Strategy, Transformation & Delivery, Governance, and Digital to convert external signals into a prioritized pipeline of opportunities, experiments, and roadmap recommendations. When an opportunity requires external engagement, the Director provides the technical and strategic assessment and transitions the opportunity to the AI Partnerships & Ecosystem Lead for partner engagement, coordination, and ongoing relationship management.
 WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
 AI is evolving faster than traditional business and technology planning cycles. New foundation models, agent frameworks, industry-specific solutions, and commercial use cases emerge continuously.
 To maintain leadership in AI-enabled customer engagement and commercial operations, U.S. Commercial requires a dedicated capability focused on separating meaningful innovation from short-term hype, identifying strategic opportunities early, and determining where to invest, experiment, partner, incubate, or scale.
 This role ensures U.S. Commercial is not simply reacting to AI change but proactively shaping its future AI roadmap and external innovation agenda.
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
 1. U.S. Commercial AI Horizon Scanning
 • Continuously monitor emerging AI technologies, vendors, startups, research, industry developments, and competitive activity relevant to U.S. Commercial.
 • Track advances across generative AI, agentic systems, multimodal AI, intelligent automation, knowledge systems, customer engagement technology, commercial analytics, and AI infrastructure.
 • Maintain a structured horizon-scanning framework that categorizes developments by strategic relevance, maturity, feasibility, and potential business impact.
 • Produce concise executive updates on significant developments and their implications for U.S. Commercial.
 • Identify signals that should influence future Commercial Engine, product, architecture, and transformation roadmaps.
 2. AI Innovation Assessment
 • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and capabilities against U.S. Commercial priorities.
 • Assess technical feasibility, scalability, differentiation, data requirements, integration considerations, and enterprise readiness.
 • Distinguish meaningful commercial opportunities from short-term market hype.
 • Create repeatable evaluation frameworks for AI products, vendors, models, platforms, and partnerships.
 • Recommend whether opportunities should be monitored, tested, partnered, incubated, scaled, or retired.
 3. U.S. Commercial Opportunity Identification
 • Identify emerging AI capabilities that can create value across customer engagement, marketing, market access, patient solutions, insights and analytics, commercial operations, field enablement, and the Commercial Engine.
 • Translate external AI developments into potential U.S. Commercial use cases and future-state capabilities.
 • Develop concept papers, opportunity briefs, and strategic recommendations for senior leaders.
 • Partner with Product Management and Transformation teams to shape future investment and experimentation priorities.
 • Connect emerging technologies to U.S. Commercial strategy and transformation roadmaps.
 4. External Innovation and Ecosystem Assessment
 • Maintain intelligence on the external AI ecosystem, including startups, technology companies, academic institutions, research organizations, and industry innovators.
 • Identify emerging capabilities that may warrant further evaluation or partnership.
 • Lead the technical and strategic assessment of external capabilities for U.S. Commercial, including strategic fit, differentiation, feasibility, enterprise readiness, and potential value.
 • Partner with the AI Partnerships & Ecosystem Lead to determine the appropriate engagement and partnership pathway.
 • Provide clear recommendations on whether opportunities should be monitored, tested, partnered, incubated, scaled, or retired.

The Opportunity
 What happens when data, AI, and great engineering come together to solve problems at Adobe's scale?
 Adobe is looking for a Director of Solution Engineering to help answer that question.
 This team works at the intersection of business strategy, software engineering, digital experiences, data, and AI. The challenges are complex, the opportunities are significant, and the impact reaches across Adobe. From helping leaders explore new opportunities to building capabilities that become part of how teams work every day, the work is varied, collaborative, and deeply rewarding.
 In this role, you'll lead a team focused on transforming ideas into solutions that can be reused across the company. You'll help shape how Adobe approaches data, automation, and AI while working alongside talented leaders in Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Platform organizations.
 Just as importantly, you'll help build an environment where people can learn, grow, take ownership, and do meaningful work. If you enjoy developing leaders, solving difficult challenges, and influencing how technology enables business success, we'd love to talk.
 What You'll Do
 - Lead and grow a team of managers, architects, and solution engineers who help Adobe solve complex business and technology challenges.
- Partner with leaders across Adobe to understand opportunities, define priorities, and identify where data can create meaningful impact.
- Work with teams to transform business needs into data products, services, and capabilities that can be adopted and reused across the company.
- Help shape trusted data foundations that make information easier to discover, understand, and use.
- Guide the creation of AI-enabled and data-driven experiences that improve how teams work and make decisions.
- Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Platform teams to bring ideas from concept to adoption.
- Encourage practical, thoughtful use of AI, automation, and modern engineering approaches that help teams spend more time innovating and less time on repetitive work.
- Establish solution patterns, reference implementations, and best practices that help teams move faster while maintaining quality.
- Support the growth of future leaders through coaching, mentorship, feedback, and career development.
- Foster an inclusive environment where people feel empowered to contribute, experiment, learn, and succeed.
 What You'll Bring
 - 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution engineering, product development, data and analytics, consulting, or related technology fields.
- Experience leading technical teams, including managers and senior individual contributors.
- A strong foundation engineering principles, system design, and modern development practices.
- Experience working with mobile applications, client-side technologies, SDKs, instrumentation frameworks, digital experiences, or event-driven systems.
- Familiarity with the full journey of data, from client instrumentation and event collection through reporting, analytics, automation, and AI experiences.
- Experience helping teams navigate ambiguity, align around shared goals, and deliver results in complex environments.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build trust across technical and non-technical audiences.
- A passion for coaching others and helping teams grow.
- Curiosity, adaptability, and a desire to learn.
 Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field preferred. Equivalent practical experience is welcomed.

description:
Work location : Savski Marof
 Use Your Power for Purpose 
 At Pfizer, we believe that every role contributes to our mission of improving patients' lives.
 We are looking for an Automation Engineer to support DeltaV-based manufacturing control systems in a GMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
 This role is ideal for an engineer with a solid Distributed Control System (DCS) background who is looking to further develop expertise in DeltaV, batch automation (ISA-88 principles), and manufacturing systems. While DeltaV experience is preferred, candidates with experience on Honeywell, Yokogawa, ABB, Siemens PCS7, or similar DCS platforms are encouraged to apply.
Responsibilities 
 - Support and maintain manufacturing automation systems.
- Troubleshoot and modify batch applications, recipes, and control strategies.
- Support DeltaV configuration, testing, and operational activities.
- Investigate and resolve automation, hardware, and communication issues.
- Work closely with Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance teams to support manufacturing.
- Participate in commissioning, qualification, and change control activities.
- Contribute to system improvements and continuous optimization initiatives.
 Key Requirements 
 - BSc/MSc degree in electrical engineering, automation, computer science, or equivalent.
- Minimum 5 years of experience with industrial DCS systems.
- DeltaV experience preferred but not mandatory.
- Strong understanding of batch automation concepts and ISA-88 standards.
- Experience troubleshooting automation applications and process control systems.
- Basic knowledge of automation hardware, controllers, I/O systems, and field instrumentation.
- Basic understanding of virtualized infrastructure
- Basic knowledge of industrial networking, including switches, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
- Basic understanding of Windows Server environments, Active Directory, and domain administration.
- Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as OPC, Modbus TCP/IP, Ethernet/IP, or AS-i.
- Experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated manufacturing environment is an advantage.
- Technical documentation/report writing ability.
- Fluent English communication skills.
- Fluent Croatian is preferred. 
 Candidate’s profile 
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and develop new technical skills.
- Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to take ownership.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
- Willing to participate in shift work (morning and afternoon shifts during the batch production), after-hours support, and on-call rotations (for night shifts and holidays).
 What we offer: 
 - Organized transport to and from the site.
- Hybrid work model: on-site presence most of the week, with the option to work from home one day per week.
- Yearly pay increase and bonus depending on performance. 
- Work with modern automated systems.  
- Strong education program.  
- Christmas, Easter and holiday bonus.  
- Affordable meals in an on-site cafeteria.  
- Free day in a month of birthday and for prevalent onsite work.
- Opportunities for career enhancement and development.  
- Further professional development in a supportive environment.  
- Free psychotherapy and coaching sessions for you and people close to you.
- Bravo employee recognition system.  
- Opportunity for working on projects with other Pfizer sites and locations.  
- Free fruit and hot beverages on the site.
 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 
Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. This is to be used solely for accommodation requests with respect to the accessibility of our website, online application process and/or interviewing. Requests for any other reason will not be returned.
 To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on  Pfizer Careers .

 Job Description: 
 Intel is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, driving innovation that shapes the future of technology. Our Substrate Packaging Technology Development (SPTD) organization is at the forefront of advanced packaging solutions, with a mission to be the supplier of choice for leading-edge and affordable substrate packaging. At Intel, we believe in creating an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative workplace where every team member plays a vital role in changing the world through technology. 
 We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Module Engineer On Shift (MEOS) to join our SPTD team in Chandler, Arizona. In this role, you will be a critical part of our 24x7 manufacturing operation, providing real-time factory support to ensure seamless lot movement through the production line. You will work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your problem-solving skills and engineering expertise will directly impact the quality and efficiency of our substrate packaging manufacturing processes.
 Shift 5 Details: 
 - Shift Hours: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Schedule: Alternating 3- and 4-day work weeks (Sunday–Tuesday and alternating Wednesday)
 This position is based in Arizona. Compensation for this role will be determined in accordance with the applicable salary range for the Arizona work location, as well as factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 - Factory Floor Support: Provide hands-on, real-time support for equipment, process, and product issues to maintain continuous 24x7 lot movement through the manufacturing line.
- Shift Communication: Receive written and verbal pass-downs from outgoing shift peers; deliver comprehensive, quality pass-downs to incoming shift teams; align priorities with management at the start of each shift.
- Troubleshooting & Error Recovery: Respond promptly to process issues, perform error recovery, manage lot disposition, and support new tool enabling activities.
- Documentation: Write and update specifications and RFCs (Request for Change) as required to maintain accurate and current process records.
- Inspection & Imaging: Execute non-standard procedures and perform inspection and imaging on panels to collect critical development data.
- Stakeholder Communication: Communicate effectively via email with Tool and Lot Owners regarding key issues, ensuring timely resolution and transparency.
- Ad-Hoc Support: Perform a variety of ad-hoc duties as required by the factory within your specific functional area.
 As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring: 
 - Strong Problem-Solving Skills – You approach challenges with curiosity and a solutions-oriented mindset.
- Excellent Communication – You communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing, with peers, engineers, and stakeholders.
- Adaptability – You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can pivot quickly when priorities shift.
- Self-Motivation – You are a self-starter who can manage your own workload while also contributing to team success.
- Collaborative Spirit – You work well with others and understand the importance of teamwork in a manufacturing environment.
- Attention to Detail – You take pride in accuracy and thoroughness in everything you do.
 If you are passionate about semiconductor technology and want to be part of a team that is shaping the future of advanced packaging, we want to hear from you!

Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research and relevant previous job and/or internship experience. This Position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

 - Bachelor's degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience
- OR master’s degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related discipline
- Relevant experience will be any of the following: - Metrology Tools
- Exposure Lithography tools
- Laser Tools
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 - 2+ years of experience in: - Statistical Process Control (SPC), Metrology tool recipe creation, and tool troubleshooting
- Semiconductor Packaging or Packaging Substrate Manufacturing

 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis. 
 We are seeking a high-caliber Account Executive with a "mission-first" mindset to drive digital transformation across the Combatant Commands (COCOMs) . This isn't just about selling software; it’s about delivering the Integrated Deterrence and Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) capabilities required for the modern battlefield.
You will be the primary strategist for navigating the complex procurement and operational environments of organizations like INDOPACOM, EUCOM, CENTCOM, and SOCOM . You’ll bridge the gap between tactical needs at the edge and enterprise-scale SaaS solutions.
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Mission Alignment: Identify and map Salesforce’s SaaS/PaaS capabilities to specific COCOM mission requirements, including readiness, logistics, situational awareness, and partner nation collaboration.
- Strategic Navigation: Navigate the unique funding streams of the COCOMs (e.g., O&M, Procurement, and RDT&E) and work closely with Service Components and DISA.
- Executive Relationship Management: Build and maintain deep-rooted relationships with Flag Officers, SES-level leadership, and J-code directors (J1–J9).
- Ecosystem Orchestration: Collaborate with Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, and the broader defense industrial base to deliver "Mission Ready" solutions on the Salesforce Government Cloud.
- Pipeline Excellence: Manage the full sales lifecycle—from initial mission discovery and "Art of the Possible" demos to closing complex, multi-million dollar ACV deals.

description:
We are currently seeking a Field Applications Engineer focused on production at scale to join our dedicated and hardworking team. At NVIDIA, we are leading the AI computing revolution, creating innovative deep learning solutions that are transforming industries globally. As a member of our team, you will play a vital role in ensuring the reliability, manufacturability, and quality of our GPU products across production and deployment environments. If you have a strong passion for root cause analysis, yield improvement, and working with cross-functional engineering teams, this is an excellent opportunity for you to make a meaningful contribution!
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Be a technical specialist on GPU and networking products, directly supporting manufacturing, quality, and failure analysis teams to improve product reliability and yield. 
- Actively establish and nurture technical relationships with internal engineering teams, manufacturing partners, and quality teams. 
-  Identify system failure modes, manufacturing risks, and product requirements to drive corrective actions and design/process improvements. 
- Frequent on-site presence in labs or manufacturing sites to diagnose, reproduce, and resolve hardware and system-level failures. 
- Support the product lifecycle from NPI (New Product Introduction) through high-volume manufacturing and field returns, ensuring quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. 
-  Develop failure analysis methodologies, test plans, and diagnostic tools for hardware validation. 
- Provide technical training and documentation to manufacturing, test, and quality teams on failure modes and debugging techniques. 
- Establish strong communication channels and collaborative relationships with cross-functional teams (design, validation, manufacturing and quality) to drive issue resolution, root cause determination, and corrective actions. 
 What we need to see: 
 - BS or MS in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Computer Science (or equivalent experience). 
- 4+ years of work-related experience in the high-tech electronics industry, particularly in manufacturing, failure analysis, validation, or hardware debug roles. 
- Capable of excelling in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment. 
- Strong ability to manage multiple failure investigations, escalations, and yield improvement initiatives. 
- Expert analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
- Strong time management and organizational skills for coordinating complex failure analysis and cross-functional investigations. 
- Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly present failure analysis results and collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams and management.  
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience with ARM and NVIDIA GPU development. 
- Knowledge of Embedded Linux Systems, APIs, and system-level debugging tools for root cause analysis. 
- Experience working with manufacturing partners, ODMs/OEMs, or reliability/quality teams in high-volume production environments. 
- In-depth understanding of CPU/GPU architecture and system-level failure mechanisms. 
 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

description:
The Opportunity
 Ready to build the media planning playbook for one of the world's most recognized brands? Adobe is establishing a new in-house media planning function to take direct ownership of end-to-end media buying and develop an AI-driven engine for global advertising execution. As Senior Media Planner, this role will translate regional media strategy into tactical media plans for one or more paid channels — starting with Meta, TikTok, and Snap — converting strategy into plans the buy desk can implement directly. It's an early opportunity to help shape how Adobe plans and buys media for years to come!
 What the Role Does
 This role sits between the media strategy teams and the buy desk, making sure every plan is platform-native and ready to execute! The Senior Media Planner builds tactical plans for assigned channels — audience targeting, budget splits, flighting, and placement — based on regional media strategy, and stays in daily contact with the local strategy team to maintain alignment. Keeping pace with platforms that change their ad products and targeting tools every quarter takes staying current and applying that knowledge consistently across every plan.
 Finished plans get handed to Adobe's India-based media-buying team for execution. This role flags blockers and resolves them against the team's established process. Where it fits, Adobe's own marketing technology — GenPem, AEP, RTCDP — gets built into the plan, putting Adobe's platforms to work on its own advertising. Before anything moves to the buy desk, campaigns are tagged, organized, and quality-checked against Ops standards, with local nuance (language, regulatory, pricing) layered on top of consistent global planning practices.
 This role will also partner with regional strategists and analysts to review campaign reporting and translate results into optimizations: budget shifts, targeting changes, and creative refreshes for their channel(s). Performance trends, platform changes, and new targeting or data-sharing opportunities get surfaced back to the Director of Media Planning and the broader team. The role also helps shape a consistent quarterly planning process and works directly with platform partners to identify testing and beta opportunities each cycle.
 Scope & Reporting
 This is an individual contributor role, one of a global team of seven Media Planners reporting to the US-based Director of Media Planning. The role works closely with, but does not manage, the India-based buy desk, analytics, media strategy, and engineering partners. Initial focus is paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap), with scope expected to grow over time.
 First 90 Days
 During the first quarter, the goal is to ramp fast and build trust. Become proficient in Adobe's audience segments, brand guidelines, and channel mix, and work on building relationships with regional strategists regarding media objectives and planning cadence. Complete the buy desk handoff process for at least one full plan submission. You will audit current tagging, naming, and QC practices against new Ops standards. You will establish a regular cadence with regional strategy counterparts and the India-based buying team.
 What's Needed to Succeed
 - 5+ years in digital advertising or media planning/buying, with hands-on experience in at least one of Meta, TikTok, or Snap
- Strong working knowledge of platform ad managers, audience targeting tools, and campaign measurement
- Experience managing multi-market activations, including platform setup across a wide range of markets and languages
- A track record of delivering performance-focused paid social campaigns
- Comfort reading campaign dashboards and working with analysts to shape concrete optimization recommendations
- Ability to translate strategic briefs into detailed, executable media plans
- Clear communication across regional and offshore teams, holding to global standards while adapting to local needs
- Strong attention to detail — comfortable owning QA, QC, and documentation for assigned plans
 Nice-to-Haves
 - Familiarity with AI-driven media buying, including executing buys through LLM-based tools like Meta's MCP
- Experience with Adobe's marketing and advertising tools (GenPem, AEP, RTCDP)
- Experience working with an offshore or outsourced buying/execution team
- Background spanning both B2B and consumer advertising
- Agency experience, or exposure to a newly formed team — ideally at a company insourcing media execution
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar

description:
ABOUT THE TEAM 
 Join the JAPAC Legal team, which leads all aspects of legal support for Adobe across the Asia Pacific region — spanning Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, India, Korea, Japan, and the Greater China area including Hong Kong and Taiwan. We are a highly collaborative team, and our mission is to play a key role in driving regional growth while giving our business partners the best possible experience working with Legal.
 THE OPPORTUNITY 
 The Associate Senior Legal Counsel will be based in Seoul, Korea , reporting to the Director & Associate General Counsel in Singapore. In this role, you will act as the main legal point of contact coordinating Adobe's Korea business with opportunities to cross-support other Asia Pacific markets.
 Serving as a trusted legal advisor to the Sales team in Korea, you will help structure deals. You will also help close deals using sound legal judgment and practical, results-focused advice. This includes reviewing and negotiating various types of commercial agreements, such as enterprise licensing transactions, collaborations with partners, and consulting engagements. You will also be providing legal support across complex regulatory compliances, anti-piracy initiatives, and engaging directly with functional teams to drive solutions.
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Commercial 
 - Review, draft, and negotiate a broad range of contracts related to commercial dealings, including enterprise software and cloud licensing agreements, partner agreements, and consulting agreements.
- Serve as the primary legal partner to Sales teams in Korea, providing timely, practical, and results-focused guidance to advance deals and close transactions using ethical and sound business practices.
- Review and advise on marketing activities in the region, including promotions and contests, and ensure marketing activities follow local fair trade and consumer protection laws.
 Anti-Piracy and License Compliance 
 - Support Korea anti-piracy enforcement and license compliance programs in market.
 Regulatory Compliance, Policy and Disputes 
 - Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in Korea relevant to Adobe's business, including data protection, AI regulation, digital markets, and software/technology policy, and provide timely internal briefings to the Legal and business teams.
- Track enforcement trends and regulatory guidance from key Korean agencies (including the PIPC, KFTC, and MSIT) and work closely with internal functions to assess implications for Adobe's products, agreements, and business practices.
- Liaise with industry associations and peer counsel networks to stay current on emerging policy developments affecting the technology sector in Korea.
- Manage matters handled by outside counsel, collaborating with corporate litigation counsel to coordinate any disputes or litigation arising in Korea.
 Employee Experience and Compliance Support 
 - Provide local legal support as needed on human resources and compliance matters, including working with regional employment and compliance counsel in implementing policies and processes, ensuring compliance with local employment laws, and assisting with managing employment disputes or investigations that may arise.
 Others 
 - Support the procurement organization on vendor and supplier contracting.
- Provide training and guidance to Sales, marketing, and other relevant teams on Adobe's corporate policies and legal processes.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams on global and regional legal initiatives and process improvement projects.
- Perform other legal duties as reasonably required.
 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED 
 - Qualification as an attorney-at-law in Korea preferred, with approximately 8 - 9 years of post-qualification experience. Otherwise, qualification as an attorney in the US, England, Australia, or a similar jurisdiction is required. You should have close to 8 to 9 years of experience as legal counsel in Korea.
- Work history spanning both private practice in a reputable law firm and an in-house legal team at a large multinational company is strongly preferred.
- Native written and oral proficiency in Korean, and excellent written and oral proficiency in English.
- Demonstrated experience handling complex commercial and technology licensing matters independently, with strong judgment on when to raise highly complex issues with significant potential risk.
- Experience in or proficiency with AI, privacy and litigation is highly desirable. Otherwise, demonstrate a keen interest and drive to develop in these areas.
- Advanced knowledge of Korean laws, policies and industry trends, with a clear understanding of Adobe's current and future technologies, strategies, and competitors.
 SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES 
 - Lives our Values and operates with the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and integrity.
- Curious and eager to grow! Embraces continuous learning - proactively keeps pace with developments in technology law, AI,

 Job Description: 
 Intel is seeking an AI Infrastructure Solution Architect Intern to join our AI Platforms team. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to support AI accelerator platforms, cluster deployments, system validation, and AI workload benchmarking. This role provides hands-on experience across AI infrastructure, system software, cluster operations, firmware debugging, and end-to-end AI solution development.
The ideal candidate is passionate about AI systems, computer architecture, Linux, and large-scale computing environments, and enjoys solving complex technical problems.
 Responsibilities 
 AI Infrastructure and Cluster Operations: 
 - Assist in deploying and validating AI accelerator systems and multi-node AI clusters.
- Support cluster bring-up activities, including system provisioning, software installation, and health verification.
- Execute performance benchmarks and collect system telemetry.
- Help troubleshoot system, networking, and software issues in AI environments.
 System Debugging and Validation: 
 - Analyze hardware, firmware, driver, and software logs to identify failures.
- Assist with validation of BIOS, firmware, and system software configurations.
- Support development of test plans and automated validation workflows.
- Participate in root-cause investigations of system performance and stability issues.
- AI/ML Workloads
- Deploy and evaluate AI models using frameworks such as PyTorch and vLLM.
- Benchmark AI workloads and identify performance bottlenecks.
- Assist in reproducing customer-reported issues in lab environments.
- Contribute to optimization studies for AI inference and training workloads.
 Automation and Tool Development: 
 - Develop Python-based tools to automate testing, monitoring, and data collection.
- Create dashboards, scripts, and utilities for cluster management and diagnostics.
- Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and technical knowledge bases.
- End-to-End AI Solutions
- Participate in building end-to-end AI solutions, such as generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, robotics, or intelligent automation projects.
- Work with cross-functional teams to integrate hardware, software, AI models, and applications into complete solutions.
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 - Currently pursuing Master's in: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or AI/ML or related fields
- Experience with Python programming.
- Familiarity with Linux command line and system administration concepts.
- Understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, networking, or distributed systems.
- Demonstrated ability to solve complex engineering or technical problems through coursework, research, personal projects, robotics competitions, hackathons, open-source contributions, or previous internships.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate in a team environment.

 - Python, C/C++, or Bash scripting
- Linux/Unix environments
- Git and software development workflows
- Docker or containerized applications

 - PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI frameworks
- LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, or generative AI applications
- Cloud or cluster computing environments
- GPU or AI accelerator technologies

 - AI/ML applications
- Robotics systems
- Autonomous systems
- Computer vision
- Distributed computing
- High-performance computing (HPC)
- End-to-end AI solution development
 Soft Skills: 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies.
- Ability to diagnose problems systematically and communicate findings clearly.

• AI accelerator and cluster architecture
• AI infrastructure deployment and operations
• System-level debugging and performance optimization
• AI model deployment and benchmarking
• Automation, monitoring, and validation frameworks
• Customer-facing AI solution development and deployment best practices

description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Senior Creative Project Manger (Managing Consultant) 
Overview
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally. Marketing Services is the organisation within Services that develops and executes the marketing programs that help our clients achieve their marketing goals. The Advisors Creative Desk (ACD) sits within Services and is responsible for ideating and creating engaging, forward-thinking, on-brand content solutions that connect our advertising partners, platforms, and our portfolio of brands.
As Creative Project Manager leading project delivery for ACD's Global Facility India (GFI), you will play a key role in advancing ACD's global capabilities, consistency, and growth. You will work closely with the Creative Director, GFI to champion creative quality, foster innovation, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. With strong stakeholder management and people leadership skills, you will drive project delivery excellence and efficiency at scale. 
Role
• Your primary responsibility is to effectively manage relations with ACD colleagues globally by responding to their inquiries, meeting specific requests, and maintaining regular communication throughout every project delivery lifecycle. 
• You will primarily be working on creative projects involving receiving creative briefs, monitoring project timelines, and ensuring that all project deliverables reach the stakeholder on time. 
• This is a highly collaborative role, as you will communicate not only with internal colleagues in ACD, but also Marketing Services colleagues and other members of our creative team to deliver projects on time and within budget.

description:
Designs and executes adversarial testing to   identify   how fraudsters and other bad actors may exploit Adobe’s externally facing products, APIs, customer journeys, and fraud controls. Uses software engineering, automation, data analysis, and adversarial techniques to recreate real-world attacks, test defenses, and   identify   control gaps.   
 Partners with Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, and Security to translate findings into stronger defenses and retests mitigations to   validate   their effectiveness against evolving fraud and abuse techniques.   
 What   you’ll   do   
 - Conduct adversarial testing of Adobe’s externally facing products, services, APIs, and fraud controls to   identify   how they may be exploited by fraudsters and other bad actors.   
 - Recreate real-world fraud and abuse attacks to understand attack paths,   identify   control gaps, and   determine   how defenses can be circumvented.   
 - Design and build automated testing tools and scripts using APIs,   Python   or similar languages to simulate fraud and abuse scenarios at scale.   
 - Develop creative test scenarios across account creation, identity, payments, entitlements, APIs, and other customer and product experiences.   
 - Partner with Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, Security, and other teams to understand threats, communicate findings, and recommend mitigations.   
 - Test new and existing fraud controls to   determine   their effectiveness and   identify   opportunities to strengthen detection and prevention.   
 - Retest mitigations to   validate   that identified attack paths have been effectively addressed and   identify   potential alternative methods of circumvention.   
 - Document attack methodologies, findings, and recommendations and help build repeatable adversarial testing capabilities.   
 - Stay current on emerging fraud, abuse, automation, and AI-enabled attack techniques and apply those learnings to Adobe’s products and defenses.   
 What you need to succeed   
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, plus 8+ years of hands-on industry experience.
- Strong software engineering or technical automation skills, with   proficiency   in Python or a similar scripting/programming language.   
 - Experience working with REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, web applications, automation frameworks, and modern cloud-based systems.   
 - Experience building scripts, tools, or automated workflows to test complex systems   and behaviors.   
 - Must have:   Python/similar programming, APIs/HTTP, automation, debugging, Git, data/SQL, ability to understand product architecture.   
 - Useful:   JavaScript, cloud services, browser automation, authentication/identity systems, CI/CD, security testing tools.   
 - Strong understanding of fraud, abuse, cybersecurity, adversarial testing, or digital risk, with curiosity about how bad actors exploit products and controls.   
 - Strong analytical skills and experience using SQL, logs, telemetry, or other data sources to understand system behavior and evaluate test results.   
 - An adversarial mindset with the creativity and persistence to   identify   alternative attack paths and methods of circumventing controls.   
 - Ability to understand complex product architectures and work effectively with Product, Engineering, Fraud, and Security teams.   
 - Strong communication   and documentation skills with the ability to translate technical findings into clear risks and actionable recommendations.   
 - Strong judgment and commitment to conducting adversarial testing safely, responsibly, and within established authorization and testing boundaries.

description:
We are now recruiting top Research Scientists to work on autonomous vehicles, robotics, and physical AI! Intelligent machines that can perceive, reason, and safely interact with people and the physical world are rapidly becoming a reality. Self-driving cars, autonomous delivery and construction vehicles, mobile manipulators, and other robotic systems are moving closer to widespread deployment. However, fundamental research challenges remain before these systems can operate safely, reliably, and autonomously in complex, unfamiliar environments.
 For example, how can we:
 - Develop new training paradigms that use perception and interaction to train autonomous vehicle and robot policies in closed loop?
- Equip autonomous systems with online and offline assurances that meet the requirements of safety-critical applications?
- Enable vehicles and robots to navigate across new environments, tasks, and embodiments?
- Build systems that reason under uncertainty and interact safely and naturally with people and other agents?
 These are some of the exciting questions being explored by NVIDIA’s Autonomous Systems and Physical AI Research (ASPIRE) group. Our diverse, interdisciplinary team conducts foundational research spanning foundation model design, embodied reasoning, safety, closed-loop training and evaluation, and agentic workflows for Physical AI development. We also investigate related areas including decision-making under uncertainty, deep learning, reinforcement learning, simulation, and the verification and validation of safety-critical AI systems. Our focus is on fundamental research, and lab members are encouraged to publish their work and open-source their code. NVIDIA is known for its collaborative culture, and our researchers work closely with experts across the company in autonomous vehicles, robotics, perception, simulation, and machine learning. This creates opportunities to influence real-world products while retaining the freedom and bandwidth to conduct groundbreaking, publishable research.
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Designing and implementing cutting-edge techniques for autonomous vehicles, robotics, and physical AI.
- Conducting original research and publishing your results.
- Collaborating with research colleagues, internal product teams, and external researchers.
- Transferring technology you’ve developed to relevant product groups.
 What we need to see: 
 - Completing or recently completed a PhD in 2026 in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
- Relevant research experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, embodied AI, or autonomous systems.
- Strong knowledge of the theory and practice of vehicle or robot autonomy—or expertise in a related area, with a strong interest in applying your work to autonomous systems.
- A track record of research excellence, demonstrated through publications at leading conferences and journals—such as RSS, ICRA, CoRL, IJRR, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, TAC, etc.—and through other research artifacts such as open-source software.
- Exceptional Python programming skills; experience with C++ and parallel programming, such as CUDA, is a plus.
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills are required, along with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, research-focused team.
 Are you intellectually curious, collaborative, and motivated to solve complex problems at the intersection of AI and the physical world? If so, you may be a great fit for NVIDIA.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026.

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Intern, Technical Program Management 
Why join Mastercard’s internship program? 
Mastercard's internship program offers more than hands-on work. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. 
Tech Team
The Technology Regulatory Excellence (TREX) EEMEA team works across Mastercard’s technology organization to help ensure products, services, and operations align with evolving regulatory requirements across Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). The team partners with product, engineering, operations, legal, and market teams to assess regulatory impacts, support compliance initiatives, and strengthen technology resilience across the region.
What You Will Do
As a Technical Program Management Intern, you will support cross-functional programs focused on technology, regulatory, and operational resilience initiatives across EEMEA. You will assist with research, data analysis, project tracking, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and reporting activities while gaining exposure to how large-scale technology and regulatory programs are planned, governed, and delivered within a global organization.
What we’re looking for: 
• Penultimate Year Students currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, with an anticipated graduation date between December 2027 and July 2028. 
• Available to work full-time for 10-12 weeks starting June 2027
• Strong verbal and written communication skills 
• Flexible, adaptive and a strong collaborator 
• Well planned, organised and structured to manage time and work effectively 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 - Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Use Your Power for Purpose 
 At Pfizer, our purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Your contributions will be pivotal in translating advanced science and technologies into impactful therapies and vaccines, ultimately improving patient outcomes globally. Whether you are involved in discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy, or supporting clinical trials, you will leverage cutting-edge design and process development capabilities to accelerate and deliver top-tier medicines to patients worldwide.
 What You Will Achieve 
 In this role, you will:
 - Contribute to immediate work group goals and collaborate with team members to achieve project objectives
- Perform process scale-down studies for characterizing and supporting the manufacturing of therapeutic vaccines and other drug substances
- Implement technology and continuous process development to ensure success
- Serve as a Technical Expert for manufacturing methods, conducting scientific studies and recommending improvements for reliability, cost, safety, compliance, and environmental performance
- Troubleshoot and improve established manufacturing processes, ensuring robustness and efficiency
- Represent MSAT in cross-functional project teams and participate in technical writing and review.
- Maintain laboratory areas and equipment in a clean, safe, and functional order, complying with safety and regulatory requirements
- Independently plan and perform work assignments, interpret and present data, and provide support for product transfers, new product development, and cost improvement projects
- Design and execute studies while prioritizing work to meet project deadlines and solving moderately complex problems under moderate supervision
 Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)
 - Bachelor’s Degree with at least 3 years of experience or an MBA/MS with any years of experience.
- Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering or related discipline. 
- Strong working knowledge of chemistry and ability to safely perform laboratory work
- Ability to perform complex data analysis
- Proficiency in troubleshooting technical issues
- Experience in planning and carrying out experiments independently
- Competence with MS Office as well as complex laboratory instrumentation and software
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
 Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)
 - Hands-on experience in bioconjugation chemistry, normal flow filtration, and tangential flow filtration of proteins and/or polysaccharides
- Strong knowledge and experience with international CMC regulatory requirements
- Familiarity with Current Good Manufacturing Practices (part of GxP)
- Ability to work effectively in a team environment
- Strong organizational and time management skills
- Experience with statistical experimental design and analysis using relevant software packages
- Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use
 PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS 
 Ability to perform mathematical calculations, analyze scientific data, draw scientifically sound conclusions and follow laboratory procedures.
 NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS 
 Flexible work hours (shift or weekend work) may be required to complete experiments at times. 
 Must wear personal protective equipment when required for lab safety (e.g. safety shoes, lab coat, gloves, safety glasses, goggles, face shield).

 Job Category 
Customer Success 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 Informatica MDM Technical Architect 
 Position Overview 
 We are seeking a highly technical, deeply hands-on, and strategically minded Informatica MDM Technical Architect t o lead the design, modernization, and delivery of enterprise-wide Master Data Management solutions. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and technical delivery lead supporting multiple customers - meaning you must be equally comfortable defining high-level strategic data roadmaps for executives and executing tactical hands-on development in the code. 
 The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of deep technical fluency within the Informatica IDMC platform, migrating legacy systems to the cloud, and a passion for embedding robust data governance into the core of enterprise data estates. 
 Key Responsibilities & Technical Requirements 
 - Lead the end-to-end design, data modeling, and deployment of robust, enterprise-wide Master Data Management (MDM) architectures spanning multiple core business domains (e.g., Customer, Product, Supplier). 
- Demonstrate extensive hands-on expertise with the Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) platform, explicitly leveraging Cloud Data Integration (CDI) and Cloud Application Integration (CAI). 
- Architect and configure Informatica MDM SaaS products, including Customer 360 (C360), Reference 360 (R360), and related cloud-native multidomain MDM solutions. 
- Successfully operate at both the strategic level (defining roadmaps, target architectures) and the tactical level (hands-on development, configuration, and deep-dive troubleshooting). 
- Lead complex legacy-to-cloud modernization initiatives, transitioning older, on-premises Informatica MDM Hub architectures into cloud-native IDMC environments. 
- Infuse data governance frameworks, metadata catalogs, data lineage, and data quality standards natively into the MDM lifecycle using Cloud Data Quality (CDQ) and governance tools. 
- Effectively manage and support multiple customers simultaneously, aligning their unique business requirements with scalable, high-performing technical strategies. 
- Architect real-time API integrations, event-driven streaming, and batch ETL pipelines connecting MDM with modern cloud data platforms and SaaS applications. 
- Design and fine-tune complex match/merge rules, survivorship matrices, hierarchy management configurations, and multi-source ingestion frameworks. 
- • Design intuitive data stewardship interfaces, custom task workflows (e.g., CAI, ActiveVOS), and business validation rules to maximize operational efficiency for data stewards. 
- Articulate complex technical designs, trade-offs, and strategic visions with clarity, reasoned judgment, and relevance to both engineering teams and business executive sponsors. 
- Actively leverage modern AI tools and generative AI features to accelerate development workflows, optimize code/configurations, and streamline technical documentation processes. 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 - Minimum of 8 years of strong, hands-on technical experience dedicated to Informatica MDM and data integration products (with 15+ years of overall IT/Data Architecture experience highly preferred to match senior market demands). 
- Successful delivery of multiple full-lifecycle enterprise MDM implementations from discovery and blueprinting through to production go-live. 
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 
 Note: This is an exceptionally hands-on technical architecture role. If you are a purely high-level strategist or administrative manager who no longer configures platforms or builds components, this position will not be a proper fit. 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible —

 At NVIDIA, we believe that inference will be driving increasing amount of compute, and as the hardware becomes more capable, it is crucial to make it easy for users to get the best performance as easily as possible. NVIDIA Dynamo helps users achieve state-of-the-art performance, using advanced techniques such as disaggregated serving, KV-aware routing, and others.  - Contribute to the Dynamo family of open source projects.
- Serve as a technical expert in AI inferencing, helping to push the frontier of what's possible.
- Represent Dynamo and NVIDIA with customers, partners and the AI community.
- Lead critical initiatives around resiliency, performance and scalability for Dynamo and AI inference.
- Build and drive Dynamo to continue being a production-ready, data center-scale AI inferencing platform.
- Collaborate with diverse partner teams at NVIDIA across storage, networking, hardware and performance.
- Keep abreast of the latest advancements in AI/ML infrastructure technologies, frameworks, and effective strategies, and promote their implementation within the company.

 - BS, MS, PhD, or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related field.

- Expertise in the AI inference space, such as operating production inference systems at scale, working on inference engines, or similar.
- Experience serving as a senior technical leader in an organization, with the ability to lead through influence.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Rust, Python, and Go, as well as familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
- Excellent problem-solving skills, showing proficiency in analyzing complex systems, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing scalable solutions.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, demonstrating effectiveness in working with diverse teams and individuals.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience in production-grade infrastructure, knowing how to take into account observability, resilience and operations.
- Enthusiasm for continual learning and keeping abreast of new technologies and effective approaches within the AI/ML systems domain.
